```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(CS2-Internal LANGUAGES CXX C)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Global compile options
if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W3 /MP /EHsc)
    add_compile_definitions(WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
else()
    add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra)
endif()

# Shared include directory
set(SHARED_INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Shared)

# Mapper removed — replaced by Loader v2 with built-in manual map

# ============================================================================
# Cheat DLL (injected into cs2.exe)
# ============================================================================

# Vendor: Dear ImGui sources
set(IMGUI_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Cheat/vendor/imgui)
set(IMGUI_SOURCES
    ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui.cpp
    ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
    ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
    ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp
    ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp

)

    ${MINHOOK_DIR}/buffer.c

    ${MINHOOK_DIR}/hde32.c
    ${MINHOOK_DIR}/hde64.c
)
```

`Cheat/src/config/config.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "config.h"
#include "json.hpp"
#include <fstream>
#include <filesystem>
#include <ShlObj.h>

using json = nlohmann::json;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

// ============================================================================
// JSON serialization for config structures
// ============================================================================

// Color
void to_json(json& j, const Color& c) {
    j = json::array({ c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a });
}

void from_json(const json& j, Color& c) {
    if (j.is_array() && j.size() >= 4) {
        c.r = j[0].get<uint8_t>();
        c.g = j[1].get<uint8_t>();
        c.b = j[2].get<uint8_t>();
        c.a = j[3].get<uint8_t>();
    }
}

// AimbotConfig
void to_json(json& j, const AimbotConfig& a) {
    j = json{
        {"enabled", a.enabled},
        {"key", a.key},
        {"fov", a.fov},
        {"smooth", a.smooth},
        {"smoothType", a.smoothType},
        {"bone", a.bone},
        {"visibilityCheck", a.visibilityCheck},
        {"rcs", a.rcs},
        {"rcsAmount", a.rcsAmount},
        {"prediction", a.prediction},
        {"triggerbot", {
            {"enabled", a.triggerbot.enabled},
            {"delayMinMs", a.triggerbot.delayMinMs},
            {"delayMaxMs", a.triggerbot.delayMaxMs},
            {"headOnly", a.triggerbot.headOnly}
        }}
    };
}

void from_json(const json& j, AimbotConfig& a) {
    if (j.contains("enabled"))         j.at("enabled").get_to(a.enabled);
    if (j.contains("key"))             j.at("key").get_to(a.key);
    if (j.contains("fov"))             j.at("fov").get_to(a.fov);
    if (j.contains("smooth"))          j.at("smooth").get_to(a.smooth);
    if (j.contains("smoothType"))      j.at("smoothType").get_to(a.smoothType);
    if (j.contains("bone"))            j.at("bone").get_to(a.bone);
    if (j.contains("visibilityCheck")) j.at("visibilityCheck").get_to(a.visibilityCheck);
    if (j.contains("rcs"))             j.at("rcs").get_to(a.rcs);
    if (j.contains("rcsAmount"))       j.at("rcsAmount").get_to(a.rcsAmount);
    if (j.contains("prediction"))      j.at("prediction").get_to(a.prediction);

    if (j.contains("triggerbot")) {
        auto& tb = j.at("triggerbot");
        if (tb.contains("enabled"))    tb.at("enabled").get_to(a.triggerbot.enabled);
        if (tb.contains("delayMinMs")) tb.at("delayMinMs").get_to(a.triggerbot.delayMinMs);
        if (tb.contains("delayMaxMs")) tb.at("delayMaxMs").get_to(a.triggerbot.delayMaxMs);
        if (tb.contains("headOnly"))   tb.at("headOnly").get_to(a.triggerbot.headOnly);
    }
}

// EspConfig
void to_json(json& j, const EspConfig& e) {
    j = json{
        {"enabled", e.enabled},
        {"boxes", {
            {"enabled", e.boxes.enabled},
            {"style", e.boxes.style},
            {"thickness", e.boxes.thickness}
        }},
        {"healthBar", e.healthBar},
        {"armorBar", e.armorBar},
        {"name", e.name},
        {"distance", e.distance},
        {"weapon", e.weapon},
        {"skeleton", e.skeleton},
        {"headDot", e.headDot},
        {"snaplines", {
            {"enabled", e.snaplines.enabled},
            {"position", e.snaplines.position}
        }},
        {"enemyColor", e.enemyColor},
        {"teamColor", e.teamColor},
        {"visibleColor", e.visibleColor},
        {"bombInfo", e.bombInfo},
        {"droppedWeapons", e.droppedWeapons}
    };
}

void from_json(const json& j, EspConfig& e) {
    if (j.contains("enabled"))    j.at("enabled").get_to(e.enabled);
    if (j.contains("healthBar"))  j.at("healthBar").get_to(e.healthBar);
    if (j.contains("armorBar"))   j.at("armorBar").get_to(e.armorBar);
    if (j.contains("name"))       j.at("name").get_to(e.name);
    if (j.contains("distance"))   j.at("distance").get_to(e.distance);
    if (j.contains("weapon"))     j.at("weapon").get_to(e.weapon);
    if (j.contains("skeleton"))   j.at("skeleton").get_to(e.skeleton);
    if (j.contains("headDot"))    j.at("headDot").get_to(e.headDot);
    if (j.contains("bombInfo"))   j.at("bombInfo").get_to(e.bombInfo);
    if (j.contains("droppedWeapons")) j.at("droppedWeapons").get_to(e.droppedWeapons);
    if (j.contains("enemyColor"))   j.at("enemyColor").get_to(e.enemyColor);
    if (j.contains("teamColor"))    j.at("teamColor").get_to(e.teamColor);
    if (j.contains("visibleColor")) j.at("visibleColor").get_to(e.visibleColor);

    if (j.contains("boxes")) {
        auto& b = j.at("boxes");
        if (b.contains("enabled"))   b.at("enabled").get_to(e.boxes.enabled);
        if (b.contains("style"))     b.at("style").get_to(e.boxes.style);
        if (b.contains("thickness")) b.at("thickness").get_to(e.boxes.thickness);
    }
    if (j.contains("snaplines")) {
        auto& s = j.at("snaplines");
        if (s.contains("enabled"))   s.at("enabled").get_to(e.snaplines.enabled);
        if (s.contains("position"))  s.at("position").get_to(e.snaplines.position);
    }
}

// MiscConfig
void to_json(json& j, const MiscConfig& m) {
    j = json{
        {"bhop", m.bhop},
        {"autostrafe", m.autostrafe},
        {"radar", m.radar},
        {"noflash", m.noflash},
        {"spectatorList", m.spectatorList},
        {"flashMaxAlpha", m.flashMaxAlpha}
    };
}

void from_json(const json& j, MiscConfig& m) {
    if (j.contains("bhop"))          j.at("bhop").get_to(m.bhop);
    if (j.contains("autostrafe"))    j.at("autostrafe").get_to(m.autostrafe);
    if (j.contains("radar"))         j.at("radar").get_to(m.radar);
    if (j.contains("noflash"))       j.at("noflash").get_to(m.noflash);
    if (j.contains("spectatorList")) j.at("spectatorList").get_to(m.spectatorList);
    if (j.contains("flashMaxAlpha")) j.at("flashMaxAlpha").get_to(m.flashMaxAlpha);
}

// SkinWeaponConfig
void to_json(json& j, const SkinWeaponConfig& s) {
    j = json{
        {"paintKit", s.paintKit},
        {"wear", s.wear},
        {"seed", s.seed},
        {"statTrak", s.statTrak}
    };
}

void from_json(const json& j, SkinWeaponConfig& s) {
    if (j.contains("paintKit")) j.at("paintKit").get_to(s.paintKit);
    if (j.contains("wear"))     j.at("wear").get_to(s.wear);
    if (j.contains("seed"))     j.at("seed").get_to(s.seed);
    if (j.contains("statTrak")) j.at("statTrak").get_to(s.statTrak);
}

// SkinChangerConfig
void to_json(json& j, const SkinChangerConfig& s) {
    j = json{
        {"enabled", s.enabled},
        {"knife", {
            {"model", s.knife.model},
            {"paintKit", s.knife.paintKit},
            {"wear", s.knife.wear}
        }},
        {"gloves", {
            {"model", s.gloves.model},
            {"paintKit", s.gloves.paintKit},
            {"wear", s.gloves.wear}
        }}
    };

    // Serialize weapon configs
    json weaponsJson;
    for (const auto& [defIndex, config] : s.weapons) {
        weaponsJson[std::to_string(defIndex)] = config;
    }
    j["weapons"] = weaponsJson;
}

void from_json(const json& j, SkinChangerConfig& s) {
    if (j.contains("enabled")) j.at("enabled").get_to(s.enabled);

    if (j.contains("knife")) {
        auto& k = j.at("knife");
        if (k.contains("model"))    k.at("model").get_to(s.knife.model);
        if (k.contains("paintKit")) k.at("paintKit").get_to(s.knife.paintKit);
        if (k.contains("wear"))     k.at("wear").get_to(s.knife.wear);
    }

    if (j.contains("gloves")) {
        auto& g = j.at("gloves");
        if (g.contains("model"))    g.at("model").get_to(s.gloves.model);
        if (g.contains("paintKit")) g.at("paintKit").get_to(s.gloves.paintKit);
        if (g.contains("wear"))     g.at("wear").get_to(s.gloves.wear);
    }

    if (j.contains("weapons")) {
        for (auto& [key, val] : j.at("weapons").items()) {
            int defIndex = std::stoi(key);
            s.weapons[defIndex] = val.get<SkinWeaponConfig>();
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ConfigManager implementation
// ============================================================================

bool ConfigManager::Initialize() {
    // Build config path: %APPDATA%/CS2Cheat/configs/
    char appDataPath[MAX_PATH];
    if (FAILED(SHGetFolderPathA(nullptr, CSIDL_APPDATA, nullptr, 0, appDataPath))) {
        return false;
    }

    m_configPath = std::string(appDataPath) + "\\CS2Cheat\\configs";

    if (!EnsureDirectoryExists())
        return false;

    // Try loading default profile
    if (!Load("default")) {
        // No default exists — save current defaults
        m_current.name = "default";
        Save("default");
    }

    return true;
}

bool ConfigManager::Save(const std::string& profileName) {
    std::string name = profileName.empty() ? m_current.name : profileName;
    std::string path = GetProfilePath(name);

    json j = json{
        {"name", name},
        {"aimbot", m_current.aimbot},
        {"esp", m_current.esp},
        {"misc", m_current.misc},
        {"skinchanger", m_current.skinchanger}
    };

    std::ofstream file(path);
    if (!file.is_open())
        return false;

    file << j.dump(4); // Pretty print with 4-space indent
    file.close();

    m_current.name = name;
    return true;
}

bool ConfigManager::Load(const std::string& profileName) {
    std::string path = GetProfilePath(profileName);

    std::ifstream file(path);
    if (!file.is_open())
        return false;

    try {
        json j;
        file >> j;

        if (j.contains("name"))        j.at("name").get_to(m_current.name);
        if (j.contains("aimbot"))      j.at("aimbot").get_to(m_current.aimbot);
        if (j.contains("esp"))         j.at("esp").get_to(m_current.esp);
        if (j.contains("misc"))        j.at("misc").get_to(m_current.misc);
        if (j.contains("skinchanger")) j.at("skinchanger").get_to(m_current.skinchanger);

        return true;
    }
    catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}

bool ConfigManager::Delete(const std::string& profileName) {
    std::string path = GetProfilePath(profileName);

    try {
        return fs::remove(path);
    }
    catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}

std::vector<std::string> ConfigManager::GetProfileNames() const {
    std::vector<std::string> names;

    try {
        for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(m_configPath)) {
            if (entry.path().extension() == ".json") {
                names.push_back(entry.path().stem().string());
            }
        }
    }
    catch (...) {}

    return names;
}

std::string ConfigManager::GetProfilePath(const std::string& name) const {
    return m_configPath + "\\" + name + ".json";
}

bool ConfigManager::EnsureDirectoryExists() {
    try {
        fs::create_directories(m_configPath);
        return true;
    }
    catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}
```

`Cheat/src/config/config.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "../sdk/vector.h"
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>

// ============================================================================
// Configuration system — JSON-based profiles with save/load
// ============================================================================

// Aimbot settings
struct AimbotConfig {
    bool  enabled        = false;
    int   key            = 0x05;   // MOUSE4 (XBUTTON1)
    float fov            = 5.0f;
    float smooth         = 3.5f;
    int   smoothType     = 2;      // 0=linear, 1=bezier, 2=humanized
    int   bone           = 6;      // BoneId::HEAD
    bool  visibilityCheck = true;
    bool  rcs            = true;
    float rcsAmount      = 100.f;  // percentage
    bool  prediction     = true;

    struct {
        bool  enabled      = false;
        int   delayMinMs   = 15;
        int   delayMaxMs   = 65;
        bool  headOnly     = false;
    } triggerbot;
};

// ESP settings
struct EspConfig {
    bool  enabled     = true;

    struct {
        bool  enabled   = true;
        int   style     = 1;       // 0=full, 1=corner, 2=3d
        float thickness = 1.5f;
    } boxes;

    bool  healthBar   = true;
    bool  armorBar    = false;
    bool  name        = true;
    bool  distance    = true;
    bool  weapon      = true;
    bool  skeleton    = false;
    bool  headDot     = false;

    struct {
        bool  enabled   = false;
        int   position  = 2;       // 0=top, 1=center, 2=bottom
    } snaplines;

    Color enemyColor   = Color(255, 50, 50, 255);
    Color teamColor    = Color(50, 255, 50, 255);
    Color visibleColor = Color(255, 255, 50, 255);

    // World ESP
    bool  bombInfo     = true;
    bool  droppedWeapons = false;
};

// Misc settings
struct MiscConfig {
    bool  bhop          = false;
    bool  autostrafe    = false;
    bool  radar         = false;
    bool  noflash       = false;
    bool  spectatorList = true;
    float flashMaxAlpha = 0.f;     // 0 = full remove, 0-255 range
};

// Skin changer settings
struct SkinWeaponConfig {
    int   paintKit = 0;
    float wear     = 0.0001f;
    int   seed     = 0;
    int   statTrak = -1;           // -1 = disabled
};

struct SkinChangerConfig {
    bool  enabled = false;

    struct {
        int   model    = 507;      // Karambit
        int   paintKit = 415;      // Marble Fade
        float wear     = 0.01f;
    } knife;

    struct {
        int   model    = 5028;     // Sport Gloves
        int   paintKit = 10036;    // Pandora's Box
        float wear     = 0.01f;
    } gloves;

    std::unordered_map<int, SkinWeaponConfig> weapons; // key = weapon def index
};

// Full config profile
struct ConfigProfile {
    std::string       name = "default";
    AimbotConfig      aimbot;
    EspConfig         esp;
    MiscConfig        misc;
    SkinChangerConfig skinchanger;
};

// ============================================================================
// Config manager — handles loading/saving/switching profiles
// ============================================================================
class ConfigManager {
public:
    static ConfigManager& Get() {
        static ConfigManager instance;
        return instance;
    }

    // Initialize — create config directory, load default profile
    bool Initialize();

    // Profile management
    bool Save(const std::string& profileName = "");
    bool Load(const std::string& profileName);
    bool Delete(const std::string& profileName);
    std::vector<std::string> GetProfileNames() const;

    // Access current config
    ConfigProfile& Current() { return m_current; }
    const ConfigProfile& Current() const { return m_current; }

    // Convenience accessors
    AimbotConfig&      Aimbot()      { return m_current.aimbot; }
    EspConfig&         Esp()         { return m_current.esp; }
    MiscConfig&        Misc()        { return m_current.misc; }
    SkinChangerConfig& Skins()       { return m_current.skinchanger; }

    // Get config directory path
    const std::string& GetConfigPath() const { return m_configPath; }

private:
    ConfigManager() = default;

    std::string   m_configPath;
    ConfigProfile m_current;

    std::string GetProfilePath(const std::string& name) const;
    bool EnsureDirectoryExists();
};
```

`Cheat/src/core/hooks.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "hooks.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>

// MinHook
#include "MinHook.h"

// ============================================================================
// Hook manager — MinHook wrapper for inline function hooking
// For external overlay approach, minimal hooks are needed
// ============================================================================

namespace Hooks {

    static bool g_initialized = false;

    // ========================================================================
    // Initialize MinHook
    // ========================================================================
    bool Initialize() {
        if (g_initialized)
            return true;

        MH_STATUS status = MH_Initialize();
        if (status != MH_OK) {
            printf("[CS2] MinHook init failed: %s\n", MH_StatusToString(status));
            return false;
        }

        g_initialized = true;
        printf("[CS2] MinHook initialized\n");

        // For external overlay rendering, we don't need to hook the game's
        // Present/SwapBuffers. We run our own DirectX device on a separate window.
        //
        // Optional hooks we could add:
        // - FrameStageNotify: for per-frame data updates (bone caching, etc.)
        // - LevelInit/LevelShutdown: for map change detection
        // - For now, we poll data in our own thread loop instead.

        return true;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // CreateHook — hook a function at `target`, redirect to `detour`
    // ========================================================================
    bool CreateHook(void* target, void* detour, void** original) {
        if (!g_initialized)
            return false;

        MH_STATUS status = MH_CreateHook(target, detour, original);
        if (status != MH_OK) {
            printf("[CS2] Failed to create hook at 0x%p: %s\n", target, MH_StatusToString(status));
            return false;
        }

        status = MH_EnableHook(target);
        if (status != MH_OK) {
            printf("[CS2] Failed to enable hook at 0x%p: %s\n", target, MH_StatusToString(status));
            MH_RemoveHook(target);
            return false;
        }

        printf("[CS2] Hook installed at 0x%p\n", target);
        return true;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // RemoveHook — unhook a previously hooked function
    // ========================================================================
    bool RemoveHook(void* target) {
        if (!g_initialized)
            return false;

        MH_DisableHook(target);
        MH_RemoveHook(target);
        return true;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Shutdown — remove all hooks and uninitialize MinHook
    // ========================================================================
    void Shutdown() {
        if (!g_initialized)
            return;

        MH_DisableHook(MH_ALL_HOOKS);
        MH_Uninitialize();
        g_initialized = false;

        printf("[CS2] Hooks shutdown\n");
    }

} // namespace Hooks

```

`Cheat/src/core/interfaces.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "interfaces.h"
#include "../sdk/engine.h"
#include "../sdk/entity.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// Source 2 Interface System — OFFSET BASED (no CreateInterface calls)
// Avoids anti-tamper: we never call game functions, only read memory
// ============================================================================

// Log to file (same as dllmain.cpp)
extern void Log(const char* msg);

namespace Interfaces {

    void* pGameResourceService = nullptr;
    void* pGameEntitySystem    = nullptr;
    void* pEngineClient        = nullptr;
    void* pInputSystem         = nullptr;
    void* pSchemaSystem        = nullptr;
    void* pMaterialSystem      = nullptr;

    uintptr_t clientBase = 0;
    uintptr_t clientSize = 0;
    uintptr_t engineBase = 0;

    bool Initialize() {
        Log("[Interfaces] Starting offset-based init...");

        // Wait for critical modules
        int attempts = 0;
        while (!GetModuleHandleA(ModuleNames::Client) && attempts < 200) {
            Sleep(100);
            attempts++;
        }
        if (!GetModuleHandleA(ModuleNames::Client)) {
            Log("[Interfaces] FATAL: client.dll timeout");
            return false;
        }

        // Get module bases — safe, no game functions called
        clientBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(GetModuleHandleA(ModuleNames::Client));
        engineBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(GetModuleHandleA(ModuleNames::Engine));

        if (!clientBase) {
            Log("[Interfaces] FATAL: client.dll base is NULL");
            return false;
        }

        // Get client.dll size from PE headers
        auto* dosHeader = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(clientBase);
        auto* ntHeaders = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*>(clientBase + dosHeader->e_lfanew);
        clientSize = ntHeaders->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;

        char buf[256];
        sprintf_s(buf, "[Interfaces] client.dll: 0x%llX (size: 0x%llX)",
                  (unsigned long long)clientBase, (unsigned long long)clientSize);
        Log(buf);
        sprintf_s(buf, "[Interfaces] engine2.dll: 0x%llX", (unsigned long long)engineBase);
        Log(buf);

        // Read entity system pointer from known offset
        // dwEntityList points to the CGameEntitySystem
        uintptr_t entityListAddr = clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList;
        pGameEntitySystem = *reinterpret_cast<void**>(entityListAddr);

        sprintf_s(buf, "[Interfaces] EntitySystem: 0x%p (from offset 0x%llX)",
                  pGameEntitySystem, (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwEntityList);
        Log(buf);

        Log("[Interfaces] Offset-based init complete (no game functions called)");
        return true;
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        pGameResourceService = nullptr;
        pGameEntitySystem    = nullptr;
        clientBase = 0;
        engineBase = 0;
    }

} // namespace Interfaces
```

`Cheat/src/core/offsets.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "offsets.h"
#include "interfaces.h"
#include "../sdk/entity.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

// ============================================================================
// Offset Manager — pattern scanning + hardcoded offset loading
// ============================================================================

namespace OffsetManager {

    // ========================================================================
    // PatternScan — Boyer-Moore-ish pattern scanner
    // Pattern format: "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0" (? = wildcard)
    // ========================================================================
    uintptr_t PatternScan(uintptr_t base, uintptr_t size, const char* pattern) {
        // Parse pattern string into bytes + mask
        struct PatternByte {
            uint8_t value;
            bool    wildcard;
        };

        PatternByte parsed[256];
        int patternLen = 0;

        const char* p = pattern;
        while (*p && patternLen < 256) {
            // Skip spaces
            while (*p == ' ') p++;
            if (!*p) break;

            if (*p == '?') {
                parsed[patternLen].value = 0;
                parsed[patternLen].wildcard = true;
                patternLen++;
                p++;
                if (*p == '?') p++; // Handle "??"
            } else {
                // Parse hex byte
                char hex[3] = { p[0], p[1], 0 };
                parsed[patternLen].value = (uint8_t)strtoul(hex, nullptr, 16);
                parsed[patternLen].wildcard = false;
                patternLen++;
                p += 2;
            }
        }

        if (patternLen == 0)
            return 0;

        // Scan memory
        const uint8_t* scanBase = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(base);

        for (uintptr_t i = 0; i < size - patternLen; i++) {
            bool found = true;
            for (int j = 0; j < patternLen; j++) {
                if (!parsed[j].wildcard && scanBase[i + j] != parsed[j].value) {
                    found = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (found) {
                return base + i;
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // ResolveRelative — resolve a RIP-relative address
    // Given: instruction at `addr` with a 4-byte relative offset at `addr + offset`
    // Returns: the absolute address it points to
    // ========================================================================
    uintptr_t ResolveRelative(uintptr_t addr, int offset, int instrLength) {
        int32_t relativeAddr = *reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(addr + offset);
        return addr + instrLength + relativeAddr;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Initialize — try pattern scanning for key offsets, fall back to hardcoded
    // ========================================================================
    bool Initialize() {
        printf("[CS2] Initializing offsets...\n");

        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        uintptr_t clientSize = Interfaces::clientSize;

        if (!clientBase || !clientSize) {
            printf("[CS2] Client module not available for scanning\n");
            return false;
        }

        // Try scanning for entity list
        // Pattern: 48 8B 0D ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 89 7C 24 (lea rcx, dwEntityList)
        uintptr_t entityListScan = PatternScan(clientBase, clientSize,
            "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 7C 24");
        if (entityListScan) {
            Offsets::dwEntityList = ResolveRelative(entityListScan, 3, 7) - clientBase;
            printf("[CS2] Scanned dwEntityList: 0x%llX\n", (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwEntityList);
        } else {
            printf("[CS2] Using hardcoded dwEntityList: 0x%llX\n",
                   (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwEntityList);
        }

        // Try scanning for local player controller
        uintptr_t localPlayerScan = PatternScan(clientBase, clientSize,
            "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 8B 88");
        if (localPlayerScan) {
            Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController = ResolveRelative(localPlayerScan, 3, 7) - clientBase;
            printf("[CS2] Scanned dwLocalPlayerController: 0x%llX\n",
                   (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
        } else {
            printf("[CS2] Using hardcoded dwLocalPlayerController: 0x%llX\n",
                   (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
        }

        // Try scanning for view matrix
        uintptr_t viewMatrixScan = PatternScan(clientBase, clientSize,
            "48 8D 05 ? ? ? ? 48 C1 E0 06");
        if (viewMatrixScan) {
            Offsets::dwViewMatrix = ResolveRelative(viewMatrixScan, 3, 7) - clientBase;
            printf("[CS2] Scanned dwViewMatrix: 0x%llX\n",
                   (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwViewMatrix);
        } else {
            printf("[CS2] Using hardcoded dwViewMatrix: 0x%llX\n",
                   (unsigned long long)Offsets::dwViewMatrix);
        }

        printf("[CS2] Offsets initialized (scanned where possible, hardcoded fallback)\n");
        printf("[CS2] NOTE: Offsets may need updating after CS2 patches.\n");
        printf("[CS2] Check github.com/a2x/cs2-dumper for latest offsets.\n");

        return true;
    }

} // namespace OffsetManager
```

```cpp
#include "schema.h"
#include "interfaces.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <string>

// ============================================================================
// Schema System — CS2 uses runtime type information (schema) for netvars
// We dump the schema at init and cache offsets for fast lookup
// ============================================================================

namespace Schema {

    // Cache: "ClassName::FieldName" -> offset
    static std::unordered_map<std::string, int32_t> g_offsetCache;

    // Schema system internal structures (reverse engineered)
    struct SchemaClassFieldData {
        const char* name;         // 0x00
        void*       type;         // 0x08
        int32_t     offset;       // 0x10
        int32_t     metadataSize; // 0x14
        void*       metadata;     // 0x18
    };

    struct SchemaClassInfoData {
        char        pad_0x00[0x08];
        const char* name;         // 0x08
        char        pad_0x10[0x08];
        int         fieldCount;   // 0x18 (approx, varies by build)
        char        pad_0x1C[0x04];
        SchemaClassFieldData* fields; // 0x20
    };

    struct SchemaTypeScopeData {
        char pad[0x08];
        char name[256];
        // The actual layout is complex — we use the vtable approach instead
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // DumpClassFields — dump all fields for a class and cache them
    // ========================================================================
    static void DumpClassFields(const char* className, SchemaClassInfoData* classInfo) {
        if (!classInfo || !classInfo->fields)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < classInfo->fieldCount; i++) {
            SchemaClassFieldData& field = classInfo->fields[i];
            if (!field.name)
                continue;

            std::string key = std::string(className) + "::" + field.name;
            g_offsetCache[key] = field.offset;
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // GetOffset — look up a cached schema offset
    // Usage: Schema::GetOffset("CCSPlayerPawn", "m_iHealth")
    // ========================================================================
    int32_t GetOffset(const char* className, const char* fieldName) {
        std::string key = std::string(className) + "::" + fieldName;

        auto it = g_offsetCache.find(key);
        if (it != g_offsetCache.end()) {
            return it->second;
        }

        // Not found — return -1
        printf("[CS2] Schema offset not found: %s::%s\n", className, fieldName);
        return -1;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // HasOffset — check if an offset is cached
    // ========================================================================
    bool HasOffset(const char* className, const char* fieldName) {
        std::string key = std::string(className) + "::" + fieldName;
        return g_offsetCache.count(key) > 0;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Initialize — dump schema from the SchemaSystem interface
    // ========================================================================
    bool Initialize() {
        printf("[CS2] Initializing schema system...\n");

        void* schemaSystem = Interfaces::pSchemaSystem;
        if (!schemaSystem) {
            printf("[CS2] SchemaSystem interface not available, using hardcoded offsets\n");
            // Populate cache with hardcoded offsets as fallback
            // These match the values in entity.h Offsets namespace
            // Updated from cs2-dumper 2026-08-20
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_iHealth"]           = 0x34C;
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_iTeamNum"]          = 0x3E7;
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_fFlags"]            = 0x3F4;
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_pGameSceneNode"]    = 0x330;
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_vecAbsVelocity"]    = 0x3F8;
            g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_sSanitizedPlayerName"] = 0x868;
            g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_hPlayerPawn"] = 0x914;
            g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_bPawnIsAlive"] = 0x91C;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_ArmorValue"]      = 0x1CA4;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_bIsScoped"]       = 0x1C78;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_iShotsFired"]     = 0x1C8C;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_bIsDefusing"]     = 0x1C7A;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_entitySpottedState"] = 0x1C60;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_iIDEntIndex"]     = 0x342C;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_pAimPunchServices"] = 0x14B8;
            g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawnBase::m_flFlashMaxAlpha"] = 0x1424;
            g_offsetCache["C_BasePlayerPawn::m_pObserverServices"] = 0x1220;
            g_offsetCache["C_BasePlayerPawn::m_pWeaponServices"]  = 0x1208;
            g_offsetCache["C_BasePlayerPawn::m_pCameraServices"]  = 0x1240;
            g_offsetCache["C_BaseModelEntity::m_vecViewOffset"]   = 0xE78;
            g_offsetCache["CGameSceneNode::m_vecAbsOrigin"]    = 0xC8;
            g_offsetCache["CGameSceneNode::m_bDormant"]        = 0x103;
            g_offsetCache["CSkeletonInstance::m_modelState"]    = 0x140;

            printf("[CS2] Loaded %zu hardcoded schema offsets\n", g_offsetCache.size());
            return true;
        }

        // Use the SchemaSystem interface to enumerate type scopes and classes
        // SchemaSystem vtable layout (approximate):
        //   [0] = destructor
        //   [1] = FindTypeScopeForModule
        //   ... varies by build

        // FindTypeScopeForModule("client.dll") to get client type scope
        using FindTypeScopeFn = void* (__thiscall*)(void*, const char*);
        auto vtable = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t**>(schemaSystem);

        // Try vtable index 13 (common for FindTypeScopeForModule)
        auto findScope = reinterpret_cast<FindTypeScopeFn>(vtable[13]);
        void* clientScope = findScope(schemaSystem, "client.dll");

        if (clientScope) {
            printf("[CS2] Found client.dll type scope at 0x%p\n", clientScope);
            // We would enumerate classes here, but the vtable layout varies per build
            // For reliability, we use hardcoded offsets as primary + schema as validation
        }

        // Still load hardcoded as fallback/primary (cs2-dumper 2026-08-20)
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_iHealth"]           = 0x34C;
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_iTeamNum"]          = 0x3E7;
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_fFlags"]            = 0x3F4;
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_pGameSceneNode"]    = 0x330;
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseEntity::m_vecAbsVelocity"]    = 0x3F8;
        g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_sSanitizedPlayerName"] = 0x868;
        g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_hPlayerPawn"] = 0x914;
        g_offsetCache["CCSPlayerController::m_bPawnIsAlive"] = 0x91C;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_ArmorValue"]      = 0x1CA4;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_bIsScoped"]       = 0x1C78;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_iShotsFired"]     = 0x1C8C;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_entitySpottedState"] = 0x1C60;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_iIDEntIndex"]     = 0x342C;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawn::m_pAimPunchServices"] = 0x14B8;
        g_offsetCache["C_CSPlayerPawnBase::m_flFlashMaxAlpha"] = 0x1424;
        g_offsetCache["C_BasePlayerPawn::m_pObserverServices"] = 0x1220;
        g_offsetCache["C_BasePlayerPawn::m_pWeaponServices"]  = 0x1208;
        g_offsetCache["C_BaseModelEntity::m_vecViewOffset"]   = 0xE78;
        g_offsetCache["CGameSceneNode::m_vecAbsOrigin"]    = 0xC8;

        printf("[CS2] Schema initialized with %zu cached offsets\n", g_offsetCache.size());
        return true;
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        g_offsetCache.clear();
    }

} // namespace Schema
```

`Cheat/src/dllmain.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstring>

#include "core/interfaces.h"
#include "core/schema.h"
#include "core/offsets.h"
#include "config/config.h"
#include "sdk/entity.h"
#include "math/math.h"
#include "shared_data.h"

// ============================================================================
// Project Nexus v6.0 — Fixed entity list + mouse aimbot
// Based on working reference code
// ============================================================================

static std::atomic<bool> g_running{ true };
static HANDLE g_hMapFile = nullptr;
static NexusSharedData* g_shared = nullptr;

void Log(const char* msg) {
    char p[MAX_PATH]; GetTempPathA(MAX_PATH, p);
    std::ofstream f(std::string(p)+"nexus_debug.log", std::ios::app);
    if (f.is_open()) f << msg << std::endl;
}

template<typename T>
static T R(uintptr_t a) {
    if (!a) return T{};
    __try { return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(a); }
    __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { return T{}; }
}

template<typename T>
static void W(uintptr_t a, T v) {
    if (!a) return;
    __try { *reinterpret_cast<T*>(a) = v; }
    __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {}
}

static bool CreateSharedMem() {
    g_hMapFile = CreateFileMappingA(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, nullptr,
        PAGE_READWRITE, 0, sizeof(NexusSharedData), NEXUS_SHARED_NAME);
    if (!g_hMapFile) return false;
    g_shared = (NexusSharedData*)MapViewOfFile(g_hMapFile,
        FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, sizeof(NexusSharedData));
    if (!g_shared) { CloseHandle(g_hMapFile); return false; }
    memset(g_shared, 0, sizeof(NexusSharedData));
    g_shared->magic = NEXUS_DATA_MAGIC;
    g_shared->connected = true;
    g_shared->aimbotFov = 80.0f; // Pixel FOV like reference
    g_shared->aimbotSmooth = 3.0f;
    g_shared->aimbotBone = 6;
    g_shared->aimbotTeamCheck = true;
    g_shared->espEnemyColor[0]=255;g_shared->espEnemyColor[1]=50;g_shared->espEnemyColor[2]=50;g_shared->espEnemyColor[3]=255;
    g_shared->espTeamColor[0]=50;g_shared->espTeamColor[1]=255;g_shared->espTeamColor[2]=50;g_shared->espTeamColor[3]=255;
    g_shared->screenW = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
    g_shared->screenH = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Bhop — CONFIRMED WORKING
// ============================================================================
static void RunBhop() {
    if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000)) return;
    uintptr_t cl = Interfaces::clientBase;
    uintptr_t pawn = R<uintptr_t>(cl + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!pawn) return;
    int flags = R<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_fFlags);
    if (flags & 1) W<int>(cl + Offsets::dwForceJump, 65537);
    else W<int>(cl + Offsets::dwForceJump, 256);
}

// ============================================================================
// NoFlash
// ============================================================================
static void RunNoFlash() {
    uintptr_t cl = Interfaces::clientBase;
    uintptr_t pawn = R<uintptr_t>(cl + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (pawn) W<float>(pawn + Offsets::m_flFlashMaxAlpha, 0.f);
}

// ============================================================================
// Mouse Aimbot — uses SendInput (simulates real mouse, not memory write)
// Entity traversal matches reference code EXACTLY
// ============================================================================
static void MoveMouseRelative(int x, int y) {
    INPUT input = {};
    input.type = INPUT_MOUSE;
    input.mi.dwFlags = MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE;
    input.mi.dx = x;
    input.mi.dy = y;
    SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(INPUT));
}

struct Vec3 { float x,y,z; };
struct Mat4 { float m[4][4]; };

static bool W2S(Vec3 pos, float& sx, float& sy, Mat4& vm, float sw, float sh) {
    float w = pos.x*vm.m[3][0] + pos.y*vm.m[3][1] + pos.z*vm.m[3][2] + vm.m[3][3];
    if (w < 0.01f) return false;
    float nx = (pos.x*vm.m[0][0] + pos.y*vm.m[0][1] + pos.z*vm.m[0][2] + vm.m[0][3]) / w;
    float ny = (pos.x*vm.m[1][0] + pos.y*vm.m[1][1] + pos.z*vm.m[1][2] + vm.m[1][3]) / w;
    sx = sw/2 + nx*sw/2;
    sy = sh/2 - ny*sh/2;
    return true;
}

static void RunAimbot() {
    if (!g_shared || !g_shared->aimbotEnabled) return;
    if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000)) return; // Aim on left click (like reference)

    uintptr_t cl = Interfaces::clientBase;
    if (!cl) return;

    float screenW = (float)g_shared->screenW;
    float screenH = (float)g_shared->screenH;
    float centerX = screenW / 2.0f;
    float centerY = screenH / 2.0f;

    Mat4 viewMatrix = R<Mat4>(cl + Offsets::dwViewMatrix);
    uintptr_t entityList = R<uintptr_t>(cl + Offsets::dwEntityList);
    uintptr_t localPawn = R<uintptr_t>(cl + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!entityList || !localPawn) return;

    int localTeam = R<int>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);

    float fovRadius = g_shared->aimbotFov;
    float closestDist = fovRadius;
    float bestX = 0, bestY = 0;
    bool found = false;

    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        // Entity traversal — MATCHES REFERENCE CODE EXACTLY
        uintptr_t listEntry = R<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8 * ((i & 0x7FFF) >> 9)) + 16);
        if (!listEntry) continue;

        uintptr_t controller = R<uintptr_t>(listEntry + 120 * (i & 0x1FF));
        if (!controller) continue;

        uint32_t pawnHandle = R<uint32_t>(controller + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
        if (!pawnHandle) continue;

        uintptr_t listEntry2 = R<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8 * ((pawnHandle & 0x7FFF) >> 9)) + 16);
        if (!listEntry2) continue;

        uintptr_t pawn = R<uintptr_t>(listEntry2 + 120 * (pawnHandle & 0x1FF));
        if (!pawn || pawn == localPawn) continue;

        int team = R<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
        if (g_shared->aimbotTeamCheck && team == localTeam) continue;

        int hp = R<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iHealth);
        if (hp <= 0) continue;

        // Position — use m_vOldOrigin like reference
        Vec3 pos = R<Vec3>(pawn + Offsets::m_vecOldOrigin);
        pos.z += 50.0f; // Head offset

        float sx, sy;
        if (W2S(pos, sx, sy, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH)) {
            float dx = sx - centerX;
            float dy = sy - centerY;
            float dist = sqrtf(dx*dx + dy*dy);

            if (dist < closestDist) {
                closestDist = dist;
                bestX = dx;
                bestY = dy;
                found = true;
            }
        }
    }

    if (found) {
        float sm = g_shared->aimbotSmooth;
        if (sm > 0.0f) { bestX /= sm; bestY /= sm; }
        MoveMouseRelative((int)bestX, (int)bestY);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Thread
// ============================================================================
static DWORD WINAPI MainThread(LPVOID) {
    Log("[Nexus] v6.0 Thread started");
    while (!GetModuleHandleA("client.dll")) Sleep(200);
    Sleep(8000);

    Interfaces::Initialize();
    Schema::Initialize();
    OffsetManager::Initialize();
    ConfigManager::Get().Initialize();
    CreateSharedMem();

    if (g_shared) {
        g_shared->cs2Pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
        g_shared->clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        g_shared->engineBase = Interfaces::engineBase;
    }

    Log("[Nexus] === v6.0 ACTIVE ===");
    Log("[Nexus] Mouse aimbot (LEFT CLICK), bhop (SPACE), entity list FIXED");

    while (g_running) {
        if (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_END) & 1) { g_running = false; break; }

        __try {
            if (g_shared) {
                auto& c = ConfigManager::Get();
                c.Aimbot().enabled = g_shared->aimbotEnabled;
                c.Misc().bhop = g_shared->bhop;
                c.Misc().noflash = g_shared->noflash;

                if (c.Aimbot().enabled) RunAimbot();
                if (c.Misc().bhop) RunBhop();
                if (c.Misc().noflash) RunNoFlash();
            }
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            Sleep(100);
        }

        Sleep(1);
    }

    if (g_shared) { g_shared->connected = false; UnmapViewOfFile(g_shared); }
    if (g_hMapFile) CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
    Log("[Nexus] Done");
    return 0;
}

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE hModule, DWORD reason, LPVOID) {
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hModule);
        Log("[Nexus] DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH v6.0");
        HANDLE h = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, MainThread, hModule, 0, nullptr);
        if (h) { CloseHandle(h); Log("[Nexus] Thread OK"); }
    }
    return TRUE;
}
```

`Cheat/src/features/aimbot/aimbot.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "aimbot.h"
#include "smoothing.h"
#include "rcs.h"
#include "triggerbot.h"
#include "prediction.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../sdk/bones.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../config/config.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

// ============================================================================
// Aimbot — target selection, angle calculation, aim loop
// ============================================================================

namespace Aimbot {

    // ========================================================================
    // Memory read helpers (internal — direct memory access since we're injected)
    // ========================================================================
    template<typename T>
    static T ReadMem(uintptr_t addr) {
        if (!addr) return T{};
        __try {
            return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr);
        }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            return T{};
        }
    }

    template<typename T>
    static void WriteMem(uintptr_t addr, const T& value) {
        if (!addr) return;
        __try {
            *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr) = value;
        }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {}
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Entity helpers
    // ========================================================================
    struct PlayerData {
        uintptr_t controller;
        uintptr_t pawn;
        Vector3   position;
        Vector3   headPos;
        int       health;
        int       team;
        bool      alive;
        bool      dormant;
        float     distance;
    };

    static uintptr_t GetEntityByIndex(int index) {
        uintptr_t entityList = Interfaces::clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList;
        uintptr_t listEntry  = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(entityList);
        if (!listEntry) return 0;

        // Chunk: index / 512, offset within chunk: (index % 512) * 0x78
        int chunkIndex = index / 512;
        int indexInChunk = index % 512;

        uintptr_t chunk = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(listEntry + (chunkIndex + 1) * 0x8);
        if (!chunk) return 0;

        return ReadMem<uintptr_t>(chunk + indexInChunk * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE);
    }

    static uintptr_t GetPawnFromController(uintptr_t controller) {
        uint32_t pawnHandle = ReadMem<uint32_t>(controller + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
        if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return 0;

        int entryIndex = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
        return GetEntityByIndex(entryIndex);
    }

    static Vector3 GetBonePosition(uintptr_t pawn, BoneId bone) {
        uintptr_t sceneNode = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
        if (!sceneNode) return {};

        uintptr_t boneArray = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(
            sceneNode + Offsets::m_modelState + Offsets::m_boneArray
        );
        if (!boneArray) return {};

        // Each bone is a Matrix3x4 (48 bytes = 12 floats)
        int boneIndex = static_cast<int>(bone);
        Matrix3x4 boneMat = ReadMem<Matrix3x4>(boneArray + boneIndex * sizeof(Matrix3x4));

        return boneMat.Origin();
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // GetLocalPlayer — get local player pawn
    // ========================================================================
    static uintptr_t GetLocalController() {
        return ReadMem<uintptr_t>(Interfaces::clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
    }

    static uintptr_t GetLocalPawn() {
        uintptr_t controller = GetLocalController();
        if (!controller) return 0;
        return GetPawnFromController(controller);
    }

    static Vector3 GetLocalEyePos(uintptr_t pawn) {
        uintptr_t sceneNode = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
        if (!sceneNode) return {};

        Vector3 origin = ReadMem<Vector3>(sceneNode + Offsets::m_vecAbsOrigin);
        Vector3 viewOffset = ReadMem<Vector3>(pawn + Offsets::m_vecViewOffset);

        return origin + viewOffset;
    }

    static QAngle GetViewAngles() {
        return ReadMem<QAngle>(Interfaces::clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles);
    }

    static void SetViewAngles(const QAngle& angles) {
        WriteMem<QAngle>(Interfaces::clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles, angles);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // GatherPlayers — collect valid enemy player data
    // ========================================================================
    static std::vector<PlayerData> GatherPlayers(uintptr_t localPawn, int localTeam) {
        std::vector<PlayerData> players;
        players.reserve(64);

        Vector3 localEyePos = GetLocalEyePos(localPawn);

        for (int i = 1; i <= 64; i++) {
            uintptr_t controller = GetEntityByIndex(i);
            if (!controller) continue;

            // Check alive
            bool isAlive = ReadMem<bool>(controller + Offsets::m_bPawnIsAlive);
            if (!isAlive) continue;

            // Get pawn
            uintptr_t pawn = GetPawnFromController(controller);
            if (!pawn || pawn == localPawn) continue;

            // Team check
            int team = ReadMem<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
            if (team == localTeam) continue; // Skip teammates

            // Health
            int health = ReadMem<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iHealth);
            if (health <= 0) continue;

            // Position
            uintptr_t sceneNode = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
            if (!sceneNode) continue;
            Vector3 pos = ReadMem<Vector3>(sceneNode + Offsets::m_vecAbsOrigin);

            // Head position
            Vector3 headPos = GetBonePosition(pawn, BoneId::HEAD);
            if (headPos.IsZero()) {
                headPos = pos;
                headPos.z += 72.f; // Approximate head height
            }

            PlayerData data;
            data.controller = controller;
            data.pawn       = pawn;
            data.position   = pos;
            data.headPos    = headPos;
            data.health     = health;
            data.team       = team;
            data.alive      = true;
            data.dormant    = false;
            data.distance   = localEyePos.DistTo(pos);

            players.push_back(data);
        }

        return players;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // SelectTarget — find the best target based on FOV
    // ========================================================================
    struct AimTarget {
        PlayerData* player = nullptr;
        Vector3     aimPoint;
        float       fov = 999.f;
        bool        visible = false;
    };

    static AimTarget SelectTarget(std::vector<PlayerData>& players,
                                   const Vector3& eyePos,
                                   const QAngle& viewAngles,
                                   const AimbotConfig& cfg) {
        AimTarget best;
        BoneId targetBone = static_cast<BoneId>(cfg.bone);

        for (auto& player : players) {
            // Get bone position for aiming
            Vector3 bonePos = GetBonePosition(player.pawn, targetBone);
            if (bonePos.IsZero()) {
                bonePos = player.headPos; // Fallback to head
            }

            // Apply prediction if enabled
            if (cfg.prediction) {
                Vector3 velocity = ReadMem<Vector3>(player.pawn + Offsets::m_vecAbsVelocity);
                bonePos = Prediction::PredictPosition(bonePos, velocity, eyePos);
            }

            // Calculate angle and FOV
            QAngle aimAngle = Math::CalcAngle(eyePos, bonePos);
            float fov = Math::GetFov(viewAngles, aimAngle);

            // FOV filter
            if (fov > cfg.fov) continue;

            // TODO: visibility check (trace ray)
            // For now, assume visible — proper vis check requires engine trace

            // Best target = lowest FOV, prefer visible
            if (fov < best.fov) {
                best.player   = &player;
                best.aimPoint = bonePos;
                best.fov      = fov;
                best.visible  = true; // placeholder
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Initialize / Shutdown
    // ========================================================================
    void Initialize() {
        Smoothing::Initialize();
        RCS::Initialize();
        Triggerbot::Initialize();
        Prediction::Initialize();
        printf("[CS2] Aimbot initialized\n");
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        printf("[CS2] Aimbot shutdown\n");
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Run — main aimbot tick (called from main loop)
    // ========================================================================
    void Run() {
        auto& cfg = ConfigManager::Get().Aimbot();
        if (!cfg.enabled) return;

        // Check aimbot key
        if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(cfg.key) & 0x8000))
            return;

        // Get local player
        uintptr_t localPawn = GetLocalPawn();
        if (!localPawn) return;

        int localTeam = ReadMem<int>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
        int localHealth = ReadMem<int>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iHealth);
        if (localHealth <= 0) return;

        Vector3 eyePos = GetLocalEyePos(localPawn);
        QAngle viewAngles = GetViewAngles();

        // Gather enemies
        auto players = GatherPlayers(localPawn, localTeam);
        if (players.empty()) return;

        // Select best target
        AimTarget target = SelectTarget(players, eyePos, viewAngles, cfg);
        if (!target.player) return;

        // Calculate aim angle
        QAngle aimAngle = Math::CalcAngle(eyePos, target.aimPoint);

        // Apply RCS compensation
        // CS2 2024+: punch angle lives inside CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices
        // Access: pawn -> m_pAimPunchServices -> m_predictableBaseAngle (m_aimPunchAngle)
        if (cfg.rcs) {
            uintptr_t aimPunchSvc = ReadMem<uintptr_t>(localPawn + Offsets::m_pAimPunchServices);
            QAngle punchAngle = {};
            if (aimPunchSvc) {
                punchAngle = ReadMem<QAngle>(aimPunchSvc + Offsets::m_aimPunchAngle);
            }
            aimAngle = RCS::Compensate(aimAngle, punchAngle, cfg.rcsAmount);
        }

        aimAngle.Normalize();

        // Apply smoothing
        QAngle smoothedAngle;
        switch (cfg.smoothType) {
            case 0: // Linear
                smoothedAngle = Smoothing::Linear(viewAngles, aimAngle, cfg.smooth);
                break;
            case 1: // Bezier
                smoothedAngle = Smoothing::Bezier(viewAngles, aimAngle, cfg.smooth);
                break;
            case 2: // Humanized
            default:
                smoothedAngle = Smoothing::Humanized(viewAngles, aimAngle, cfg.smooth);
                break;
        }

        smoothedAngle.Normalize();

        // Set view angles
        SetViewAngles(smoothedAngle);

        // Run triggerbot if enabled
        if (cfg.triggerbot.enabled) {
            Triggerbot::Run(localPawn);
        }
    }

} // namespace Aimbot
```

`Cheat/src/features/aimbot/prediction.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "prediction.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include <cmath>

// ============================================================================
// Target prediction — extrapolate enemy position based on velocity
// ============================================================================

namespace Prediction {

    // Average bullet travel time estimation (simplified)
    // Real implementation would use weapon-specific data
    static constexpr float TICK_RATE = 64.f;     // CS2 tickrate
    static constexpr float TICK_INTERVAL = 1.f / TICK_RATE;

    void Initialize() {
        // Nothing to init for now
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // PredictPosition — linear velocity extrapolation
    // Returns the predicted position of the target
    // ========================================================================
    Vector3 PredictPosition(const Vector3& targetPos, const Vector3& velocity,
                             const Vector3& eyePos) {
        // Skip if target is stationary
        if (velocity.LengthSqr() < 1.f)
            return targetPos;

        // Estimate bullet travel time based on distance
        // Most CS2 weapons are hitscan (instant), but we account for latency
        float distance = eyePos.DistTo(targetPos);

        // Predict ~2-3 ticks ahead to compensate for network latency
        // This is a rough estimation — real prediction would use interp amount
        float predictionTicks = 2.5f;
        float predictionTime  = predictionTicks * TICK_INTERVAL;

        // Scale prediction with distance (more prediction at range)
        float distanceFactor = Math::Clamp(distance / 2000.f, 0.5f, 2.0f);
        predictionTime *= distanceFactor;

        // Linear extrapolation: pos + vel * time
        Vector3 predicted;
        predicted.x = targetPos.x + velocity.x * predictionTime;
        predicted.y = targetPos.y + velocity.y * predictionTime;
        predicted.z = targetPos.z + velocity.z * predictionTime;

        return predicted;
    }

} // namespace Prediction
```

`Cheat/src/features/aimbot/rcs.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "rcs.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// Recoil Control System — compensate for weapon recoil
// CS2 stores punch angles in m_aimPunchAngle, applied at 2x scale
// ============================================================================

namespace RCS {

    static QAngle g_lastPunchAngle = {};

    void Initialize() {
        g_lastPunchAngle = {};
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Compensate — subtract recoil from aim angle
    // amount = 0-100 (percentage of recoil to compensate)
    // ========================================================================
    QAngle Compensate(const QAngle& aimAngle, const QAngle& punchAngle, float amount) {
        float scale = (amount / 100.f) * 2.0f; // CS2 applies punch at 2x

        QAngle compensated;
        compensated.pitch = aimAngle.pitch - punchAngle.pitch * scale;
        compensated.yaw   = aimAngle.yaw   - punchAngle.yaw   * scale;
        compensated.roll  = 0.f;

        compensated.Normalize();
        return compensated;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Standalone — RCS without aimbot (just counter recoil on current aim)
    // Called when aimbot is off but RCS is enabled
    // ========================================================================
    void Standalone(uintptr_t localPawn) {
        if (!localPawn) return;

        // CS2 2024+: punch angle is in CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices
        uintptr_t aimPunchSvc = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(localPawn + Offsets::m_pAimPunchServices);
        if (!aimPunchSvc) return;
        QAngle punchAngle = *reinterpret_cast<QAngle*>(aimPunchSvc + Offsets::m_aimPunchAngle);

        // Only compensate if shooting (punch angle is non-zero)
        if (punchAngle.IsZero()) {
            g_lastPunchAngle = {};
            return;
        }

        // Calculate the delta since last frame
        QAngle delta;
        delta.pitch = punchAngle.pitch - g_lastPunchAngle.pitch;
        delta.yaw   = punchAngle.yaw   - g_lastPunchAngle.yaw;
        delta.roll  = 0.f;

        g_lastPunchAngle = punchAngle;

        // If delta is too small, skip
        if (std::abs(delta.pitch) < 0.01f && std::abs(delta.yaw) < 0.01f)
            return;

        // Read current view angles
        uintptr_t clientBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(GetModuleHandleA("client.dll"));
        QAngle viewAngles = *reinterpret_cast<QAngle*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles);

        // Subtract the punch delta (scaled by 2x as CS2 applies it)
        viewAngles.pitch -= delta.pitch * 2.0f;
        viewAngles.yaw   -= delta.yaw   * 2.0f;
        viewAngles.Normalize();

        // Write back
        *reinterpret_cast<QAngle*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles) = viewAngles;
    }

} // namespace RCS

```

`Cheat/src/features/aimbot/smoothing.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "smoothing.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>

// ============================================================================
// Aim smoothing algorithms — make aim movement look human
// ============================================================================

namespace Smoothing {

    static bool g_seeded = false;

    void Initialize() {
        if (!g_seeded) {
            srand(static_cast<unsigned>(time(nullptr)));
            g_seeded = true;
        }
    }

    // Random float in range [min, max]
    static float RandFloat(float min, float max) {
        float r = static_cast<float>(rand()) / static_cast<float>(RAND_MAX);
        return min + r * (max - min);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Linear smoothing — constant speed approach
    // factor = 1.0 = instant, higher = slower
    // ========================================================================
    QAngle Linear(const QAngle& current, const QAngle& target, float factor) {
        if (factor <= 1.0f)
            return target;

        return Math::SmoothAngle(current, target, factor);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Bezier curve smoothing — non-linear path with randomized control points
    // Creates a more natural arc movement
    // ========================================================================
    QAngle Bezier(const QAngle& current, const QAngle& target, float factor) {
        if (factor <= 1.0f)
            return target;

        QAngle delta = Math::AngleDelta(target, current);
        float dist = std::sqrt(delta.pitch * delta.pitch + delta.yaw * delta.yaw);

        if (dist < 0.1f)
            return target;

        // Interpolation parameter — how far along the curve we are this frame
        float t = 1.0f / factor;

        // Generate control points with slight randomization
        // Control points deviate from the straight line to create an arc
        float deviation = dist * 0.15f; // 15% of total distance

        QAngle cp1 = current;
        cp1.pitch += delta.pitch * 0.33f + RandFloat(-deviation, deviation);
        cp1.yaw   += delta.yaw   * 0.33f + RandFloat(-deviation, deviation);

        QAngle cp2 = current;
        cp2.pitch += delta.pitch * 0.66f + RandFloat(-deviation, deviation);
        cp2.yaw   += delta.yaw   * 0.66f + RandFloat(-deviation, deviation);

        return Math::BezierInterpolate(current, cp1, cp2, target, t);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Humanized smoothing — most realistic
    // Combines: variable speed, micro-jitter, overshoot, acceleration
    // ========================================================================
    QAngle Humanized(const QAngle& current, const QAngle& target, float factor) {
        if (factor <= 1.0f)
            return target;

        QAngle delta = Math::AngleDelta(target, current);
        float dist = std::sqrt(delta.pitch * delta.pitch + delta.yaw * delta.yaw);

        if (dist < 0.05f)
            return target;

        // Speed varies based on distance — fast when far, slow when close
        // This mimics how humans move a mouse (ballistic phase + correction phase)
        float speedMultiplier;
        if (dist > 10.f) {
            // Ballistic phase — fast approach
            speedMultiplier = 1.0f / (factor * 0.5f);
        } else if (dist > 3.f) {
            // Deceleration phase
            speedMultiplier = 1.0f / factor;
        } else {
            // Correction phase — slow, precise
            speedMultiplier = 1.0f / (factor * 1.8f);
        }

        speedMultiplier = Math::Clamp(speedMultiplier, 0.01f, 1.0f);

        QAngle result;
        result.pitch = current.pitch + delta.pitch * speedMultiplier;
        result.yaw   = current.yaw   + delta.yaw   * speedMultiplier;
        result.roll  = 0.f;

        // Add micro-jitter (simulates human hand tremor)
        // Scale jitter with distance — more jitter when far, less when close
        float jitterScale = Math::Clamp(dist * 0.01f, 0.005f, 0.15f);
        result.pitch += RandFloat(-jitterScale, jitterScale);
        result.yaw   += RandFloat(-jitterScale, jitterScale);

        // Occasional tiny overshoot (5% chance per tick)
        if (dist < 2.f && (rand() % 20) == 0) {
            float overshoot = RandFloat(0.05f, 0.2f);
            result.pitch += delta.pitch * overshoot;
            result.yaw   += delta.yaw   * overshoot;
        }

        result.Normalize();
        return result;
    }

} // namespace Smoothing

```

`Cheat/src/features/aimbot/triggerbot.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "triggerbot.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../config/config.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>

// ============================================================================
// Triggerbot — auto-fire when crosshair is on enemy
// Uses m_iIDEntTarget (entity ID under crosshair)
// ============================================================================

namespace Triggerbot {

    static std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_lastShotTime;
    static int  g_pendingDelay = 0;
    static bool g_delayActive  = false;

    void Initialize() {
        g_pendingDelay = 0;
        g_delayActive  = false;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Run — check crosshair target and fire
    // ========================================================================
    void Run(uintptr_t localPawn) {
        if (!localPawn) return;

        auto& cfg = ConfigManager::Get().Aimbot().triggerbot;
        if (!cfg.enabled) return;

        // Read entity under crosshair
        int entIndex = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iIDEntTarget);

        if (entIndex <= 0 || entIndex > 64) {
            g_delayActive = false;
            return;
        }

        // Get the target entity
        uintptr_t entityList = Interfaces::clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList;
        uintptr_t listEntry  = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(entityList);
        if (!listEntry) return;

        int chunkIndex = entIndex / 512;
        int indexInChunk = entIndex % 512;

        uintptr_t chunk = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(listEntry + (chunkIndex + 1) * 0x8);
        if (!chunk) return;

        uintptr_t targetEntity = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            chunk + indexInChunk * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
        );
        if (!targetEntity) return;

        // Team check — only fire on enemies
        int localTeam  = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
        int targetTeam = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(targetEntity + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
        if (targetTeam == localTeam) return;

        // Health check
        int targetHealth = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(targetEntity + Offsets::m_iHealth);
        if (targetHealth <= 0) return;

        // Start delay timer if not active
        if (!g_delayActive) {
            g_delayActive = true;
            g_pendingDelay = cfg.delayMinMs +
                (rand() % (cfg.delayMaxMs - cfg.delayMinMs + 1));
            g_lastShotTime = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            return;
        }

        // Check if delay has elapsed
        auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            now - g_lastShotTime
        ).count();

        if (elapsed < g_pendingDelay)
            return;

        // Fire! Simulate mouse click
        INPUT input = {};
        input.type = INPUT_MOUSE;
        input.mi.dwFlags = MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN;
        SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(INPUT));

        Sleep(5 + (rand() % 10)); // Hold click briefly

        input.mi.dwFlags = MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP;
        SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(INPUT));

        // Reset delay for next shot
        g_delayActive = false;
    }

} // namespace Triggerbot

```

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// ESP — orchestrates all ESP rendering
// Called from the overlay render thread each frame
// ============================================================================

namespace Esp {

    void Initialize() {
        printf("[CS2] ESP initialized\n");
    }

    void Render() {
        auto& cfg = ConfigManager::Get().Esp();
        if (!cfg.enabled) return;

        // Render player ESP
        PlayerEsp::Render(cfg);

        // Render world ESP (bomb, weapons)
        if (cfg.bombInfo || cfg.droppedWeapons) {
            WorldEsp::Render(cfg);
        }
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        printf("[CS2] ESP shutdown\n");
    }

} // namespace Esp
```
