`Cheat/src/features/esp/player_esp.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "player_esp.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../sdk/bones.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../render/renderer.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

// ============================================================================
// Player ESP — boxes, health bars, names, skeleton, snaplines
// ============================================================================

namespace PlayerEsp {

    // Memory read helper
    template<typename T>
    static T Read(uintptr_t addr) {
        if (!addr) return T{};
        __try {
            return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr);
        }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            return T{};
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // DrawCornerBox — draw corner-style box (L-shaped corners)
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawCornerBox(float x, float y, float w, float h,
                               const Color& color, float thickness) {
        float cornerLen = h * 0.2f; // Corner length = 20% of height
        if (cornerLen < 4.f) cornerLen = 4.f;

        // Top-left
        Renderer::DrawLine(x, y, x + cornerLen, y, color, thickness);
        Renderer::DrawLine(x, y, x, y + cornerLen, color, thickness);

        // Top-right
        Renderer::DrawLine(x + w, y, x + w - cornerLen, y, color, thickness);
        Renderer::DrawLine(x + w, y, x + w, y + cornerLen, color, thickness);

        // Bottom-left
        Renderer::DrawLine(x, y + h, x + cornerLen, y + h, color, thickness);
        Renderer::DrawLine(x, y + h, x, y + h - cornerLen, color, thickness);

        // Bottom-right
        Renderer::DrawLine(x + w, y + h, x + w - cornerLen, y + h, color, thickness);
        Renderer::DrawLine(x + w, y + h, x + w, y + h - cornerLen, color, thickness);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // DrawHealthBar — vertical bar on the left side of the box
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawHealthBar(float x, float y, float h, int health) {
        float barW = 3.f;
        float barX = x - barW - 3.f;

        // Background (dark)
        Renderer::DrawFilledRect(barX - 1, y - 1, barW + 2, h + 2, Color(0, 0, 0, 180));

        // Health fill (bottom to top)
        float healthFrac = static_cast<float>(health) / 100.f;
        float fillH = h * healthFrac;
        float fillY = y + h - fillH;

        // Color: green at 100, yellow at 50, red at 0
        Color barColor;
        if (healthFrac > 0.5f) {
            barColor = Color::Lerp(Color::Yellow(), Color::Green(), (healthFrac - 0.5f) * 2.f);
        } else {
            barColor = Color::Lerp(Color::Red(), Color::Yellow(), healthFrac * 2.f);
        }

        Renderer::DrawFilledRect(barX, fillY, barW, fillH, barColor);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // DrawArmorBar — vertical bar on the right side
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawArmorBar(float x, float y, float w, float h, int armor) {
        if (armor <= 0) return;

        float barW = 3.f;
        float barX = x + w + 3.f;

        Renderer::DrawFilledRect(barX - 1, y - 1, barW + 2, h + 2, Color(0, 0, 0, 180));

        float armorFrac = static_cast<float>(armor) / 100.f;
        float fillH = h * armorFrac;
        float fillY = y + h - fillH;

        Renderer::DrawFilledRect(barX, fillY, barW, fillH, Color(50, 100, 255, 255));
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // DrawSkeleton — bone-to-bone lines
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawSkeleton(uintptr_t pawn, const VMatrix& viewMatrix,
                              int screenW, int screenH, const Color& color) {
        for (int i = 0; i < SKELETON_CONNECTION_COUNT; i++) {
            const auto& conn = SKELETON_CONNECTIONS[i];

            // Get bone positions
            uintptr_t sceneNode = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
            if (!sceneNode) return;

            uintptr_t boneArray = Read<uintptr_t>(
                sceneNode + Offsets::m_modelState + Offsets::m_boneArray
            );
            if (!boneArray) return;

            Matrix3x4 fromMat = Read<Matrix3x4>(
                boneArray + static_cast<int>(conn.from) * sizeof(Matrix3x4)
            );
            Matrix3x4 toMat = Read<Matrix3x4>(
                boneArray + static_cast<int>(conn.to) * sizeof(Matrix3x4)
            );

            Vector3 fromPos = fromMat.Origin();
            Vector3 toPos   = toMat.Origin();

            if (fromPos.IsZero() || toPos.IsZero()) continue;

            Vector2 fromScreen, toScreen;
            if (Math::WorldToScreen(fromPos, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH, fromScreen) &&
                Math::WorldToScreen(toPos, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH, toScreen)) {
                Renderer::DrawLine(fromScreen.x, fromScreen.y,
                                   toScreen.x, toScreen.y, color, 1.5f);
            }
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Render — main player ESP rendering
    // ========================================================================
    void Render(const EspConfig& cfg) {
        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!clientBase) return;

        // Get view matrix
        VMatrix viewMatrix = Read<VMatrix>(clientBase + Offsets::dwViewMatrix);

        // Get local player info
        uintptr_t localController = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
        if (!localController) return;

        uint32_t localPawnHandle = Read<uint32_t>(localController + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
        int localTeam = 0;

        // Get local pawn for team check
        if (localPawnHandle != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
            uintptr_t entityList = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
            if (entityList) {
                int idx = localPawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
                uintptr_t chunk = Read<uintptr_t>(
                    Read<uintptr_t>(entityList) + (idx / 512 + 1) * 0x8
                );
                if (chunk) {
                    uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(
                        chunk + (idx % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
                    );
                    if (localPawn) {
                        localTeam = Read<int>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Screen dimensions
        int screenW = Renderer::GetWidth();
        int screenH = Renderer::GetHeight();

        // Iterate all player slots (1-64)
        uintptr_t entityList = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
        if (!entityList) return;
        uintptr_t listBase = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList);
        if (!listBase) return;

        for (int i = 1; i <= 64; i++) {
            // Get controller
            int chunkIdx = i / 512;
            int idxInChunk = i % 512;

            uintptr_t chunk = Read<uintptr_t>(listBase + (chunkIdx + 1) * 0x8);
            if (!chunk) continue;

            uintptr_t controller = Read<uintptr_t>(
                chunk + idxInChunk * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
            );
            if (!controller || controller == localController) continue;

            // Alive check
            bool alive = Read<bool>(controller + Offsets::m_bPawnIsAlive);
            if (!alive) continue;

            // Get pawn
            uint32_t pawnHandle = Read<uint32_t>(controller + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
            if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;

            int pawnIdx = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
            uintptr_t pawnChunk = Read<uintptr_t>(listBase + (pawnIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
            if (!pawnChunk) continue;

            uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(
                pawnChunk + (pawnIdx % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
            );
            if (!pawn) continue;

            // Get team, health
            int team   = Read<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
            int health = Read<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_iHealth);
            if (health <= 0) continue;

            bool isEnemy = (team != localTeam);

            // Get position
            uintptr_t sceneNode = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
            if (!sceneNode) continue;
            Vector3 origin = Read<Vector3>(sceneNode + Offsets::m_vecAbsOrigin);

            // Head position (bone or estimated)
            Vector3 headPos = origin;
            headPos.z += 75.f; // Head height above origin

            // Try bone-based head
            uintptr_t boneArray = Read<uintptr_t>(
                sceneNode + Offsets::m_modelState + Offsets::m_boneArray
            );
            if (boneArray) {
                Matrix3x4 headMat = Read<Matrix3x4>(
                    boneArray + static_cast<int>(BoneId::HEAD) * sizeof(Matrix3x4)
                );
                Vector3 boneHead = headMat.Origin();
                if (!boneHead.IsZero()) {
                    headPos = boneHead;
                    headPos.z += 8.f; // Slight offset above head bone
                }
            }

            // World to screen
            Vector2 headScreen, feetScreen;
            if (!Math::WorldToScreen(headPos, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH, headScreen))
                continue;
            if (!Math::WorldToScreen(origin, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH, feetScreen))
                continue;

            // Calculate bounding box
            Math::BBox box = Math::CalcPlayerBBox(headScreen, feetScreen);
            if (!box.valid) continue;

            // Choose color
            Color color = isEnemy ? cfg.enemyColor : cfg.teamColor;

            // ---- Draw ESP elements ----

            // Boxes
            if (cfg.boxes.enabled) {
                if (cfg.boxes.style == 1) {
                    DrawCornerBox(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h, color, cfg.boxes.thickness);
                } else {
                    Renderer::DrawRect(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h, color, cfg.boxes.thickness);
                }
            }

            // Health bar
            if (cfg.healthBar) {
                DrawHealthBar(box.x, box.y, box.h, health);
            }

            // Armor bar
            if (cfg.armorBar) {
                int armor = Read<int>(pawn + Offsets::m_ArmorValue);
                DrawArmorBar(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h, armor);
            }

            // Name
            if (cfg.name) {
                char name[128] = {};
                uintptr_t nameAddr = Read<uintptr_t>(controller + Offsets::m_sSanitizedPlayerName);
                if (nameAddr) {
                    memcpy(name, reinterpret_cast<void*>(nameAddr), 127);
                    name[127] = 0;
                }
                if (name[0]) {
                    float textX = box.x + box.w * 0.5f;
                    float textY = box.y - 14.f;
                    Renderer::DrawText(textX, textY, name, Color::White(), true);
                }
            }

            // Distance
            if (cfg.distance) {
                uintptr_t localPawnPtr = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
                if (localPawnPtr) {
                    uintptr_t localScene = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawnPtr + Offsets::m_pGameSceneNode);
                    if (localScene) {
                        Vector3 localOrigin = Read<Vector3>(localScene + Offsets::m_vecAbsOrigin);
                        float dist = localOrigin.DistTo(origin) * 0.0254f; // Units to meters

                        char distText[32];
                        snprintf(distText, sizeof(distText), "%.0fm", dist);
                        float textX = box.x + box.w * 0.5f;
                        float textY = box.y + box.h + 2.f;
                        Renderer::DrawText(textX, textY, distText, Color(200, 200, 200), true);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Weapon name — use weapon services -> active weapon handle
            if (cfg.weapon) {
                uintptr_t weaponSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pWeaponServices);
                uint32_t wepHandle = weaponSvc ? Read<uint32_t>(weaponSvc + Offsets::m_hActiveWeapon) : 0xFFFFFFFF;
                uintptr_t weaponPtr = 0;
                if (wepHandle != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
                    int wi = wepHandle & 0x7FFF;
                    uintptr_t wc = Read<uintptr_t>(listBase + (wi / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
                    if (wc) weaponPtr = Read<uintptr_t>(wc + (wi % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE);
                }
                if (weaponPtr) {
                    int defIndex = Read<short>(weaponPtr + Offsets::m_iItemDefinitionIndex);
                    const char* weaponName = GetWeaponName(defIndex);
                    float textX = box.x + box.w * 0.5f;
                    float textY = box.y + box.h + (cfg.distance ? 16.f : 2.f);
                    Renderer::DrawText(textX, textY, weaponName, Color(180, 180, 180), true);
                }
            }

            // Skeleton
            if (cfg.skeleton) {
                DrawSkeleton(pawn, viewMatrix, screenW, screenH, color);
            }

            // Head dot
            if (cfg.headDot) {
                Renderer::DrawFilledCircle(headScreen.x, headScreen.y, 3.f, color);
            }

            // Snaplines
            if (cfg.snaplines.enabled) {
                float startX = static_cast<float>(screenW) * 0.5f;
                float startY;
                switch (cfg.snaplines.position) {
                    case 0: startY = 0.f; break;                    // Top
                    case 1: startY = screenH * 0.5f; break;         // Center
                    default: startY = static_cast<float>(screenH); break; // Bottom
                }
                Renderer::DrawLine(startX, startY, feetScreen.x, feetScreen.y,
                                   Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 120), 1.f);
            }
        }
    }

} // namespace PlayerEsp
```

```h
                        }
```
```cpp
                    }
                }
            }
```

`Cheat/src/features/misc/autostrafe.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "misc.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../math/math.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cmath>

// ============================================================================
// Auto-strafe — optimal air strafing based on mouse movement
// When in air, automatically applies strafe keys based on yaw delta
// ============================================================================

namespace Misc {

    static QAngle g_lastViewAngles = {};

    void AutoStrafe() {
        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!clientBase) return;

        // Get local pawn
        uintptr_t localController = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController
        );
        if (!localController) return;

        uint32_t pawnHandle = *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(
            localController + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn
        );
        if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return;

        uintptr_t entityList = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
        if (!entityList) return;
        uintptr_t listBase = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(entityList);
        if (!listBase) return;

        int pawnIdx = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
        uintptr_t chunk = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            listBase + (pawnIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8
        );
        if (!chunk) return;

        uintptr_t localPawn = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            chunk + (pawnIdx % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
        );
        if (!localPawn) return;

        // Only strafe when in air
        int flags = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(localPawn + Offsets::m_fFlags);
        if (flags & PlayerFlags::FL_ONGROUND) {
            g_lastViewAngles = *reinterpret_cast<QAngle*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles);
            return;
        }

        // Get current view angles
        QAngle currentAngles = *reinterpret_cast<QAngle*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwViewAngles);

        // Calculate yaw delta since last frame
        float yawDelta = currentAngles.yaw - g_lastViewAngles.yaw;
        while (yawDelta > 180.f)  yawDelta -= 360.f;
        while (yawDelta < -180.f) yawDelta += 360.f;

        g_lastViewAngles = currentAngles;

        // Skip if not moving mouse significantly
        if (std::abs(yawDelta) < 0.5f)
            return;

        // Apply strafe in the direction of mouse movement
        // Moving mouse right → press D, moving left → press A
        if (yawDelta > 0.f) {
            // Turning right — strafe right (D key)
            INPUT input = {};
            input.type = INPUT_KEYBOARD;
            input.ki.wVk = 0x44; // D key
            input.ki.dwFlags = 0;
            SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(INPUT));
        } else {
            // Turning left — strafe left (A key)
            INPUT input = {};
            input.type = INPUT_KEYBOARD;
            input.ki.wVk = 0x41; // A key
            input.ki.dwFlags = 0;
            SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(INPUT));
        }
    }

} // namespace Misc

```

`Cheat/src/features/misc/bhop.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "misc.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include <Windows.h>

// ============================================================================
// Bunny Hop — simplified, uses dwLocalPlayerPawn directly
// ============================================================================

namespace Misc {

    void BunnyHop() {
        if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000))
            return;

        uintptr_t client = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!client) return;

        // Use dwLocalPlayerPawn directly — no entity list walking needed
        uintptr_t pawn = 0;
        __try { pawn = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(client + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerPawn); }
        __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { return; }
        if (!pawn) return;

        // Read flags
        int flags = 0;
        __try { flags = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(pawn + Offsets::m_fFlags); }
        __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { return; }

        // Write force jump — NO +0x30, write directly to the button address
        __try {
            if (flags & PlayerFlags::FL_ONGROUND)
                *reinterpret_cast<int*>(client + Offsets::dwForceJump) = 65537;
            else
                *reinterpret_cast<int*>(client + Offsets::dwForceJump) = 256;
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { }
    }

} // namespace Misc
```

```cpp
    void NoFlash() {

        if (!clientBase) return;

        uintptr_t localController = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController
        );

        uintptr_t entityList = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
```

`Cheat/src/features/misc/radar.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "misc.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include <cstdint>

// ============================================================================
// Radar hack — force all enemies visible on the in-game radar
// Writes m_bSpottedByMask on all enemy pawns
// ============================================================================

namespace Misc {

    void RadarHack() {
        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!clientBase) return;

        // Get local team
        uintptr_t localController = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController
        );
        if (!localController) return;

        uint32_t pawnHandle = *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(
            localController + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn
        );
        if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return;

        uintptr_t entityList = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
        if (!entityList) return;
        uintptr_t listBase = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(entityList);
        if (!listBase) return;

        // Get local pawn to determine team
        int localIdx = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
        uintptr_t localChunk = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            listBase + (localIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8
        );
        if (!localChunk) return;

        uintptr_t localPawn = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
            localChunk + (localIdx % 512) * 0x78
        );
        if (!localPawn) return;
        int localTeam = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(localPawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);

        // Iterate all players and set spotted flag
        for (int i = 1; i <= 64; i++) {
            int chunkIdx = i / 512;
            int idxInChunk = i % 512;

            uintptr_t chunk = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
                listBase + (chunkIdx + 1) * 0x8
            );
            if (!chunk) continue;

            uintptr_t controller = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(
                chunk + idxInChunk * 0x78
            );
            if (!controller) continue;

            bool alive = *reinterpret_cast<bool*>(controller + Offsets::m_bPawnIsAlive);
            if (!alive) continue;

            uint32_t ph = *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(controller + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
            if (ph == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;

            int pi = ph & 0x7FFF;
            uintptr_t pc = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(listBase + (pi / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
            if (!pc) continue;

            uintptr_t pawn = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(pc + (pi % 512) * 0x78);
            if (!pawn || pawn == localPawn) continue;

            int team = *reinterpret_cast<int*>(pawn + Offsets::m_iTeamNum);
            if (team == localTeam) continue;

            // Set spotted flag — forces enemy to appear on radar
            *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(pawn + Offsets::m_bSpottedByMask) = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        }
    }

} // namespace Misc
```

`Cheat/src/features/misc/spectators.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "misc.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../render/renderer.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>

// ============================================================================
// Spectator List — show who is watching you
// Checks m_hObserverTarget on all player pawns
// ============================================================================

namespace Misc {

    void Initialize() {
        printf("[CS2] Misc features initialized\n");
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        printf("[CS2] Misc features shutdown\n");
    }

    template<typename T>
    static T ReadM(uintptr_t addr) {
        if (!addr) return T{};
        __try { return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr); }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { return T{}; }
    }

    void SpectatorList() {
        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!clientBase) return;

        uintptr_t localController = ReadM<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
        if (!localController) return;

        uint32_t localPawnHandle = ReadM<uint32_t>(localController + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
        if (localPawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return;

        uintptr_t entityList = ReadM<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
        if (!entityList) return;
        uintptr_t listBase = ReadM<uintptr_t>(entityList);
        if (!listBase) return;

        std::vector<std::string> spectators;

        for (int i = 1; i <= 64; i++) {
            int chunkIdx = i / 512;
            int idxInChunk = i % 512;

            uintptr_t chunk = ReadM<uintptr_t>(listBase + (chunkIdx + 1) * 0x8);
            if (!chunk) continue;

            uintptr_t controller = ReadM<uintptr_t>(chunk + idxInChunk * 0x78);
            if (!controller || controller == localController) continue;

            // Get this player's pawn
            uint32_t pawnHandle = ReadM<uint32_t>(controller + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
            if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;

            int pawnIdx = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
            uintptr_t pawnChunk = ReadM<uintptr_t>(listBase + (pawnIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
            if (!pawnChunk) continue;

            uintptr_t pawn = ReadM<uintptr_t>(pawnChunk + (pawnIdx % 512) * 0x78);
            if (!pawn) continue;

            // Check observer services
            uintptr_t observerSvc = ReadM<uintptr_t>(pawn + Offsets::m_pObserverServices);
            if (!observerSvc) continue;

            // Get observer target handle
            uint32_t obsTarget = ReadM<uint32_t>(observerSvc + Offsets::m_hObserverTarget);
            if (obsTarget == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;

            // Check if they're observing us
            if (obsTarget == localPawnHandle) {
                // Get their name
                uintptr_t nameAddr = ReadM<uintptr_t>(controller + Offsets::m_sSanitizedPlayerName);
                if (nameAddr) {
                    char name[64] = {};
                    memcpy(name, reinterpret_cast<void*>(nameAddr), 63);
                    spectators.push_back(std::string(name));
                }
            }
        }

        // Render spectator list in top-right corner
        if (!spectators.empty()) {
            int screenW = Renderer::GetWidth();
            float x = screenW - 200.f;
            float y = 50.f;

            Renderer::DrawText(x, y, "Spectators:", Color::White(), false);
            y += 16.f;

            for (const auto& name : spectators) {
                Renderer::DrawText(x + 10.f, y, name.c_str(), Color::Yellow(), false);
                y += 14.f;
            }
        }
    }

} // namespace Misc
```

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Glove changer utilities — model lookup and validation

namespace GloveChanger {

    // Get glove info by definition index
    const GloveInfo* GetGloveInfo(int defIndex) {
        for (const auto& glove : GLOVES) {
            if (glove.defIndex == defIndex)
                return &glove;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    // Get glove name by definition index
    const char* GetGloveName(int defIndex) {
        const GloveInfo* info = GetGloveInfo(defIndex);
        return info ? info->name : "Unknown";
    }

    // Get all available gloves count
    int GetGloveCount() {
        return sizeof(GLOVES) / sizeof(GLOVES[0]);
    }

    // Validate a glove definition index
    bool IsValidGlove(int defIndex) {
        return GetGloveInfo(defIndex) != nullptr;
    }

} // namespace GloveChanger
```

`Cheat/src/features/skinchanger/skinchanger.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "skinchanger.h"
#include "../../sdk/entity.h"
#include "../../sdk/weapon.h"
#include "../../core/interfaces.h"
#include "../../config/config.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// Skin Changer — modify weapon skins, knife models, glove models in memory
// Writes paint kit, wear, seed to weapon entity fields
// ============================================================================

namespace SkinChanger {

    template<typename T>
    static T Read(uintptr_t addr) {
        if (!addr) return T{};
        __try { return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr); }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) { return T{}; }
    }

    template<typename T>
    static void Write(uintptr_t addr, const T& val) {
        if (!addr) return;
        __try { *reinterpret_cast<T*>(addr) = val; }
        __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {}
    }

    void Initialize() {
        printf("[CS2] Skin changer initialized\n");
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        printf("[CS2] Skin changer shutdown\n");
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // ApplyWeaponSkin — apply skin to a single weapon entity
    // ========================================================================
    static void ApplyWeaponSkin(uintptr_t weapon, int paintKit, float wear, int seed, int statTrak) {
        if (!weapon) return;

        // Set fallback paint kit
        Write<int>(weapon + Offsets::m_nFallbackPaintKit, paintKit);

        // Set wear (0.0 = factory new, 1.0 = battle-scarred)
        Write<float>(weapon + Offsets::m_flFallbackWear, wear);

        // Set pattern seed
        Write<int>(weapon + Offsets::m_nFallbackSeed, seed);

        // Set StatTrak counter (-1 = disabled)
        if (statTrak >= 0) {
            Write<int>(weapon + Offsets::m_nFallbackStatTrak, statTrak);
        }

        // Force item ID high to trigger fallback values
        // ItemIDHigh = -1 makes the game use fallback fields instead of inventory
        Write<int>(weapon + Offsets::m_iItemIDHigh, -1);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Run — main skin changer tick
    // ========================================================================
    void Run() {
        auto& cfg = ConfigManager::Get().Skins();
        if (!cfg.enabled) return;

        uintptr_t clientBase = Interfaces::clientBase;
        if (!clientBase) return;

        // Get local pawn
        uintptr_t localController = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwLocalPlayerController);
        if (!localController) return;

        uint32_t pawnHandle = Read<uint32_t>(localController + Offsets::m_hPlayerPawn);
        if (pawnHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return;

        uintptr_t entityList = Read<uintptr_t>(clientBase + Offsets::dwEntityList);
        if (!entityList) return;
        uintptr_t listBase = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList);
        if (!listBase) return;

        int pawnIdx = pawnHandle & 0x7FFF;
        uintptr_t pawnChunk = Read<uintptr_t>(listBase + (pawnIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
        if (!pawnChunk) return;

        uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(
            pawnChunk + (pawnIdx % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
        );
        if (!localPawn) return;

        // Get active weapon via weapon services
        uintptr_t weaponSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + Offsets::m_pWeaponServices);
        if (!weaponSvc) return;

        uint32_t weaponHandle = Read<uint32_t>(weaponSvc + Offsets::m_hActiveWeapon);
        if (weaponHandle == 0xFFFFFFFF) return;

        // Resolve weapon handle to entity
        int weaponIdx = weaponHandle & 0x7FFF;
        uintptr_t weaponChunk = Read<uintptr_t>(listBase + (weaponIdx / 512 + 1) * 0x8);
        if (!weaponChunk) return;

        uintptr_t activeWeapon = Read<uintptr_t>(
            weaponChunk + (weaponIdx % 512) * CGameEntitySystem::ENTITY_STRIDE
        );
        if (!activeWeapon) return;

        short defIndex = Read<short>(activeWeapon + Offsets::m_iItemDefinitionIndex);
        if (defIndex <= 0) return;

        // Check if we have a skin config for this weapon
        auto it = cfg.weapons.find(defIndex);
        if (it != cfg.weapons.end()) {
            const auto& skinCfg = it->second;
            ApplyWeaponSkin(activeWeapon, skinCfg.paintKit, skinCfg.wear,
                           skinCfg.seed, skinCfg.statTrak);
        }

        // Handle knife replacement
        if (defIndex == WeaponId::KNIFE_CT || defIndex == WeaponId::KNIFE_T) {
            // Change knife definition index to desired knife model
            Write<short>(activeWeapon + Offsets::m_iItemDefinitionIndex,
                        static_cast<short>(cfg.knife.model));

            // Apply knife skin
            ApplyWeaponSkin(activeWeapon, cfg.knife.paintKit, cfg.knife.wear, 0, -1);
        }
    }

} // namespace SkinChanger
```

`Cheat/src/math/math.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "math.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

namespace Math {

QAngle CalcAngle(const Vector3& src, const Vector3& dst) {
    Vector3 delta = dst - src;
    float hyp = delta.Length2D();

    QAngle angle;
    angle.pitch = -std::atan2(delta.z, hyp) * RAD2DEG;
    angle.yaw   = std::atan2(delta.y, delta.x) * RAD2DEG;
    angle.roll  = 0.f;

    NormalizeAngle(angle);
    return angle;
}

void NormalizeAngle(QAngle& angle) {
    // Clamp pitch to [-89, 89]
    if (angle.pitch > 89.f)  angle.pitch = 89.f;
    if (angle.pitch < -89.f) angle.pitch = -89.f;

    // Wrap yaw to [-180, 180]
    while (angle.yaw > 180.f)  angle.yaw -= 360.f;
    while (angle.yaw < -180.f) angle.yaw += 360.f;

    angle.roll = 0.f;
}

float GetFov(const QAngle& viewAngle, const QAngle& aimAngle) {
    QAngle delta = aimAngle - viewAngle;
    NormalizeAngle(delta);

    return std::sqrt(delta.pitch * delta.pitch + delta.yaw * delta.yaw);
}

bool WorldToScreen(const Vector3& worldPos, const VMatrix& viewMatrix,
                   int screenWidth, int screenHeight, Vector2& screenOut) {
    // Clip-space W coordinate — if negative, point is behind camera
    float w = viewMatrix[3][0] * worldPos.x +
              viewMatrix[3][1] * worldPos.y +
              viewMatrix[3][2] * worldPos.z +
              viewMatrix[3][3];

    if (w < 0.001f)
        return false;

    float invW = 1.f / w;

    // Normalized device coordinates
    float ndcX = (viewMatrix[0][0] * worldPos.x +
                  viewMatrix[0][1] * worldPos.y +
                  viewMatrix[0][2] * worldPos.z +
                  viewMatrix[0][3]) * invW;

    float ndcY = (viewMatrix[1][0] * worldPos.x +
                  viewMatrix[1][1] * worldPos.y +
                  viewMatrix[1][2] * worldPos.z +
                  viewMatrix[1][3]) * invW;

    // Screen coordinates
    screenOut.x = (screenWidth  * 0.5f) + (ndcX * screenWidth  * 0.5f);
    screenOut.y = (screenHeight * 0.5f) - (ndcY * screenHeight * 0.5f);

    return true;
}

float VectorDistance(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b) {
    return (a - b).Length();
}

Vector3 AngleToDirection(const QAngle& angle) {
    float pitchRad = angle.pitch * DEG2RAD;
    float yawRad   = angle.yaw * DEG2RAD;

    float cosPitch = std::cos(pitchRad);

    return {
        cosPitch * std::cos(yawRad),
        cosPitch * std::sin(yawRad),
        -std::sin(pitchRad)
    };
}

QAngle DirectionToAngle(const Vector3& direction) {
    float hyp = direction.Length2D();

    QAngle angle;
    angle.pitch = -std::atan2(direction.z, hyp) * RAD2DEG;
    angle.yaw   = std::atan2(direction.y, direction.x) * RAD2DEG;
    angle.roll  = 0.f;

    NormalizeAngle(angle);
    return angle;
}

float Clamp(float value, float min, float max) {
    return std::clamp(value, min, max);
}

float Lerp(float a, float b, float t) {
    return a + (b - a) * std::clamp(t, 0.f, 1.f);
}

QAngle AngleDelta(const QAngle& a, const QAngle& b) {
    QAngle delta;
    delta.pitch = a.pitch - b.pitch;
    delta.yaw   = a.yaw - b.yaw;
    delta.roll  = 0.f;

    // Normalize yaw delta
    while (delta.yaw > 180.f)  delta.yaw -= 360.f;
    while (delta.yaw < -180.f) delta.yaw += 360.f;

    return delta;
}

QAngle AngleLerp(const QAngle& a, const QAngle& b, float t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.f, 1.f);

    QAngle delta = AngleDelta(b, a);

    QAngle result;
    result.pitch = a.pitch + delta.pitch * t;
    result.yaw   = a.yaw + delta.yaw * t;
    result.roll  = 0.f;

    NormalizeAngle(result);
    return result;
}

QAngle SmoothAngle(const QAngle& current, const QAngle& target, float factor) {
    if (factor <= 1.f)
        return target; // No smoothing — instant snap

    QAngle delta = AngleDelta(target, current);

    QAngle result;
    result.pitch = current.pitch + delta.pitch / factor;
    result.yaw   = current.yaw + delta.yaw / factor;
    result.roll  = 0.f;

    NormalizeAngle(result);
    return result;
}

QAngle BezierInterpolate(const QAngle& p0, const QAngle& p1,
                          const QAngle& p2, const QAngle& p3, float t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.f, 1.f);
    float u  = 1.f - t;
    float uu = u * u;
    float tt = t * t;

    // Cubic bezier: B(t) = (1-t)^3*P0 + 3*(1-t)^2*t*P1 + 3*(1-t)*t^2*P2 + t^3*P3
    float b0 = uu * u;
    float b1 = 3.f * uu * t;
    float b2 = 3.f * u * tt;
    float b3 = tt * t;

    QAngle result;
    result.pitch = b0 * p0.pitch + b1 * p1.pitch + b2 * p2.pitch + b3 * p3.pitch;
    result.yaw   = b0 * p0.yaw   + b1 * p1.yaw   + b2 * p2.yaw   + b3 * p3.yaw;
    result.roll  = 0.f;

    NormalizeAngle(result);
    return result;
}

BBox CalcPlayerBBox(const Vector2& head, const Vector2& feet, float padding) {
    BBox box;

    float height = feet.y - head.y;
    if (height < 2.f) {
        box.valid = false;
        return box;
    }

    float width = height * 0.35f; // Approximate player width/height ratio

    box.x = head.x - width * 0.5f - padding;
    box.y = head.y - padding;
    box.w = width + padding * 2.f;
    box.h = height + padding * 2.f;
    box.valid = true;

    return box;
}

} // namespace Math

```

`Cheat/src/math/math.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "../sdk/vector.h"

// ============================================================================
// Math utilities for aimbot, ESP, and general game calculations
// ============================================================================

namespace Math {

    // Calculate the angle from source to destination position
    QAngle CalcAngle(const Vector3& src, const Vector3& dst);

    // Normalize an angle to valid FPS range
    void NormalizeAngle(QAngle& angle);

    // Get the FOV (angular distance) between two angles
    float GetFov(const QAngle& viewAngle, const QAngle& aimAngle);

    // Convert world position to screen coordinates
    // Returns true if the point is in front of the camera (visible on screen)
    bool WorldToScreen(const Vector3& worldPos, const VMatrix& viewMatrix,
                       int screenWidth, int screenHeight, Vector2& screenOut);

    // Distance between two 3D points
    float VectorDistance(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b);

    // Convert an angle to a forward direction vector
    Vector3 AngleToDirection(const QAngle& angle);

    // Convert a direction vector to an angle
    QAngle DirectionToAngle(const Vector3& direction);

    // Clamp a float value between min and max
    float Clamp(float value, float min, float max);

    // Linear interpolation between two values
    float Lerp(float a, float b, float t);

    // Linear interpolation between two angles (handles wrap-around)
    QAngle AngleLerp(const QAngle& a, const QAngle& b, float t);

    // Get the delta between two angles, handling wrap-around
    QAngle AngleDelta(const QAngle& a, const QAngle& b);

    // Smooth angle transition (used by aimbot smoothing)
    QAngle SmoothAngle(const QAngle& current, const QAngle& target, float factor);

    // Bezier curve interpolation for aim smoothing
    // p0 = start, p1 = control1, p2 = control2, p3 = end, t = 0..1
    QAngle BezierInterpolate(const QAngle& p0, const QAngle& p1,
                              const QAngle& p2, const QAngle& p3, float t);

    // Calculate the 2D bounding box for a player given head/feet screen positions
    struct BBox {
        float x, y, w, h;
        bool valid;
    };
    BBox CalcPlayerBBox(const Vector2& head, const Vector2& feet, float padding = 5.f);

} // namespace Math
```

```cpp
        constexpr ImU32 FrameHover      = IM_COL32(35,  35,  48,  255);
        constexpr ImU32 SliderGrab      = IM_COL32(212, 168, 67,  255);
        constexpr ImU32 Separator       = IM_COL32(40,  40,  52,  255);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // ApplyNexusStyle — apply the dark gold theme once
    // ========================================================================
    static void ApplyNexusStyle() {
        if (g_styleApplied) return;
        g_styleApplied = true;

        ImGuiStyle& s = ImGui::GetStyle();
        s.WindowRounding    = 8.0f;
        s.FrameRounding     = 4.0f;
        s.GrabRounding      = 4.0f;
        s.ScrollbarRounding = 4.0f;
        s.TabRounding       = 4.0f;
        s.ChildRounding     = 6.0f;
        s.PopupRounding     = 4.0f;
        s.WindowBorderSize  = 0.0f;
        s.FrameBorderSize   = 0.0f;
        s.ChildBorderSize   = 1.0f;
        s.WindowPadding     = ImVec2(0, 0);
        s.FramePadding      = ImVec2(8, 5);
        s.ItemSpacing       = ImVec2(8, 6);
        s.ItemInnerSpacing  = ImVec2(6, 4);
        s.ScrollbarSize     = 10.0f;
        s.GrabMinSize       = 8.0f;

        ImVec4* c = s.Colors;
        c[ImGuiCol_WindowBg]          = ImColor(Colors::Background);
        c[ImGuiCol_ChildBg]           = ImColor(Colors::PanelBg);
        c[ImGuiCol_Border]            = ImColor(Colors::PanelBorder);

        c[ImGuiCol_TextDisabled]      = ImColor(Colors::TextDim);
        c[ImGuiCol_FrameBg]           = ImColor(Colors::FrameBg);
        c[ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered]    = ImColor(Colors::FrameHover);
        c[ImGuiCol_FrameBgActive]     = ImColor(Colors::FrameHover);
        c[ImGuiCol_Button]            = ImColor(Colors::FrameBg);
        c[ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered]     = ImColor(Colors::FrameHover);

        c[ImGuiCol_SliderGrab]        = ImColor(Colors::SliderGrab);
        c[ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive]  = ImColor(Colors::AccentHover);
        c[ImGuiCol_CheckMark]         = ImColor(Colors::Accent);
        c[ImGuiCol_Header]            = ImColor(Colors::FrameBg);
        c[ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered]     = ImColor(Colors::FrameHover);
        c[ImGuiCol_HeaderActive]      = ImColor(Colors::FrameHover);

        c[ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrabActive]  = ImColor(Colors::AccentDim);

    // ========================================================================
    // Custom toggle switch (replaces default checkbox)
    // ========================================================================
    static bool ToggleSwitch(const char* label, bool* v) {
        ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
        if (window->SkipItems) return false;

        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);

        const float height = ImGui::GetFrameHeight() * 0.75f;
        const float width  = height * 1.8f;
        const float radius = height * 0.45f;

        ImVec2 pos = window->DC.CursorPos;
        ImVec2 labelSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label, nullptr, true);

        ImRect totalBb(pos, ImVec2(pos.x + width + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + labelSize.x,
                                    pos.y + std::max(height, labelSize.y) + style.FramePadding.y));
        ImGui::ItemSize(totalBb, style.FramePadding.y);
        if (!ImGui::ItemAdd(totalBb, id))
            return false;

        bool hovered, held;
        bool pressed = ImGui::ButtonBehavior(totalBb, id, &hovered, &held);
        if (pressed) *v = !(*v);

        // Draw toggle track
        float trackY = pos.y + (totalBb.GetHeight() - height) * 0.5f;
        ImVec2 trackMin(pos.x, trackY);
        ImVec2 trackMax(pos.x + width, trackY + height);

        ImU32 trackColor = *v ? Colors::Accent : Colors::ToggleOff;
        if (hovered) trackColor = *v ? Colors::AccentHover : IM_COL32(65, 65, 75, 255);

        window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(trackMin, trackMax, trackColor, height * 0.5f);

        // Draw knob
        float knobX = *v ? (trackMax.x - radius - 2.f) : (trackMin.x + radius + 2.f);
        float knobY = trackMin.y + height * 0.5f;
        window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(knobX, knobY), radius,
                                           Colors::ToggleKnob, 16);

        // Draw label
        ImVec2 textPos(pos.x + width + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x,
                       pos.y + (totalBb.GetHeight() - labelSize.y) * 0.5f);
        window->DrawList->AddText(textPos, Colors::TextWhite, label);

        return pressed;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Custom section header (panel title)
    // ========================================================================
    static void SectionHeader(const char* title) {
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImColor(Colors::TextGray).Value);
        ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + 2.f);
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(title);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        ImGui::Spacing();
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Custom keybind button
    // ========================================================================
    static bool KeybindButton(const char* label, int* key) {
        char buf[32];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Keybind##%s", label);

        static bool waiting = false;
        static const char* waitingFor = nullptr;

        if (waiting && waitingFor == label) {
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImColor(Colors::Accent).Value);
            if (ImGui::Button("Press key...", ImVec2(-1, 0))) {
                waiting = false;
                waitingFor = nullptr;
            }
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();

            for (int vk = 0x01; vk < 0xFF; vk++) {
                if (vk == VK_INSERT || vk == VK_END || vk == VK_ESCAPE) continue;
                if (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 1) {
                    *key = vk;
                    waiting = false;
                    waitingFor = nullptr;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } else {
            char keyName[32];
            snprintf(keyName, sizeof(keyName), "0x%02X##%s", *key, label);
            if (ImGui::Button(keyName, ImVec2(-1, 0))) {
                waiting = true;
                waitingFor = label;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Color edit helper
    // ========================================================================
    static void ColorEdit(const char* label, Color& color) {
        float col[4] = { color.r/255.f, color.g/255.f, color.b/255.f, color.a/255.f };
        if (ImGui::ColorEdit4(label, col, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar)) {
            color.r = (uint8_t)(col[0]*255.f);
            color.g = (uint8_t)(col[1]*255.f);
            color.b = (uint8_t)(col[2]*255.f);
            color.a = (uint8_t)(col[3]*255.f);
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Header bar — "Project Nexus" + main tabs
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawHeader(float menuW) {
        ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        ImVec2 wp = ImGui::GetWindowPos();

        // Header background
        dl->AddRectFilled(wp, ImVec2(wp.x + menuW, wp.y + 42),
                          Colors::HeaderBg, 8.f, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTop);

        // "Project" in white
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(wp.x + 18, wp.y + 12), Colors::TextWhite, "Project");

        // "Nexus" in gold
        ImVec2 projectSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize("Project");
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(wp.x + 18 + projectSize.x + 1, wp.y + 12),
                    Colors::Accent, "Nexus");

        // Main tab buttons on the right
        float tabX = wp.x + menuW - 20.f;
        for (int i = MAIN_TAB_COUNT - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            ImVec2 textSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(MAIN_TABS[i]);
            float btnW = textSize.x + 28.f;
            tabX -= btnW;

            ImVec2 btnMin(tabX, wp.y + 6);
            ImVec2 btnMax(tabX + btnW, wp.y + 36);

            bool hovered = ImGui::IsMouseHoveringRect(btnMin, btnMax);
            bool clicked = hovered && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(0);

            if (clicked) {
                g_mainTab = i;
                g_subTab = 0;
            }

            // Tab background on hover or active
            if (i == g_mainTab) {
                dl->AddRectFilled(btnMin, btnMax, IM_COL32(35, 35, 48, 255), 4.f);
            } else if (hovered) {
                dl->AddRectFilled(btnMin, btnMax, IM_COL32(28, 28, 38, 255), 4.f);
            }

            ImU32 textCol = (i == g_mainTab) ? Colors::TextWhite : Colors::TextGray;
            dl->AddText(ImVec2(tabX + 10, wp.y + 13), textCol, MAIN_TABS[i]);

            // Dropdown arrow
            float arrowX = tabX + btnW - 16.f;
            float arrowY = wp.y + 18.f;
            dl->AddTriangleFilled(
                ImVec2(arrowX, arrowY),
                ImVec2(arrowX + 6, arrowY),
                ImVec2(arrowX + 3, arrowY + 4),
                textCol
            );

            tabX -= 4.f; // gap between tabs
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Sub-navigation bar
    // ========================================================================
    static void DrawSubNav(float menuW) {
        ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        ImVec2 wp = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
        float y = wp.y + 42;

        // Sub-nav background
        dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(wp.x, y), ImVec2(wp.x + menuW, y + 32), Colors::SubNavBg);
        dl->AddLine(ImVec2(wp.x, y + 32), ImVec2(wp.x + menuW, y + 32), Colors::PanelBorder);

        // Gear icon (simple)
        float gearX = wp.x + 16;
        dl->AddCircle(ImVec2(gearX + 5, y + 16), 5, Colors::TextGray, 6, 1.5f);

        // Breadcrumb: "General" dot "SubTabName"
        const char* subTabs[][4] = {
            { "Aimbot", "Triggerbot", "Anti-Aim", nullptr },     // Combat
            { "Player ESP", "World ESP", "Colors", nullptr },     // Visuals
            { "Movement", "Automation", "Radar", nullptr },       // Exploits
            { "Skins", "Config", "Info", nullptr }                // Misc
        };

        float textX = gearX + 18;
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(textX, y + 9), Colors::TextGray, "General");
        textX += ImGui::CalcTextSize("General").x + 6;

        // Dot separator
        dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(textX + 2, y + 16), 2.f, Colors::Accent);
        textX += 10;

        // Active sub-tab name
        const char* activeSubName = subTabs[g_mainTab][g_subTab];
        if (activeSubName)
            dl->AddText(ImVec2(textX, y + 9), Colors::Accent, activeSubName);

        // Sub-tab clickable items on the right
        float stX = wp.x + menuW - 16;
        for (int i = 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (!subTabs[g_mainTab][i]) continue;
            ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(subTabs[g_mainTab][i]);
            stX -= ts.x;

            ImVec2 stMin(stX - 4, y + 4);
            ImVec2 stMax(stX + ts.x + 4, y + 28);

            bool hover = ImGui::IsMouseHoveringRect(stMin, stMax);
            if (hover && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(0)) g_subTab = i;

            // Gear icon on far right for settings
            stX -= 12;
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Begin a styled content panel (left or right column)
    // ========================================================================
    static bool BeginPanel(const char* title, float width, float height) {
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildRounding, 6.f);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(14, 10));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, ImColor(Colors::PanelBg).Value);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, ImColor(Colors::PanelBorder).Value);

        bool open = ImGui::BeginChild(title, ImVec2(width, height), true);

        if (open) {
            // Panel header
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImColor(Colors::TextGray).Value);
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(title);
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::Spacing();
        }

        return open;
    }

    static void EndPanel() {
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
        ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Combat tab content
    // ========================================================================
    static void RenderCombat() {
        auto& aim = ConfigManager::Get().Aimbot();
        float panelW = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.5f - 6.f;
        float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4.f;

        // Left panel: Aimbot
        BeginPanel("Aimbot", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ToggleSwitch("Enable Aimbot", &aim.enabled);
            ImGui::Spacing();

            ImGui::Text("Aimbot Type");
            int aimType = 0; // Mouse Aim default
            ImGui::Combo("##aimtype", &aimType, AIMBOT_TYPES, IM_ARRAYSIZE(AIMBOT_TYPES));

            ToggleSwitch("Sticky Aim", &aim.prediction);
            ToggleSwitch("Draw FOV", &aim.visibilityCheck);

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Text("Aim Key");
            KeybindButton("aimkey", &aim.key);

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Text("Aimbot Checks");
            int checkType = 0;
            ImGui::Combo("##checks", &checkType, CHECK_TYPES, IM_ARRAYSIZE(CHECK_TYPES));
        }
        EndPanel();

        ImGui::SameLine();

        // Right panel: Aimbot Settings
        BeginPanel("Aimbot Settings", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ImGui::Text("Target Hitbox");
            int boneIdx = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < IM_ARRAYSIZE(HITBOX_IDS); i++) {
                if (HITBOX_IDS[i] == aim.bone) { boneIdx = i; break; }
            }
            if (ImGui::Combo("##hitbox", &boneIdx, HITBOX_NAMES, IM_ARRAYSIZE(HITBOX_NAMES)))
                aim.bone = HITBOX_IDS[boneIdx];

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Text("FOV Size");
            ImGui::SliderFloat("##fov", &aim.fov, 1.f, 180.f, "%.1f");

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Text("Smooth Type");
            ImGui::Combo("##smooth_type", &aim.smoothType, SMOOTH_TYPES, IM_ARRAYSIZE(SMOOTH_TYPES));

            ImGui::Text("Smooth Amount");
            ImGui::SliderFloat("##smooth", &aim.smooth, 1.f, 20.f, "%.1f");

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ToggleSwitch("Mouse Prediction", &aim.prediction);
            ToggleSwitch("Recoil Control", &aim.rcs);
            if (aim.rcs) {
                ImGui::Text("RCS Amount");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##rcs", &aim.rcsAmount, 0.f, 100.f, "%.0f%%");
            }
        }
        EndPanel();

        // Sub-tab: Triggerbot
        if (g_subTab == 1) {
            // Reset and draw triggerbot panels instead
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Visuals tab content
    // ========================================================================
    static void RenderVisuals() {
        auto& esp = ConfigManager::Get().Esp();
        float panelW = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.5f - 6.f;
        float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4.f;

        BeginPanel("Player ESP", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ToggleSwitch("Enable ESP", &esp.enabled);
            ImGui::Spacing();

            ToggleSwitch("Bounding Box", &esp.boxes.enabled);
            if (esp.boxes.enabled) {
                ImGui::Text("Box Style");
                ImGui::Combo("##boxstyle", &esp.boxes.style, BOX_STYLES, IM_ARRAYSIZE(BOX_STYLES));
                ImGui::Text("Thickness");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##thick", &esp.boxes.thickness, 0.5f, 5.f, "%.1f");
            }

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ToggleSwitch("Health Bar", &esp.healthBar);
            ToggleSwitch("Armor Bar", &esp.armorBar);
            ToggleSwitch("Name Tag", &esp.name);
            ToggleSwitch("Distance", &esp.distance);
            ToggleSwitch("Weapon Name", &esp.weapon);
            ToggleSwitch("Skeleton", &esp.skeleton);
            ToggleSwitch("Head Dot", &esp.headDot);

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ToggleSwitch("Snaplines", &esp.snaplines.enabled);
            if (esp.snaplines.enabled) {
                ImGui::Combo("##snappos", &esp.snaplines.position, SNAP_POS, IM_ARRAYSIZE(SNAP_POS));
            }
        }
        EndPanel();

        ImGui::SameLine();

        BeginPanel("ESP Settings", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ImGui::Text("Enemy Color");
            ColorEdit("##enemy", esp.enemyColor);
            ImGui::Text("Team Color");
            ColorEdit("##team", esp.teamColor);
            ImGui::Text("Visible Color");
            ColorEdit("##visible", esp.visibleColor);

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::Spacing();

            ImGui::Text("World ESP");
            ToggleSwitch("Bomb Info", &esp.bombInfo);
            ToggleSwitch("Dropped Weapons", &esp.droppedWeapons);
        }
        EndPanel();
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Exploits tab content
    // ========================================================================
    static void RenderExploits() {
        auto& misc = ConfigManager::Get().Misc();
        auto& aim  = ConfigManager::Get().Aimbot();
        float panelW = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.5f - 6.f;
        float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4.f;

        BeginPanel("Movement", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ToggleSwitch("Bunny Hop", &misc.bhop);
            ToggleSwitch("Auto Strafe", &misc.autostrafe);
            ToggleSwitch("Radar Hack", &misc.radar);

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::Spacing();

            ToggleSwitch("No Flash", &misc.noflash);
            if (misc.noflash) {
                ImGui::Text("Flash Alpha");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##flash", &misc.flashMaxAlpha, 0.f, 255.f, "%.0f");
            }

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ToggleSwitch("Spectator List", &misc.spectatorList);
        }
        EndPanel();

        ImGui::SameLine();

        BeginPanel("Triggerbot", panelW, panelH);
        {
            ToggleSwitch("Enable Triggerbot", &aim.triggerbot.enabled);

            if (aim.triggerbot.enabled) {
                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("Min Delay (ms)");
                ImGui::SliderInt("##tbmin", &aim.triggerbot.delayMinMs, 0, 200);

                ImGui::Text("Max Delay (ms)");
                ImGui::SliderInt("##tbmax", &aim.triggerbot.delayMaxMs, 0, 200);

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ToggleSwitch("Head Only", &aim.triggerbot.headOnly);
            }
        }
        EndPanel();
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Misc tab content (Skins + Config)
    // ========================================================================
    static void RenderMisc() {
        auto& skins = ConfigManager::Get().Skins();
        auto& cfgMgr = ConfigManager::Get();
        float panelW = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.5f - 6.f;
        float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4.f;

        // Skins panel
        if (g_subTab == 0) {
            BeginPanel("Skin Changer", panelW, panelH);
            {
                ToggleSwitch("Enable Skins", &skins.enabled);
                ImGui::Spacing();

                ImGui::Text("Knife Model");
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##knife", KnifeChanger::GetKnifeName(skins.knife.model))) {
                    for (const auto& k : KNIVES) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(k.name, skins.knife.model == k.defIndex))
                            skins.knife.model = k.defIndex;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
                ImGui::Text("Knife Wear");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##kwear", &skins.knife.wear, 0.f, 1.f, "%.4f");

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("Glove Model");
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##glove", GloveChanger::GetGloveName(skins.gloves.model))) {
                    for (const auto& g : GLOVES) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(g.name, skins.gloves.model == g.defIndex))
                            skins.gloves.model = g.defIndex;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
            }
            EndPanel();

            ImGui::SameLine();

            BeginPanel("Weapon Skins", panelW, panelH);
            {
                ImGui::Text("AK-47");
                SkinWeaponConfig& akCfg = skins.weapons[WeaponId::AK47];
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##akskin", "Select Skin")) {
                    for (const auto& s : AK47_SKINS) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(s.name, akCfg.paintKit == s.paintKit))
                            akCfg.paintKit = s.paintKit;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("AWP");
                SkinWeaponConfig& awpCfg = skins.weapons[WeaponId::AWP];
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##awpskin", "Select Skin")) {
                    for (const auto& s : AWP_SKINS) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(s.name, awpCfg.paintKit == s.paintKit))
                            awpCfg.paintKit = s.paintKit;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("M4A4");
                SkinWeaponConfig& m4Cfg = skins.weapons[WeaponId::M4A1];
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##m4skin", "Select Skin")) {
                    for (const auto& s : M4A4_SKINS) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(s.name, m4Cfg.paintKit == s.paintKit))
                            m4Cfg.paintKit = s.paintKit;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("M4A1-S");
                SkinWeaponConfig& m4sCfg = skins.weapons[WeaponId::M4A1_SILENCER];
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##m4sskin", "Select Skin")) {
                    for (const auto& s : M4A1S_SKINS) {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(s.name, m4sCfg.paintKit == s.paintKit))
                            m4sCfg.paintKit = s.paintKit;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
            }
            EndPanel();
        }

        // Config panel
        if (g_subTab == 1) {
            BeginPanel("Config Profiles", panelW, panelH);
            {
                auto profiles = cfgMgr.GetProfileNames();
                std::string curName = cfgMgr.Current().name;

                for (const auto& p : profiles) {
                    bool sel = (p == curName);
                    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text,
                        sel ? ImColor(Colors::Accent).Value : ImColor(Colors::TextWhite).Value);
                    if (ImGui::Selectable(p.c_str(), sel))
                        cfgMgr.Load(p);
                    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
                }

                if (profiles.empty())
                    ImGui::TextDisabled("No saved profiles");
            }
            EndPanel();

            ImGui::SameLine();

            BeginPanel("Actions", panelW, panelH);
            {
                if (ImGui::Button("Save Current", ImVec2(-1, 30))) {
                    cfgMgr.Save();
                }

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Text("Save As:");
                ImGui::InputText("##newcfg", g_newProfile, sizeof(g_newProfile));
                if (ImGui::Button("Save As New", ImVec2(-1, 30))) {
                    if (g_newProfile[0]) {
                        cfgMgr.Save(g_newProfile);
                        g_newProfile[0] = 0;
                    }
                }

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::Separator();
                ImGui::Spacing();

                ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, IM_COL32(120, 30, 30, 255));
                ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, IM_COL32(160, 40, 40, 255));
                if (ImGui::Button("Delete Current", ImVec2(-1, 30))) {
                    std::string n = cfgMgr.Current().name;
                    if (n != "default") {
                        cfgMgr.Delete(n);
                        cfgMgr.Load("default");
                    }
                }
                ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);

                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Path: %s", cfgMgr.GetConfigPath().c_str());
            }
            EndPanel();
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Render — main entry point
    // ========================================================================
    void Render() {
        ApplyNexusStyle();

        const float MENU_W = 620.f;
        const float MENU_H = 460.f;

        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(MENU_W, MENU_H), ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(100, 100), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);

        ImGui::Begin("##ProjectNexus", nullptr,
                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar |
                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse |
                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar |
                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse);

        // Draw custom header and sub-nav
        DrawHeader(MENU_W);
        DrawSubNav(MENU_W);

        // Content area starts below header (42px) + sub-nav (32px) + padding
        ImGui::SetCursorPos(ImVec2(12, 82));

        // Render active tab content
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(10, 8));
        switch (g_mainTab) {
            case 0: RenderCombat();   break;
            case 1: RenderVisuals();  break;
            case 2: RenderExploits(); break;
            case 3: RenderMisc();     break;
        }
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();

        ImGui::End();
    }

} // namespace Menu
```

`Cheat/src/render/overlay.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "overlay.h"
#include "renderer.h"
#include "menu.h"
#include "../features/esp/esp.h"
#include "../features/misc/misc.h"
#include "../config/config.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi.h>
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_dx11.h"
#include "imgui_impl_win32.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <atomic>

#pragma comment(lib, "d3d11.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dxgi.lib")

extern void Log(const char* msg);
extern LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);

// ============================================================================
// Overlay — lightweight external window, NO separate thread
// Renders from the main cheat loop (same thread)
// No WS_EX_TOPMOST at creation — uses SetWindowPos to stay above CS2
// ============================================================================

namespace Overlay {

    static HWND g_overlayHwnd = nullptr;
    static HWND g_gameHwnd    = nullptr;
    static std::atomic<bool> g_menuOpen{ false };
    static bool g_initialized = false;

    static ID3D11Device*           g_device     = nullptr;
    static ID3D11DeviceContext*    g_context    = nullptr;
    static IDXGISwapChain*         g_swapChain  = nullptr;
    static ID3D11RenderTargetView* g_rtv        = nullptr;

    static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        if (g_menuOpen && ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam))
            return 0;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }

    static HWND FindGameWindow() {
        // Find CS2 window by enumerating
        HWND hwnd = nullptr;
        // Try common CS2 window classes
        hwnd = FindWindowA("SDL_app", nullptr);
        if (!hwnd) hwnd = FindWindowA(nullptr, "Counter-Strike 2");
        return hwnd;
    }

    bool Initialize() {
        Log("[Overlay] Lightweight init (no separate thread)...");

        // Find CS2 window
        g_gameHwnd = FindGameWindow();
        if (!g_gameHwnd) {
            // Try a few more times
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && !g_gameHwnd; i++) {
                Sleep(500);
                g_gameHwnd = FindGameWindow();
            }
        }
        if (!g_gameHwnd) {
            Log("[Overlay] CS2 window not found");
            return false;
        }

        char buf[128];
        sprintf_s(buf, "[Overlay] CS2 window: 0x%p", g_gameHwnd);
        Log(buf);

        // Get CS2 window rect
        RECT gameRect;
        GetWindowRect(g_gameHwnd, &gameRect);
        int w = gameRect.right - gameRect.left;
        int h = gameRect.bottom - gameRect.top;

        // Register overlay window class
        WNDCLASSEXW wc = {};
        wc.cbSize = sizeof(wc);
        wc.style = CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
        wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc;
        wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleA(nullptr);
        wc.lpszClassName = L"NexusOvl";
        RegisterClassExW(&wc);

        // Create overlay — NO WS_EX_TOPMOST, just transparent + layered + toolwindow
        g_overlayHwnd = CreateWindowExW(
            WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE,
            L"NexusOvl", L"",
            WS_POPUP,
            gameRect.left, gameRect.top, w, h,
            nullptr, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr
        );

        if (!g_overlayHwnd) {
            Log("[Overlay] CreateWindowEx failed");
            return false;
        }

        // Transparent background via color key
        SetLayeredWindowAttributes(g_overlayHwnd, RGB(0, 0, 0), 0, LWA_COLORKEY);
        ShowWindow(g_overlayHwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);

        // Create D3D11 device
        DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC scd = {};
        scd.BufferDesc.Width = w;
        scd.BufferDesc.Height = h;
        scd.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        scd.BufferDesc.RefreshRate = {0, 1};
        scd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        scd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
        scd.BufferCount = 2;
        scd.OutputWindow = g_overlayHwnd;
        scd.Windowed = TRUE;
        scd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_DISCARD;

        HRESULT hr = D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(
            nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr, 0,
            nullptr, 0, D3D11_SDK_VERSION,
            &scd, &g_swapChain, &g_device, nullptr, &g_context
        );

        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            sprintf_s(buf, "[Overlay] D3D11 create failed: 0x%08X", hr);
            Log(buf);
            DestroyWindow(g_overlayHwnd);
            return false;
        }

        // Create render target
        ID3D11Texture2D* backBuf = nullptr;
        g_swapChain->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backBuf));
        g_device->CreateRenderTargetView(backBuf, nullptr, &g_rtv);
        backBuf->Release();

        // Init ImGui
        IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
        ImGui::CreateContext();
        ImGui::StyleColorsDark();
        ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_overlayHwnd);
        ImGui_ImplDX11_Init(g_device, g_context);

        g_initialized = true;
        Log("[Overlay] Initialized — call RenderFrame() from main loop");
        return true;
    }

    // Called from main cheat loop — NO separate thread
    void RenderFrame() {
        if (!g_initialized) return;

        // Process window messages (on THIS thread)
        MSG msg;
        while (PeekMessage(&msg, g_overlayHwnd, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessage(&msg);
        }

        // Check if game window still exists
        if (!IsWindow(g_gameHwnd)) {
            g_gameHwnd = FindGameWindow();
            if (!g_gameHwnd) return;
        }

        // Keep overlay positioned over CS2 (no TOPMOST, just SetWindowPos)
        RECT gameRect;
        GetWindowRect(g_gameHwnd, &gameRect);
        SetWindowPos(g_overlayHwnd, g_gameHwnd,
                     gameRect.left, gameRect.top,
                     gameRect.right - gameRect.left,
                     gameRect.bottom - gameRect.top,
                     SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        // Bring just above CS2
        SetWindowPos(g_overlayHwnd, HWND_TOPMOST,
                     0, 0, 0, 0,
                     SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        SetWindowPos(g_overlayHwnd, HWND_NOTOPMOST,
                     0, 0, 0, 0,
                     SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOACTIVATE);

        // Toggle menu
        if (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_INSERT) & 1) {
            g_menuOpen = !g_menuOpen;

            if (g_menuOpen) {
                LONG exStyle = GetWindowLong(g_overlayHwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
                exStyle &= ~WS_EX_TRANSPARENT;
                SetWindowLong(g_overlayHwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle);
                SetForegroundWindow(g_overlayHwnd);
            } else {
                LONG exStyle = GetWindowLong(g_overlayHwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
                exStyle |= WS_EX_TRANSPARENT;
                SetWindowLong(g_overlayHwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle);
            }
        }

        // Render
        ImGui_ImplDX11_NewFrame();
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        ImGui::NewFrame();

        // ESP
        if (ConfigManager::Get().Esp().enabled)
            Esp::Render();

        // Spectators
        if (ConfigManager::Get().Misc().spectatorList)
            Misc::SpectatorList();

        // Menu
        if (g_menuOpen)
            Menu::Render();

        ImGui::Render();

        float clearColor[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        g_context->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &g_rtv, nullptr);
        g_context->ClearRenderTargetView(g_rtv, clearColor);
        ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData());

        g_swapChain->Present(1, 0);
    }

    void Shutdown() {
        if (g_rtv) g_rtv->Release();
        if (g_swapChain) g_swapChain->Release();
        if (g_context) g_context->Release();
        if (g_device) g_device->Release();

        if (ImGui::GetCurrentContext()) {
            ImGui_ImplDX11_Shutdown();
            ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown();
            ImGui::DestroyContext();
        }

        if (g_overlayHwnd) {
            DestroyWindow(g_overlayHwnd);
            UnregisterClassW(L"NexusOvl", GetModuleHandleA(nullptr));
        }

        g_initialized = false;
    }

    bool IsMenuOpen() { return g_menuOpen; }

} // namespace Overlay
```

`Cheat/src/sdk/bones.h`:

```h
#pragma once

// ============================================================================
// CS2 Bone IDs — Source 2 skeleton bone indices
// Used for aimbot bone targeting and skeleton ESP
// ============================================================================

enum class BoneId : int {
    // Head
    HEAD            = 6,
    NECK            = 5,
    JAW             = 7,

    // Spine
    SPINE_0         = 2,    // pelvis / root
    SPINE_1         = 3,    // lower back
    SPINE_2         = 4,    // upper back

    // Left arm
    LEFT_SHOULDER   = 8,
    LEFT_UPPER_ARM  = 9,
    LEFT_FOREARM    = 10,
    LEFT_HAND       = 11,

    // Right arm
    RIGHT_SHOULDER  = 13,
    RIGHT_UPPER_ARM = 14,
    RIGHT_FOREARM   = 15,
    RIGHT_HAND      = 16,

    // Left leg
    LEFT_THIGH      = 22,
    LEFT_CALF       = 23,
    LEFT_FOOT       = 24,

    // Right leg
    RIGHT_THIGH     = 25,
    RIGHT_CALF      = 26,
    RIGHT_FOOT      = 27,

    // Root
    ROOT            = 0,

    // Count
    BONE_COUNT      = 28
};

// Bone connection pairs for skeleton ESP rendering
struct BoneConnection {
    BoneId from;
    BoneId to;
};

inline constexpr BoneConnection SKELETON_CONNECTIONS[] = {
    // Head -> Spine
    { BoneId::HEAD,           BoneId::NECK },
    { BoneId::NECK,           BoneId::SPINE_2 },
    { BoneId::SPINE_2,        BoneId::SPINE_1 },
    { BoneId::SPINE_1,        BoneId::SPINE_0 },

    // Left arm
    { BoneId::SPINE_2,        BoneId::LEFT_SHOULDER },
    { BoneId::LEFT_SHOULDER,  BoneId::LEFT_UPPER_ARM },
    { BoneId::LEFT_UPPER_ARM, BoneId::LEFT_FOREARM },
    { BoneId::LEFT_FOREARM,   BoneId::LEFT_HAND },

    // Right arm
    { BoneId::SPINE_2,         BoneId::RIGHT_SHOULDER },
    { BoneId::RIGHT_SHOULDER,  BoneId::RIGHT_UPPER_ARM },
    { BoneId::RIGHT_UPPER_ARM, BoneId::RIGHT_FOREARM },
    { BoneId::RIGHT_FOREARM,   BoneId::RIGHT_HAND },

    // Left leg
    { BoneId::SPINE_0,     BoneId::LEFT_THIGH },
    { BoneId::LEFT_THIGH,  BoneId::LEFT_CALF },
    { BoneId::LEFT_CALF,   BoneId::LEFT_FOOT },

    // Right leg
    { BoneId::SPINE_0,      BoneId::RIGHT_THIGH },
    { BoneId::RIGHT_THIGH,  BoneId::RIGHT_CALF },
    { BoneId::RIGHT_CALF,   BoneId::RIGHT_FOOT },
};

inline constexpr int SKELETON_CONNECTION_COUNT = sizeof(SKELETON_CONNECTIONS) / sizeof(BoneConnection);

// Aimbot bone priority (higher = preferred target)
enum class BonePriority : int {
    LOW    = 0,  // feet, hands
    MEDIUM = 1,  // limbs
    HIGH   = 2,  // chest, spine
    CRITICAL = 3 // head, neck
};

inline BonePriority GetBonePriority(BoneId bone) {
    switch (bone) {
        case BoneId::HEAD:
        case BoneId::NECK:
            return BonePriority::CRITICAL;
        case BoneId::SPINE_2:
        case BoneId::SPINE_1:
            return BonePriority::HIGH;
        case BoneId::LEFT_UPPER_ARM:
        case BoneId::RIGHT_UPPER_ARM:
        case BoneId::LEFT_THIGH:
        case BoneId::RIGHT_THIGH:
            return BonePriority::MEDIUM;
        default:
            return BonePriority::LOW;
    }
}
```
