```h
// ============================================================================
// BYOVD Kernel Mapper — maps unsigned driver via vulnerable signed driver
// Uses WinRing0x64.sys for physical memory primitives
// Flow: Load WinRing0 → phys R/W → map our driver → unload WinRing0
// ============================================================================

class ByovdMapper {
public:
    ByovdMapper() = default;
    ~ByovdMapper();

    // Initialize: load the vulnerable driver and open its device
    bool Initialize(const std::string& vulnDriverPath);

    // Map our unsigned kernel driver into kernel memory
    bool MapDriver(const std::string& driverPath);

    // Cleanup: unload vulnerable driver
    void Cleanup();

    // Status
    const std::string& GetLastError() const { return m_lastError; }
    bool IsInitialized() const { return m_initialized; }

private:
    // Vulnerable driver handle
    HANDLE    m_hDevice     = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    SC_HANDLE m_scManager   = nullptr;
    SC_HANDLE m_scService   = nullptr;
    bool      m_initialized = false;
    std::string m_lastError;
    std::string m_vulnServiceName = "iqvw64e";

    // Cached kernel info
    uint64_t m_ntoskrnlBase = 0;
    uint64_t m_systemCr3    = 0;

    // === WinRing0 Physical Memory Primitives ===
    bool ReadPhysical(uint64_t physAddr, void* buffer, uint32_t size);
    bool WritePhysical(uint64_t physAddr, const void* buffer, uint32_t size);

    // === Page Table Walking (virtual ↔ physical translation) ===
    uint64_t VirtToPhys(uint64_t cr3, uint64_t virtualAddr);
    bool ReadKernelVirtual(uint64_t virtualAddr, void* buffer, uint32_t size);
    bool WriteKernelVirtual(uint64_t virtualAddr, const void* buffer, uint32_t size);

    // === Kernel Discovery ===
    bool FindSystemCr3();
    bool FindNtoskrnlBase();
    uint64_t GetKernelExport(const char* functionName);

    // === Driver Mapping ===
    uint64_t AllocateKernelPool(uint32_t size);
    bool CopyDriverSections(uint64_t remoteBase, const uint8_t* image,
                            PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 ntHeaders);
    bool FixRelocations(uint64_t remoteBase, const uint8_t* image,
                        PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 ntHeaders, int64_t delta);
    bool ResolveDriverImports(uint64_t remoteBase, const uint8_t* image,
                              PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 ntHeaders);
    bool CallDriverEntry(uint64_t entryPoint, uint64_t driverBase);

    // === SCM helpers ===
    bool LoadVulnDriver(const std::string& path);
    bool UnloadVulnDriver();
};

// ============================================================================
// Intel iqvw64e.sys (NAL Driver) — IOCTL codes and structures
// Sourced from kdmapper by TheCruZ (GitHub)
// ============================================================================

// Device name — Intel NAL driver
#define INTEL_NAL_DEVICE_NAME "\\\\.\\Nal"

// Single IOCTL code — all operations differentiated by case_number in buffer
#define INTEL_NAL_IOCTL 0x80862007

// Case numbers for different operations
#define NAL_CASE_MAP_IO_SPACE       0x19
#define NAL_CASE_UNMAP_IO_SPACE     0x1A

// Structures for each operation — all start with case_number + reserved
#pragma pack(push, 1)

struct COPY_MEMORY_BUFFER_INFO {
    uint64_t case_number;
    uint64_t reserved;
    uint64_t source;
    uint64_t destination;
    uint64_t length;
};

struct FILL_MEMORY_BUFFER_INFO {
    uint64_t case_number;
    uint64_t reserved1;
    uint32_t value;
    uint32_t reserved2;
    uint64_t destination;
    uint64_t length;
};

struct GET_PHYS_ADDRESS_BUFFER_INFO {
    uint64_t case_number;
    uint64_t reserved;
    uint64_t return_physical_address;
    uint64_t address_to_translate;
};

struct MAP_IO_SPACE_BUFFER_INFO {
    uint64_t case_number;       // = 0x19
    uint64_t reserved;
    uint64_t return_value;
    uint64_t return_virtual_address;
    uint64_t physical_address_to_map;
    uint32_t size;
};

struct UNMAP_IO_SPACE_BUFFER_INFO {
    uint64_t case_number;       // = 0x1A
    uint64_t reserved1;
    uint64_t reserved2;
    uint64_t virt_address;
    uint64_t reserved3;
    uint32_t number_of_bytes;
};

#pragma pack(pop)

// Page table constants
#define PAGE_SIZE_4KB     0x1000
#define PAGE_MASK_4KB     0xFFF
#define PML4_SHIFT        39
#define PDPT_SHIFT        30
#define PD_SHIFT          21
#define PT_SHIFT          12
#define TABLE_INDEX_MASK  0x1FF
#define PHYS_ADDR_MASK    0x000FFFFFFFFFF000ULL
#define PAGE_PRESENT      0x1
#define PAGE_LARGE        0x80
```

`Loader/include/syscalls.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <winternl.h>
#include <cstdint>

// ============================================================================
// Direct Syscalls — bypass VAC's ntdll hooks
// Resolves syscall numbers dynamically from ntdll on disk
// Calls syscall instruction directly (no ntdll code executed)
// ============================================================================

#ifndef NT_SUCCESS
#define NT_SUCCESS(Status) (((NTSTATUS)(Status)) >= 0)
#endif

// NT structures
typedef struct _UNICODE_STRING_NT {
    USHORT Length;
    USHORT MaximumLength;
    PWSTR  Buffer;
} UNICODE_STRING_NT;

typedef struct _OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES_NT {
    ULONG           Length;
    HANDLE          RootDirectory;
    UNICODE_STRING_NT* ObjectName;
    ULONG           Attributes;
    PVOID           SecurityDescriptor;
    PVOID           SecurityQualityOfService;
} OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES_NT;

// CLIENT_ID defined in winternl.h

// ============================================================================
// Syscall class — resolves and calls NT functions via direct syscall
// ============================================================================
class DirectSyscall {
public:
    bool Initialize();

    // Process operations
    NTSTATUS NtOpenProcess(PHANDLE ProcessHandle, ACCESS_MASK DesiredAccess,
                           DWORD ProcessId);

    // Memory operations
    NTSTATUS NtAllocateVirtualMemory(HANDLE ProcessHandle, PVOID* BaseAddress,
                                      SIZE_T* RegionSize, ULONG AllocationType,
                                      ULONG Protect);

    NTSTATUS NtWriteVirtualMemory(HANDLE ProcessHandle, PVOID BaseAddress,
                                   PVOID Buffer, SIZE_T Size, PSIZE_T Written);

    NTSTATUS NtReadVirtualMemory(HANDLE ProcessHandle, PVOID BaseAddress,
                                  PVOID Buffer, SIZE_T Size, PSIZE_T Read);

    NTSTATUS NtFreeVirtualMemory(HANDLE ProcessHandle, PVOID* BaseAddress,
                                  PSIZE_T RegionSize, ULONG FreeType);

    NTSTATUS NtProtectVirtualMemory(HANDLE ProcessHandle, PVOID* BaseAddress,
                                     PSIZE_T RegionSize, ULONG NewProtect,
                                     PULONG OldProtect);

    // Thread operations
    NTSTATUS NtCreateThreadEx(PHANDLE ThreadHandle, ACCESS_MASK DesiredAccess,
                               PVOID ObjectAttributes, HANDLE ProcessHandle,
                               PVOID StartRoutine, PVOID Argument,
                               ULONG CreateFlags, SIZE_T ZeroBits,
                               SIZE_T StackSize, SIZE_T MaxStackSize,
                               PVOID AttributeList);

    NTSTATUS NtClose(HANDLE Handle);

private:
    // Syscall numbers (resolved at runtime)
    DWORD m_sysNtOpenProcess = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtAllocateVirtualMemory = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtWriteVirtualMemory = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtReadVirtualMemory = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtFreeVirtualMemory = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtProtectVirtualMemory = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtCreateThreadEx = 0;
    DWORD m_sysNtClose = 0;

    // Resolve syscall number from ntdll on disk
    DWORD GetSyscallNumber(const char* functionName);

    // Execute a syscall with given number and args
    // Implemented in assembly
};

// Global instance
extern DirectSyscall g_Syscall;
```

`Loader/src/byovd.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../include/byovd.h"
#include <winioctl.h>
#include <Psapi.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "psapi.lib")

// ============================================================================
// BYOVD Kernel Mapper — Intel iqvw64e.sys (NAL driver)
// Uses MmMapIoSpace via IOCTL 0x80862007 for physical memory access
// ============================================================================

ByovdMapper::~ByovdMapper() { Cleanup(); }

// ============================================================================
// SCM — load/unload Intel NAL driver
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::LoadVulnDriver(const std::string& path) {
    char fp[MAX_PATH];
    GetFullPathNameA(path.c_str(), MAX_PATH, fp, nullptr);

    if (GetFileAttributesA(fp) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
        m_lastError = "iqvw64e.sys not found: " + std::string(fp);
        return false;
    }

    m_scManager = OpenSCManagerA(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ALL_ACCESS);
    if (!m_scManager) {
        m_lastError = "OpenSCManager failed (need admin)";
        return false;
    }

    // Clean up stale service
    SC_HANDLE existing = OpenServiceA(m_scManager, m_vulnServiceName.c_str(), SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS);
    if (existing) {
        SERVICE_STATUS ss;
        ControlService(existing, SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP, &ss);
        DeleteService(existing);
        CloseServiceHandle(existing);
        Sleep(500);
    }

    // Build NT device path
    std::string ntPath = std::string("\\??\\") + fp;

    m_scService = CreateServiceA(
        m_scManager, m_vulnServiceName.c_str(), m_vulnServiceName.c_str(),
        SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS, SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER, SERVICE_DEMAND_START,
        SERVICE_ERROR_NORMAL, ntPath.c_str(),
        nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr
    );

    if (!m_scService) {
        DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
        if (err == static_cast<DWORD>(ERROR_SERVICE_EXISTS)) {
            m_scService = OpenServiceA(m_scManager, m_vulnServiceName.c_str(), SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS);
        }
        if (!m_scService) {
            m_lastError = "CreateService failed (err: " + std::to_string(::GetLastError()) + ")";
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (!StartServiceA(m_scService, 0, nullptr)) {
        DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
        if (err != static_cast<DWORD>(ERROR_SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING)) {
            m_lastError = "StartService failed (err: " + std::to_string(err) + ")";
            DeleteService(m_scService);
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::UnloadVulnDriver() {
    if (m_hDevice != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        CloseHandle(m_hDevice);
        m_hDevice = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
    if (m_scService) {
        SERVICE_STATUS ss;
        ControlService(m_scService, SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP, &ss);
        DeleteService(m_scService);
        CloseServiceHandle(m_scService);
        m_scService = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_scManager) {
        CloseServiceHandle(m_scManager);
        m_scManager = nullptr;
    }
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Intel NAL — MapIoSpace / UnmapIoSpace via IOCTL 0x80862007
// ============================================================================

static bool NalMapIoSpace(HANDLE hDevice, uint64_t physAddr, uint32_t size, uint64_t& outVirt) {
    MAP_IO_SPACE_BUFFER_INFO buf = {};
    buf.case_number             = NAL_CASE_MAP_IO_SPACE;
    buf.physical_address_to_map = physAddr;
    buf.size                    = size;

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        hDevice, INTEL_NAL_IOCTL,
        &buf, sizeof(buf),
        &buf, sizeof(buf),
        &bytesReturned, nullptr
    );

    if (!ok || buf.return_virtual_address == 0)
        return false;

    outVirt = buf.return_virtual_address;
    return true;
}

static bool NalUnmapIoSpace(HANDLE hDevice, uint64_t virtAddr, uint32_t size) {
    UNMAP_IO_SPACE_BUFFER_INFO buf = {};
    buf.case_number      = NAL_CASE_UNMAP_IO_SPACE;
    buf.virt_address     = virtAddr;
    buf.number_of_bytes  = size;

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    return DeviceIoControl(
        hDevice, INTEL_NAL_IOCTL,
        &buf, sizeof(buf),
        &buf, sizeof(buf),
        &bytesReturned, nullptr
    ) != FALSE;
}

// ============================================================================
// Physical Memory R/W via MapIoSpace
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::ReadPhysical(uint64_t pa, void* buf, uint32_t sz) {
    if (sz == 0) return true;

    uint64_t mapped = 0;
    if (!NalMapIoSpace(m_hDevice, pa, sz, mapped))
        return false;

    // The mapped address is a kernel virtual address — we can read it via
    // the NAL driver's copy memory functionality
    // But since MmMapIoSpace returns a SYSTEM address, we need to use
    // the driver to copy FROM that address TO our usermode buffer

    // Use CopyMemory case to copy from mapped kernel addr to our buffer
    COPY_MEMORY_BUFFER_INFO copyBuf = {};
    copyBuf.case_number  = 0x33; // CopyMemory case number
    copyBuf.source       = mapped;
    copyBuf.destination  = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(buf);
    copyBuf.length       = sz;

    DWORD br = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice, INTEL_NAL_IOCTL,
        &copyBuf, sizeof(copyBuf),
        &copyBuf, sizeof(copyBuf),
        &br, nullptr
    );

    NalUnmapIoSpace(m_hDevice, mapped, sz);
    return ok != FALSE;
}

bool ByovdMapper::WritePhysical(uint64_t pa, const void* buf, uint32_t sz) {
    if (sz == 0) return true;

    uint64_t mapped = 0;
    if (!NalMapIoSpace(m_hDevice, pa, sz, mapped))
        return false;

    COPY_MEMORY_BUFFER_INFO copyBuf = {};
    copyBuf.case_number  = 0x33;
    copyBuf.source       = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(buf);
    copyBuf.destination  = mapped;
    copyBuf.length       = sz;

    DWORD br = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice, INTEL_NAL_IOCTL,
        &copyBuf, sizeof(copyBuf),
        &copyBuf, sizeof(copyBuf),
        &br, nullptr
    );

    NalUnmapIoSpace(m_hDevice, mapped, sz);
    return ok != FALSE;
}

// ============================================================================
// Page Table Walking — virtual to physical translation
// ============================================================================

uint64_t ByovdMapper::VirtToPhys(uint64_t cr3, uint64_t va) {
    uint64_t e, a;

    // PML4
    a = (cr3 & PHYS_ADDR_MASK) + ((va >> PML4_SHIFT) & TABLE_INDEX_MASK) * 8;
    if (!ReadPhysical(a, &e, 8) || !(e & PAGE_PRESENT)) return 0;

    // PDPT
    a = (e & PHYS_ADDR_MASK) + ((va >> PDPT_SHIFT) & TABLE_INDEX_MASK) * 8;
    if (!ReadPhysical(a, &e, 8) || !(e & PAGE_PRESENT)) return 0;
    if (e & PAGE_LARGE) return (e & 0xFFFFFFC0000000ULL) | (va & 0x3FFFFFFFULL);

    // PD
    a = (e & PHYS_ADDR_MASK) + ((va >> PD_SHIFT) & TABLE_INDEX_MASK) * 8;
    if (!ReadPhysical(a, &e, 8) || !(e & PAGE_PRESENT)) return 0;
    if (e & PAGE_LARGE) return (e & 0xFFFFFFFE00000ULL) | (va & 0x1FFFFFULL);

    // PT
    a = (e & PHYS_ADDR_MASK) + ((va >> PT_SHIFT) & TABLE_INDEX_MASK) * 8;
    if (!ReadPhysical(a, &e, 8) || !(e & PAGE_PRESENT)) return 0;

    return (e & PHYS_ADDR_MASK) | (va & PAGE_MASK_4KB);
}

// ============================================================================
// Kernel Virtual R/W via page table translation
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::ReadKernelVirtual(uint64_t va, void* buf, uint32_t sz) {
    if (!m_systemCr3) return false;
    uint8_t* d = (uint8_t*)buf;
    uint32_t rem = sz;
    uint64_t cur = va;

    while (rem > 0) {
        uint64_t pa = VirtToPhys(m_systemCr3, cur);
        if (!pa) return false;

        uint32_t off = (uint32_t)(cur & PAGE_MASK_4KB);
        uint32_t chunk = PAGE_SIZE_4KB - off;
        if (chunk > rem) chunk = rem;

        if (!ReadPhysical(pa, d, chunk)) return false;
        d += chunk; cur += chunk; rem -= chunk;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::WriteKernelVirtual(uint64_t va, const void* buf, uint32_t sz) {
    if (!m_systemCr3) return false;
    const uint8_t* s = (const uint8_t*)buf;
    uint32_t rem = sz;
    uint64_t cur = va;

    while (rem > 0) {
        uint64_t pa = VirtToPhys(m_systemCr3, cur);
        if (!pa) return false;

        uint32_t off = (uint32_t)(cur & PAGE_MASK_4KB);
        uint32_t chunk = PAGE_SIZE_4KB - off;
        if (chunk > rem) chunk = rem;

        if (!WritePhysical(pa, s, chunk)) return false;
        s += chunk; cur += chunk; rem -= chunk;
    }
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Kernel Discovery
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::FindSystemCr3() {
    LPVOID drv[1024]; DWORD need;
    if (!EnumDeviceDrivers(drv, sizeof(drv), &need)) {
        m_lastError = "EnumDeviceDrivers failed";
        return false;
    }
    m_ntoskrnlBase = (uint64_t)drv[0];
    printf("[BYOVD] ntoskrnl: 0x%llX\n", m_ntoskrnlBase);

    printf("[BYOVD] Scanning for system CR3...\n");

    for (uint64_t c = 0x1000; c < 0x40000000ULL; c += 0x1000) {
        if ((c & 0xFFFFFFF) == 0) {
            printf("[BYOVD] Scanned 0x%llX...\r", c);
            fflush(stdout);
        }

        // Quick filter: check kernel PML4 entry exists
        uint64_t kernelPml4Idx = (m_ntoskrnlBase >> PML4_SHIFT) & TABLE_INDEX_MASK;
        uint64_t pml4e = 0;
        if (!ReadPhysical(c + kernelPml4Idx * 8, &pml4e, 8)) continue;
        if (!(pml4e & PAGE_PRESENT)) continue;

        // Verify KUSER_SHARED_DATA mapping
        uint64_t kusdPhys = VirtToPhys(c, 0xFFFFF78000000000ULL + 0x260);
        if (!kusdPhys) continue;

        uint32_t ntMajor = 0;
        if (!ReadPhysical(kusdPhys, &ntMajor, 4)) continue;
        if (ntMajor != 10) continue;

        // Verify ntoskrnl MZ header
        uint64_t ntPhys = VirtToPhys(c, m_ntoskrnlBase);
        if (!ntPhys) continue;

        uint16_t mz = 0;
        if (!ReadPhysical(ntPhys, &mz, 2)) continue;
        if (mz != 0x5A4D) continue;

        printf("\n[BYOVD] CR3 found: 0x%llX\n", c);
        m_systemCr3 = c;
        return true;
    }

    printf("\n");
    m_lastError = "CR3 not found in 1GB scan";
    return false;
}

bool ByovdMapper::FindNtoskrnlBase() {
    if (m_ntoskrnlBase) return true;
    LPVOID d[1024]; DWORD n;
    if (!EnumDeviceDrivers(d, sizeof(d), &n)) return false;
    m_ntoskrnlBase = (uint64_t)d[0];
    return m_ntoskrnlBase != 0;
}

uint64_t ByovdMapper::GetKernelExport(const char* fn) {
    if (!m_ntoskrnlBase || !m_systemCr3) return 0;

    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = {};
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase, &dos, sizeof(dos));
    if (dos.e_magic != 0x5A4D) return 0;

    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt = {};
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + dos.e_lfanew, &nt, sizeof(nt));

    auto& ed = nt.OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
    if (!ed.VirtualAddress) return 0;

    IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exp = {};
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + ed.VirtualAddress, &exp, sizeof(exp));

    std::vector<uint32_t> names(exp.NumberOfNames), funcs(exp.NumberOfFunctions);
    std::vector<uint16_t> ords(exp.NumberOfNames);
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + exp.AddressOfNames, names.data(), exp.NumberOfNames * 4);
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + exp.AddressOfFunctions, funcs.data(), exp.NumberOfFunctions * 4);
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + exp.AddressOfNameOrdinals, ords.data(), exp.NumberOfNames * 2);

    for (DWORD i = 0; i < exp.NumberOfNames; i++) {
        char name[256] = {};
        ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + names[i], name, 255);
        if (strcmp(name, fn) == 0 && ords[i] < exp.NumberOfFunctions)
            return m_ntoskrnlBase + funcs[ords[i]];
    }
    return 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// Kernel pool allocation
// ============================================================================

uint64_t ByovdMapper::AllocateKernelPool(uint32_t size) {
    uint64_t alloc = GetKernelExport("ExAllocatePool2");
    if (!alloc) alloc = GetKernelExport("ExAllocatePoolWithTag");
    if (!alloc) { m_lastError = "Pool allocator not found"; return 0; }
    printf("[BYOVD] Pool allocator: 0x%llX\n", alloc);

    // Find space after ntoskrnl image for driver mapping
    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = {};
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase, &dos, sizeof(dos));
    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt = {};
    ReadKernelVirtual(m_ntoskrnlBase + dos.e_lfanew, &nt, sizeof(nt));

    uint64_t secAddr = m_ntoskrnlBase + dos.e_lfanew + sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64);
    uint64_t lastEnd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nt.FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++) {
        IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER s = {};
        ReadKernelVirtual(secAddr + i * sizeof(s), &s, sizeof(s));
        uint64_t e = m_ntoskrnlBase + s.VirtualAddress + s.Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (e > lastEnd) lastEnd = e;
    }
    lastEnd = (lastEnd + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFULL;
    printf("[BYOVD] Mapping at: 0x%llX (size: 0x%X)\n", lastEnd, size);
    return lastEnd;
}

// ============================================================================
// Driver mapping steps
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::CopyDriverSections(uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img, PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt) {
    auto* s = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, s++) {
        if (!s->SizeOfRawData) continue;
        uint32_t sz = (s->SizeOfRawData < s->Misc.VirtualSize)
                      ? s->SizeOfRawData : s->Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (!WriteKernelVirtual(base + s->VirtualAddress, img + s->PointerToRawData, sz))
            return false;
        printf("[BYOVD]   %-8.8s -> 0x%llX (%u bytes)\n",
               s->Name, base + s->VirtualAddress, sz);
    }
    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::FixRelocations(uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img,
                                  PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt, int64_t d) {
    if (!d) return true;
    auto& rd = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
    if (!rd.VirtualAddress) return true;

    auto* b = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)(img + rd.VirtualAddress);
    const uint8_t* end = img + rd.VirtualAddress + rd.Size;

    while ((const uint8_t*)b < end && b->VirtualAddress) {
        DWORD count = (b->SizeOfBlock - sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION)) / 2;
        const WORD* en = (const WORD*)(b + 1);

        for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int type = en[i] >> 12;
            int offset = en[i] & 0xFFF;
            uint64_t addr = base + b->VirtualAddress + offset;

            if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64) {
                uint64_t v; ReadKernelVirtual(addr, &v, 8);
                v += d; WriteKernelVirtual(addr, &v, 8);
            } else if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW) {
                uint32_t v; ReadKernelVirtual(addr, &v, 4);
                v += (uint32_t)d; WriteKernelVirtual(addr, &v, 4);
            }
        }
        b = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)((const uint8_t*)b + b->SizeOfBlock);
    }
    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::ResolveDriverImports(uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img,
                                        PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt) {
    auto& id = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
    if (!id.VirtualAddress) return true;

    auto* desc = (const IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR*)(img + id.VirtualAddress);
    while (desc->Name) {
        const char* dll = (const char*)(img + desc->Name);
        printf("[BYOVD]   Imports from: %s\n", dll);

        uint64_t ilt = desc->OriginalFirstThunk ? desc->OriginalFirstThunk : desc->FirstThunk;
        auto* th = (const IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64*)(img + ilt);
        uint64_t iat = base + desc->FirstThunk;
        int n = 0;

        while (th->u1.AddressOfData) {
            if (!IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL64(th->u1.Ordinal)) {
                auto* h = (const IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME*)(
                    img + (th->u1.AddressOfData & 0x7FFFFFFF));
                uint64_t fa = GetKernelExport(h->Name);
                if (fa) { WriteKernelVirtual(iat, &fa, 8); n++; }
                else printf("[BYOVD]   UNRESOLVED: %s\n", h->Name);
            }
            th++; iat += 8;
        }
        printf("[BYOVD]   Resolved %d\n", n);
        desc++;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::CallDriverEntry(uint64_t ep, uint64_t base) {
    printf("[BYOVD] Driver mapped at 0x%llX, entry: 0x%llX\n", base, ep);
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Public API
// ============================================================================

bool ByovdMapper::Initialize(const std::string& vulnPath) {
    printf("[BYOVD] Loading Intel NAL driver: %s\n", vulnPath.c_str());

    if (!LoadVulnDriver(vulnPath))
        return false;

    printf("[BYOVD] Driver loaded via SCM\n");

    // Open device
    m_hDevice = CreateFileA(
        INTEL_NAL_DEVICE_NAME,
        GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
        nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr
    );

    if (m_hDevice == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        printf("[BYOVD] Failed to open device. GetLastError: %lu\n", ::GetLastError());
        m_lastError = "Failed to open \\\\.\\Nal device";
        UnloadVulnDriver();
        return false;
    }
    printf("[BYOVD] Device opened: %s\n", INTEL_NAL_DEVICE_NAME);

    // Test physical memory access — map 1 page at physical 0x1000
    uint64_t testMapped = 0;
    if (NalMapIoSpace(m_hDevice, 0x1000, 0x1000, testMapped)) {
        printf("[BYOVD] Physical memory access CONFIRMED (mapped 0x1000 -> 0x%llX)\n", testMapped);
        NalUnmapIoSpace(m_hDevice, testMapped, 0x1000);
    } else {
        printf("[BYOVD] MapIoSpace test FAILED. GetLastError: %lu\n", ::GetLastError());
        m_lastError = "MapIoSpace failed — driver may not support this operation";
        UnloadVulnDriver();
        return false;
    }

    // Find system CR3
    if (!FindSystemCr3()) {
        UnloadVulnDriver();
        return false;
    }

    m_initialized = true;
    return true;
}

bool ByovdMapper::MapDriver(const std::string& drvPath) {
    if (!m_initialized) { m_lastError = "Not initialized"; return false; }

    std::ifstream f(drvPath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f.is_open()) { m_lastError = "Cannot open driver file"; return false; }

    size_t sz = (size_t)f.tellg(); f.seekg(0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> img(sz);
    f.read((char*)img.data(), sz); f.close();

    auto* dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)img.data();
    auto* nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(img.data() + dos->e_lfanew);

    uint64_t base = AllocateKernelPool((uint32_t)nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage);
    if (!base) return false;

    printf("[BYOVD] Copying sections...\n");
    if (!CopyDriverSections(base, img.data(), nt)) return false;

    int64_t delta = (int64_t)(base - nt->OptionalHeader.ImageBase);
    printf("[BYOVD] Fixing relocations (delta: 0x%llX)...\n", delta);
    if (!FixRelocations(base, img.data(), nt, delta)) return false;

    printf("[BYOVD] Resolving imports...\n");
    if (!ResolveDriverImports(base, img.data(), nt)) return false;

    return CallDriverEntry(base + nt->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint, base);
}

void ByovdMapper::Cleanup() {
    printf("[BYOVD] Cleaning up Intel NAL driver...\n");
    UnloadVulnDriver();
    m_initialized = false;
}
```

`Loader/src/driver_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../include/driver_loader.h"
#include "../../Shared/shared.h"
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// DriverLoader — SCM-based kernel driver loading
// ============================================================================

DriverLoader::~DriverLoader() {
    if (m_loaded) {
        Unload();
    }
    if (m_scService) CloseServiceHandle(m_scService);
    if (m_scManager) CloseServiceHandle(m_scManager);
}

void DriverLoader::SetError(const char* context) {
    DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
    char buf[512];
    FormatMessageA(
        FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM | FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
        nullptr, err, 0, buf, sizeof(buf), nullptr
    );
    m_lastError = std::string(context) + ": " + buf;
    // Remove trailing newline
    while (!m_lastError.empty() &&
           (m_lastError.back() == '\n' || m_lastError.back() == '\r'))
        m_lastError.pop_back();
}

// ============================================================================
// Load — register and start driver via Service Control Manager
// ============================================================================
bool DriverLoader::Load(const std::string& driverPath, const std::string& serviceName) {
    m_serviceName = serviceName;

    // Get absolute path
    char fullPath[MAX_PATH];
    if (!GetFullPathNameA(driverPath.c_str(), MAX_PATH, fullPath, nullptr)) {
        SetError("GetFullPathName");
        return false;
    }

    // Verify file exists
    DWORD attr = GetFileAttributesA(fullPath);
    if (attr == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
        m_lastError = "Driver file not found: " + std::string(fullPath);
        return false;
    }

    // Open SCM
    m_scManager = OpenSCManagerA(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ALL_ACCESS);
    if (!m_scManager) {
        SetError("OpenSCManager (are you running as admin?)");
        return false;
    }

    // Try to open existing service first
    m_scService = OpenServiceA(m_scManager, serviceName.c_str(), SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS);

    if (m_scService) {
        // Service exists — stop and delete it first (stale from previous run)
        printf("[Loader] Cleaning up old service...\n");
        StopService();
        DeleteService();
        CloseServiceHandle(m_scService);
        m_scService = nullptr;
    }

    // Create new service
    // NT path format: \??\C:\path\to\driver.sys
    std::string ntPath = "\\??\\" + std::string(fullPath);

    m_scService = CreateServiceA(
        m_scManager,
        serviceName.c_str(),        // Service name
        serviceName.c_str(),        // Display name
        SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS,
        SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER,      // Kernel driver type
        SERVICE_DEMAND_START,       // Manual start
        SERVICE_ERROR_NORMAL,
        ntPath.c_str(),             // Path to .sys file
        nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr
    );

    if (!m_scService) {
        DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
        if (err == ERROR_SERVICE_EXISTS) {
            // Race condition — try opening again
            m_scService = OpenServiceA(m_scManager, serviceName.c_str(), SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS);
            if (!m_scService) {
                SetError("OpenService (retry)");
                return false;
            }
        } else {
            SetError("CreateService");
            return false;
        }
    }

    // Start the service (loads the driver)
    if (!StartServiceA(m_scService, 0, nullptr)) {
        DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
        if (err == ERROR_SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING) {
            printf("[Loader] Driver already running\n");
            m_loaded = true;
            return true;
        }
        SetError("StartService");
        // Clean up the service on failure
        DeleteService();
        return false;
    }

    m_loaded = true;
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Unload — stop and remove the driver service
// ============================================================================
bool DriverLoader::Unload() {
    if (!m_scService)
        return false;

    bool ok = StopService();
    ok = DeleteService() && ok;

    m_loaded = false;
    return ok;
}

bool DriverLoader::StopService() {
    if (!m_scService) return false;

    SERVICE_STATUS status;
    if (!ControlService(m_scService, SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP, &status)) {
        DWORD err = ::GetLastError();
        if (err != ERROR_SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool DriverLoader::DeleteService() {
    if (!m_scService) return false;
    return ::DeleteService(m_scService) != 0;
}

bool DriverLoader::IsLoaded() const {
    return m_loaded;
}

// ============================================================================
// IsDeviceReady — check if the driver device is accessible
// ============================================================================
bool DriverLoader::IsDeviceReady() const {
    // Legacy device check — not used with kdmapper/syscall hook approach
    HANDLE hDevice = CreateFileA(
        "\\\\.\\CS2Drv",
        GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
        nullptr,
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        nullptr
    );

    if (hDevice == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        return false;

    CloseHandle(hDevice);
    return true;
}
```

```cpp
#include "../include/injector.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// Injector — shared memory communication with kernel driver
// Opens named section "Global\NexusSharedMem" created by driver
// ============================================================================

Injector::~Injector() {
    if (m_shared) UnmapViewOfFile(m_shared);
    if (m_hSection) CloseHandle(m_hSection);
}

bool Injector::ConnectToDriver() {
    // Try to open the named section multiple times (driver might need a moment)
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
        m_hSection = OpenFileMappingW(FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, NEXUS_SECTION_NAME);
        if (m_hSection) break;
        Sleep(500);
    }

    if (!m_hSection) {
        m_lastError = "Cannot open shared section (driver not loaded?)";
        return false;
    }

    m_shared = (PNEXUS_SHARED)MapViewOfFile(
        m_hSection, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, sizeof(NEXUS_SHARED)
    );

    if (!m_shared) {
        m_lastError = "Cannot map shared section";
        CloseHandle(m_hSection);
        m_hSection = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    // Verify magic
    if (m_shared->Magic != NEXUS_MAGIC) {
        m_lastError = "Shared section magic mismatch";
        UnmapViewOfFile(m_shared);
        CloseHandle(m_hSection);
        m_shared = nullptr;
        m_hSection = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    // Test command
    if (!SendCommand(CMD_TEST)) {
        m_lastError = "Driver test command failed";
        return false;
    }

    if (m_shared->Output != NEXUS_MAGIC) {
        m_lastError = "Driver test response mismatch";
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

bool Injector::SendCommand(ULONG cmd, DWORD pid, uint64_t addr,
                            uint64_t buf, uint64_t size,
                            const wchar_t* modName) {
    if (!m_shared) return false;

    // Wait for driver to be free
    int timeout = 5000; // 5 seconds
    while (m_shared->Command != CMD_NONE && timeout > 0) {
        Sleep(1);
        timeout--;
    }
    if (timeout <= 0) return false;

    // Fill request
    m_shared->ProcessId = pid;
    m_shared->Address   = addr;
    m_shared->Buffer    = buf;
    m_shared->Size      = size;
    m_shared->Output    = 0;
    m_shared->Status    = 0;

    if (modName) {
        wcsncpy_s((wchar_t*)m_shared->ModuleName, 256, modName, 255);
    }

    // Issue command (driver polls for this)
    m_shared->Command = cmd;

    // Wait for completion (driver sets Command back to CMD_NONE)
    timeout = 10000; // 10 seconds
    while (m_shared->Command != CMD_NONE && timeout > 0) {
        Sleep(1);
        timeout--;
    }

    return timeout > 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// Driver communication wrappers
// ============================================================================

bool Injector::DriverRead(DWORD pid, uint64_t addr, void* buffer, DWORD size) {
    if (!SendCommand(CMD_READ_MEMORY, pid, addr,
                     reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(buffer), size))
        return false;
    return m_shared->Status == 0; // STATUS_SUCCESS
}

bool Injector::DriverWrite(DWORD pid, uint64_t addr, const void* buffer, DWORD size) {
    if (!SendCommand(CMD_WRITE_MEMORY, pid, addr,
                     reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(buffer), size))
        return false;
    return m_shared->Status == 0;
}

uint64_t Injector::DriverGetModuleBase(DWORD pid, const wchar_t* moduleName) {
    if (!SendCommand(CMD_GET_MODULE_BASE, pid, 0, 0, 0, moduleName))
        return 0;
    return (m_shared->Status == 0) ? m_shared->Output : 0;
}

uint64_t Injector::DriverAllocate(DWORD pid, uint64_t size, DWORD protection) {
    if (!SendCommand(CMD_ALLOC_MEMORY, pid, 0, 0, size))
        return 0;
    return (m_shared->Status == 0) ? m_shared->Output : 0;
}

bool Injector::DriverFree(DWORD pid, uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    return SendCommand(CMD_FREE_MEMORY, pid, addr, 0, size)
           && m_shared->Status == 0;
}

bool Injector::DriverHideModule(DWORD pid, uint64_t moduleBase) {
    return SendCommand(CMD_HIDE_MODULE, pid, moduleBase)
           && m_shared->Status == 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// Manual mapping — same as before
// ============================================================================

bool Injector::CopySections(DWORD pid, uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img,
                             PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt) {
    auto* s = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, s++) {
        if (!s->SizeOfRawData) continue;
        DWORD sz = (s->SizeOfRawData < s->Misc.VirtualSize)
                   ? s->SizeOfRawData : s->Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (!DriverWrite(pid, base + s->VirtualAddress,
                         img + s->PointerToRawData, sz)) {
            m_lastError = "Failed to write section";
            return false;
        }
        printf("[Loader]   %-8.8s -> 0x%llX (%u bytes)\n",
               s->Name, base + s->VirtualAddress, sz);
    }
    return true;
}

bool Injector::ProcessRelocations(DWORD pid, uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img,
                                   PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt, int64_t delta) {
    if (!delta) return true;
    auto& rd = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
    if (!rd.VirtualAddress) return true;
    auto* b = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)(img + rd.VirtualAddress);
    const uint8_t* end = img + rd.VirtualAddress + rd.Size;
    while ((const uint8_t*)b < end && b->VirtualAddress) {
        DWORD cnt = (b->SizeOfBlock - sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION)) / 2;
        const WORD* e = (const WORD*)(b + 1);
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
            int type = e[i] >> 12, off = e[i] & 0xFFF;
            uint64_t addr = base + b->VirtualAddress + off;
            if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64) {
                uint64_t v = 0; DriverRead(pid, addr, &v, 8);
                v += delta; DriverWrite(pid, addr, &v, 8);
            } else if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW) {
                uint32_t v = 0; DriverRead(pid, addr, &v, 4);
                v += (uint32_t)delta; DriverWrite(pid, addr, &v, 4);
            }
        }
        b = (const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)((const uint8_t*)b + b->SizeOfBlock);
    }
    return true;
}

bool Injector::ResolveImports(DWORD pid, uint64_t base, const uint8_t* img,
                               PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt) {
    auto& id = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
    if (!id.VirtualAddress) return true;
    auto* desc = (const IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR*)(img + id.VirtualAddress);
    while (desc->Name) {
        const char* dll = (const char*)(img + desc->Name);
        wchar_t wdll[256]; MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, dll, -1, wdll, 256);
        uint64_t dllBase = DriverGetModuleBase(pid, wdll);
        if (!dllBase) { printf("[Loader]   WARNING: %s not found\n", dll); desc++; continue; }

        IMAGE_DOS_HEADER rDos = {}; DriverRead(pid, dllBase, &rDos, sizeof(rDos));
        IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 rNt = {}; DriverRead(pid, dllBase + rDos.e_lfanew, &rNt, sizeof(rNt));
        auto& ed = rNt.OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
        if (!ed.VirtualAddress) { desc++; continue; }

        IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exp = {};
        DriverRead(pid, dllBase + ed.VirtualAddress, &exp, sizeof(exp));

        std::vector<uint32_t> names(exp.NumberOfNames), funcs(exp.NumberOfFunctions);
        std::vector<uint16_t> ords(exp.NumberOfNames);
        if (exp.NumberOfNames > 0) {
            DriverRead(pid, dllBase + exp.AddressOfNames, names.data(), exp.NumberOfNames * 4);
            DriverRead(pid, dllBase + exp.AddressOfNameOrdinals, ords.data(), exp.NumberOfNames * 2);
        }
        if (exp.NumberOfFunctions > 0)
            DriverRead(pid, dllBase + exp.AddressOfFunctions, funcs.data(), exp.NumberOfFunctions * 4);

        uint64_t ilt = desc->OriginalFirstThunk ? desc->OriginalFirstThunk : desc->FirstThunk;
        auto* th = (const IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64*)(img + ilt);
        uint64_t iat = base + desc->FirstThunk;
        int n = 0;
        while (th->u1.AddressOfData) {
            uint64_t fa = 0;
            if (!IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL64(th->u1.Ordinal)) {
                auto* h = (const IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME*)(img + (th->u1.AddressOfData & 0x7FFFFFFF));
                for (DWORD j = 0; j < exp.NumberOfNames; j++) {
                    char rn[256] = {}; DriverRead(pid, dllBase + names[j], rn, 255);
                    if (strcmp(h->Name, rn) == 0 && ords[j] < exp.NumberOfFunctions) {
                        fa = dllBase + funcs[ords[j]]; break;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                WORD ord = (WORD)(IMAGE_ORDINAL64(th->u1.Ordinal) - exp.Base);
                if (ord < exp.NumberOfFunctions) fa = dllBase + funcs[ord];
            }
            if (fa) { DriverWrite(pid, iat, &fa, 8); n++; }
            th++; iat += 8;
        }
        printf("[Loader]   %s: %d resolved\n", dll, n);
        desc++;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Injector::CallEntryPoint(DWORD pid, uint64_t base, uint64_t epRva) {
    uint64_t ep = base + epRva;
    uint8_t sc[] = {
        0x48, 0xB9, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,
        0xBA, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        0x4D, 0x31, 0xC0,
        0x48, 0xB8, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,
        0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x28,
        0xFF, 0xD0,
        0x48, 0x83, 0xC4, 0x28,
        0xC3
    };
    *(uint64_t*)&sc[2] = base;
    *(uint64_t*)&sc[20] = ep;

    uint64_t scAddr = DriverAllocate(pid, sizeof(sc), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    if (!scAddr) { m_lastError = "Shellcode alloc failed"; return false; }
    DriverWrite(pid, scAddr, sc, sizeof(sc));

    HANDLE hp = OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
    if (!hp) { m_lastError = "OpenProcess failed"; return false; }
    HANDLE ht = CreateRemoteThread(hp, nullptr, 0,
        (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)scAddr, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (!ht) { m_lastError = "CreateRemoteThread failed"; CloseHandle(hp); return false; }
    WaitForSingleObject(ht, 10000);
    CloseHandle(ht); CloseHandle(hp);
    DriverFree(pid, scAddr, sizeof(sc));
    return true;
}

bool Injector::Inject(const std::string& dllPath, DWORD pid) {
    std::ifstream f(dllPath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f.is_open()) { m_lastError = "Cannot open DLL"; return false; }
    size_t sz = (size_t)f.tellg(); f.seekg(0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> img(sz);
    f.read((char*)img.data(), sz); f.close();

    auto* dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)img.data();
    auto* nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(img.data() + dos->e_lfanew);

    printf("[Loader] Allocating %u bytes...\n", nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage);
    uint64_t base = DriverAllocate(pid, nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    if (!base) { m_lastError = "Remote alloc failed"; return false; }
    printf("[Loader] Base: 0x%llX\n", base);

    printf("[Loader] Copying sections...\n");
    if (!CopySections(pid, base, img.data(), nt)) return false;

    int64_t delta = (int64_t)(base - nt->OptionalHeader.ImageBase);
    printf("[Loader] Relocations...\n");
    if (!ProcessRelocations(pid, base, img.data(), nt, delta)) return false;

    printf("[Loader] Imports...\n");
    if (!ResolveImports(pid, base, img.data(), nt)) return false;

    printf("[Loader] DllMain...\n");
    if (!CallEntryPoint(pid, base, nt->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint)) return false;

    printf("[Loader] Erasing headers...\n");
    std::vector<uint8_t> z(0x1000, 0);
    DriverWrite(pid, base, z.data(), (DWORD)0x1000);

    printf("[Loader] Hiding from PEB...\n");
    DriverHideModule(pid, base);

    return true;
}
```

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Process utilities

static DWORD FindProcess(const char* name) {
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    PROCESSENTRY32 pe = {}; pe.dwSize = sizeof(pe);
    if (Process32First(snap, &pe)) {
        do { if (_stricmp(pe.szExeFile, name) == 0) { CloseHandle(snap); return pe.th32ProcessID; } }
        while (Process32Next(snap, &pe));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap); return 0;
}

static DWORD WaitForProcessAnim(const char* name, int sec) {
    for (int i = 0; i < sec * 2; i++) {
        DWORD pid = FindProcess(name);
        if (pid) return pid;
        ClearLine(); printf("  "); Clr::Gold(); printf("%s ", SPIN[i%10]);
        Clr::Gray(); printf("Waiting for %s... (%ds)", name, i/2);
        Reset(); fflush(stdout); Sleep(500);
    }
    ClearLine(); return 0;
}

static std::string GetFilePath(const std::string& f) {
    char exe[MAX_PATH]; GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
    return (fs::path(exe).parent_path() / f).string();
}

// ============================================================================
// Manual Map Injector — pure usermode, no kernel driver
// ============================================================================

static bool ManualMapInject(const std::string& dllPath, DWORD pid) {
    // 1. Read DLL
    printf("[Inject] Reading: %s\n", dllPath.c_str());
    std::ifstream f(dllPath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f.is_open()) { printf("[Inject] Cannot open DLL\n"); return false; }
    size_t fileSize = (size_t)f.tellg(); f.seekg(0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> raw(fileSize);
    f.read((char*)raw.data(), fileSize); f.close();

    auto* dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)raw.data();
    if (dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) { printf("[Inject] Bad DOS sig\n"); return false; }
    auto* nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(raw.data() + dos->e_lfanew);
    if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) { printf("[Inject] Bad PE sig\n"); return false; }

    DWORD imageSize = nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;

    // 2. Build local image — do ALL processing locally, write once to remote
    printf("[Inject] Building image locally (%u bytes)...\n", imageSize);
    std::vector<uint8_t> localImage(imageSize, 0);

    // Copy headers
    memcpy(localImage.data(), raw.data(), nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfHeaders);

    // Copy sections to correct virtual offsets
    auto* section = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, section++) {
        if (!section->SizeOfRawData) continue;
        DWORD sz = (section->SizeOfRawData < section->Misc.VirtualSize)
                   ? section->SizeOfRawData : section->Misc.VirtualSize;
        memcpy(localImage.data() + section->VirtualAddress,
               raw.data() + section->PointerToRawData, sz);
        printf("[Inject]   %-8.8s at offset 0x%X (%u bytes)\n",
               section->Name, section->VirtualAddress, sz);
    }

    // 3. Open target process via direct syscall
    HANDLE hProc = nullptr;
    NTSTATUS ntStatus = g_Syscall.NtOpenProcess(&hProc, PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, pid);
    if (ntStatus != 0 || !hProc) {
        printf("[Inject] NtOpenProcess failed: 0x%08X\n", ntStatus);
        return false;
    }
    printf("[Inject] Process opened via syscall (PID: %lu)\n", pid);

    // 4. Allocate memory in target via direct syscall
    LPVOID remoteBase = nullptr;
    SIZE_T allocSize = imageSize;
    ntStatus = g_Syscall.NtAllocateVirtualMemory(
        hProc, &remoteBase, &allocSize,
        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE
    );
    if (ntStatus != 0 || !remoteBase) {
        printf("[Inject] NtAllocateVirtualMemory failed: 0x%08X\n", ntStatus);
        g_Syscall.NtClose(hProc); return false;
    }
    printf("[Inject] Remote base: 0x%p\n", remoteBase);

    // 5. Apply relocations LOCALLY (no remote read/write needed)
    int64_t delta = (int64_t)((uint64_t)remoteBase - nt->OptionalHeader.ImageBase);
    if (delta != 0) {
        auto& rd = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
        if (rd.VirtualAddress) {
            auto* block = (IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)(localImage.data() + rd.VirtualAddress);
            uint8_t* end = localImage.data() + rd.VirtualAddress + rd.Size;
            int relocCount = 0;

            while ((uint8_t*)block < end && block->VirtualAddress) {
                DWORD count = (block->SizeOfBlock - sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION)) / 2;
                WORD* entries = (WORD*)(block + 1);

                for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    int type = entries[i] >> 12;
                    int offset = entries[i] & 0xFFF;
                    uint8_t* patchPtr = localImage.data() + block->VirtualAddress + offset;

                    if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64) {
                        *(uint64_t*)patchPtr += delta;
                        relocCount++;
                    } else if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW) {
                        *(uint32_t*)patchPtr += (uint32_t)delta;
                        relocCount++;
                    }
                }
                block = (IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*)((uint8_t*)block + block->SizeOfBlock);
            }
            printf("[Inject] %d relocations applied locally\n", relocCount);
        }
    }

    // 6. Resolve imports LOCALLY
    auto& impDir = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
    if (impDir.VirtualAddress) {
        auto* desc = (IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR*)(localImage.data() + impDir.VirtualAddress);
        while (desc->Name) {
            const char* dllName = (const char*)(localImage.data() + desc->Name);

            HMODULE hMod = LoadLibraryExA(dllName, nullptr, DONT_RESOLVE_DLL_REFERENCES);
            if (!hMod) {
                printf("[Inject]   WARNING: %s not loadable\n", dllName);
                desc++; continue;
            }

            uint64_t iltRva = desc->OriginalFirstThunk ? desc->OriginalFirstThunk
                                                        : desc->FirstThunk;
            auto* thunk = (IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64*)(localImage.data() + iltRva);
            uint64_t* iatPtr = (uint64_t*)(localImage.data() + desc->FirstThunk);
            int resolved = 0;

            while (thunk->u1.AddressOfData) {
                uint64_t funcAddr = 0;

                if (IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL64(thunk->u1.Ordinal)) {
                    WORD ord = (WORD)IMAGE_ORDINAL64(thunk->u1.Ordinal);
                    funcAddr = (uint64_t)GetProcAddress(hMod, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(ord));
                } else {
                    auto* hint = (IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME*)(
                        localImage.data() + (thunk->u1.AddressOfData & 0x7FFFFFFF));
                    funcAddr = (uint64_t)GetProcAddress(hMod, hint->Name);
                }

                if (funcAddr) {
                    *iatPtr = funcAddr;
                    resolved++;
                }

                thunk++;
                iatPtr++;
            }

            printf("[Inject]   %s: %d resolved\n", dllName, resolved);
            FreeLibrary(hMod);
            desc++;
        }
    }

    // 7. Find .pdata section for exception handler registration
    DWORD pdataRva = 0, pdataSize = 0;
    auto* secScan = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD si = 0; si < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; si++, secScan++) {
        if (memcmp(secScan->Name, ".pdata", 6) == 0) {
            pdataRva = secScan->VirtualAddress;
            pdataSize = secScan->Misc.VirtualSize;
            printf("[Inject] .pdata found: RVA=0x%X Size=%u\n", pdataRva, pdataSize);
            break;
        }
    }

    // 8. Write image to remote
    printf("[Inject] Writing %u bytes to remote process...\n", imageSize);
    ntStatus = g_Syscall.NtWriteVirtualMemory(
        hProc, remoteBase, localImage.data(), imageSize, nullptr
    );
    if (ntStatus != 0) {
        printf("[Inject] NtWriteVirtualMemory failed: 0x%08X\n", ntStatus);
        g_Syscall.NtClose(hProc); return false;
    }
    printf("[Inject] Image written successfully\n");

    // 9. Build shellcode that:
    //    a) Calls RtlAddFunctionTable to register exception handlers
    //    b) Then calls DllMain
    // This fixes __try/__except for manually mapped DLLs!
    uint64_t entryPoint = (uint64_t)remoteBase + nt->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint;
    uint64_t pdataAddr = (uint64_t)remoteBase + pdataRva;
    uint32_t pdataEntries = pdataSize / sizeof(RUNTIME_FUNCTION);

    // Get RtlAddFunctionTable address
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll");
    uint64_t rtlAddFuncTable = (uint64_t)GetProcAddress(ntdll, "RtlAddFunctionTable");

    printf("[Inject] Registering %u exception handlers via RtlAddFunctionTable\n", pdataEntries);
    printf("[Inject] RtlAddFunctionTable at: 0x%llX\n", rtlAddFuncTable);

    // Shellcode:
    //   sub rsp, 0x28          ; shadow space
    //   mov rcx, pdataAddr     ; FunctionTable
    //   mov edx, pdataEntries  ; EntryCount
    //   mov r8, remoteBase     ; BaseAddress
    //   mov rax, RtlAddFunc    ;
    //   call rax               ; RtlAddFunctionTable(pdata, count, base)
    //   mov rcx, remoteBase    ; hModule
    //   mov edx, 1             ; DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH
    //   xor r8, r8             ; NULL
    //   mov rax, entryPoint    ;
    //   call rax               ; DllMain(hModule, 1, NULL)
    //   add rsp, 0x28
    //   xor eax, eax
    //   ret
    uint8_t shellcode[] = {
        0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x28,                                        // sub rsp, 0x28
        // RtlAddFunctionTable(pdata, count, base)
        0x48, 0xB9, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,                                  // mov rcx, pdataAddr
        0xBA, 0,0,0,0,                                                 // mov edx, pdataEntries
        0x49, 0xB8, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,                                  // mov r8, remoteBase
        0x48, 0xB8, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,                                  // mov rax, RtlAddFunctionTable
        0xFF, 0xD0,                                                    // call rax
        // DllMain(hModule, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, NULL)
        0x48, 0xB9, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,                                  // mov rcx, hModule
        0xBA, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,                                  // mov edx, 1
        0x4D, 0x31, 0xC0,                                              // xor r8, r8
        0x48, 0xB8, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,                                  // mov rax, entryPoint
        0xFF, 0xD0,                                                    // call rax
        0x48, 0x83, 0xC4, 0x28,                                        // add rsp, 0x28
        0x33, 0xC0,                                                    // xor eax, eax
        0xC3                                                           // ret
    };

    // Patch addresses
    *(uint64_t*)&shellcode[6]  = pdataAddr;              // rcx = pdata
    *(uint32_t*)&shellcode[15] = pdataEntries;            // edx = count
    *(uint64_t*)&shellcode[21] = (uint64_t)remoteBase;   // r8 = base
    *(uint64_t*)&shellcode[31] = rtlAddFuncTable;         // rax = RtlAddFunctionTable
    *(uint64_t*)&shellcode[41] = (uint64_t)remoteBase;   // rcx = hModule
    *(uint64_t*)&shellcode[54] = entryPoint;              // rax = DllMain

    // Allocate shellcode in target
    LPVOID scRemote = VirtualAllocEx(hProc, nullptr, sizeof(shellcode),
                                      MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    if (!scRemote) {
        printf("[Inject] Shellcode alloc failed\n");
        CloseHandle(hProc); return false;
    }

    g_Syscall.NtWriteVirtualMemory(hProc, scRemote, shellcode, sizeof(shellcode), nullptr);

    // 10. Create remote thread via direct syscall (bypasses VAC)
    printf("[Inject] Calling DllMain via NtCreateThreadEx...\n");
    HANDLE hThread = nullptr;
    ntStatus = g_Syscall.NtCreateThreadEx(
        &hThread, THREAD_ALL_ACCESS, nullptr, hProc,
        scRemote, nullptr,
        0, 0, 0, 0, nullptr
    );

    if (ntStatus != 0 || !hThread) {
        printf("[Inject] NtCreateThreadEx failed: 0x%08X\n", ntStatus);
        SIZE_T freeSize = 0;
        g_Syscall.NtFreeVirtualMemory(hProc, &scRemote, &freeSize, MEM_RELEASE);
        g_Syscall.NtClose(hProc);
        return false;
    }

    WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 15000);
    g_Syscall.NtClose(hThread);

    // Free shellcode and close handle
    SIZE_T freeSize = 0;
    g_Syscall.NtFreeVirtualMemory(hProc, &scRemote, &freeSize, MEM_RELEASE);

    // Wait for cheat to fully initialize before cleanup
    Sleep(3000);

    // DO NOT erase PE headers — needed for RtlAddFunctionTable / exception handling
    // Without headers, __try/__except crashes CS2 instead of catching exceptions
    printf("[Inject] PE headers KEPT (required for exception handling)\n");

    // Fix memory protection PER SECTION (not the whole image)
    // .text → RX (code, no write needed)
    // .rdata → R (read-only data)
    // .data → RW (global variables, MUST be writable)
    // .pdata → R (exception data)
    auto* fixSection = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD si = 0; si < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; si++, fixSection++) {
        ULONG prot = PAGE_READONLY;
        bool isCode = (fixSection->Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE) ||
                      (fixSection->Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE);
        bool isWrite = (fixSection->Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE);

        if (isCode && isWrite)      prot = PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE;
        else if (isCode)            prot = PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
        else if (isWrite)           prot = PAGE_READWRITE;
        else                        prot = PAGE_READONLY;

        PVOID secBase = (uint8_t*)remoteBase + fixSection->VirtualAddress;
        SIZE_T secSize = fixSection->Misc.VirtualSize;
        ULONG oldProt = 0;
        g_Syscall.NtProtectVirtualMemory(hProc, &secBase, &secSize, prot, &oldProt);
    }
    printf("[Inject] Section protections set (per-section)\n");

    // Close handle cleanly — don't leave traces
    g_Syscall.NtClose(hProc);

    printf("[Inject] SUCCESS!\n");
    return true;
}
```

`Loader/src/syscalls.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../include/syscalls.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>

// ============================================================================
// Direct Syscalls — reads syscall numbers from ntdll.dll ON DISK
// (not from memory, where VAC might have hooked them)
// Then executes via inline assembly syscall instruction
// ============================================================================

DirectSyscall g_Syscall;

// ============================================================================
// GetSyscallNumber — read ntdll from disk, find function, extract syscall #
// ============================================================================
DWORD DirectSyscall::GetSyscallNumber(const char* functionName) {
    // Read ntdll from disk (clean copy, no hooks)
    char ntdllPath[MAX_PATH];
    GetSystemDirectoryA(ntdllPath, MAX_PATH);
    strcat_s(ntdllPath, "\\ntdll.dll");

    std::ifstream file(ntdllPath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!file.is_open()) return 0;

    size_t fileSize = (size_t)file.tellg();
    file.seekg(0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> raw(fileSize);
    file.read((char*)raw.data(), fileSize);
    file.close();

    // Parse PE
    auto* dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)raw.data();
    if (dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) return 0;

    auto* nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(raw.data() + dos->e_lfanew);
    if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) return 0;

    // Find export directory
    auto& expDir = nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
    if (!expDir.VirtualAddress) return 0;

    // Convert RVA to file offset
    auto RvaToOffset = [&](DWORD rva) -> DWORD {
        auto* section = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
        for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, section++) {
            if (rva >= section->VirtualAddress &&
                rva < section->VirtualAddress + section->Misc.VirtualSize) {
                return rva - section->VirtualAddress + section->PointerToRawData;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    };

    DWORD expOffset = RvaToOffset(expDir.VirtualAddress);
    if (!expOffset) return 0;

    auto* exports = (PIMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY)(raw.data() + expOffset);

    auto* names = (DWORD*)(raw.data() + RvaToOffset(exports->AddressOfNames));
    auto* funcs = (DWORD*)(raw.data() + RvaToOffset(exports->AddressOfFunctions));
    auto* ords  = (WORD*)(raw.data() + RvaToOffset(exports->AddressOfNameOrdinals));

    for (DWORD i = 0; i < exports->NumberOfNames; i++) {
        const char* name = (const char*)(raw.data() + RvaToOffset(names[i]));
        if (strcmp(name, functionName) == 0) {
            WORD ordIdx = ords[i];
            DWORD funcRva = funcs[ordIdx];
            DWORD funcOffset = RvaToOffset(funcRva);

            // The syscall stub in ntdll looks like:
            // 4C 8B D1          mov r10, rcx
            // B8 XX XX 00 00    mov eax, <syscall_number>
            uint8_t* funcBytes = raw.data() + funcOffset;

            // Verify it's a syscall stub
            if (funcBytes[0] == 0x4C && funcBytes[1] == 0x8B && funcBytes[2] == 0xD1 &&
                funcBytes[3] == 0xB8) {
                DWORD sysNum = *(DWORD*)(funcBytes + 4);
                return sysNum;
            }

            // Alternative pattern (some Windows versions):
            // B8 XX XX 00 00    mov eax, <syscall_number>
            if (funcBytes[0] == 0xB8) {
                DWORD sysNum = *(DWORD*)(funcBytes + 1);
                return sysNum;
            }

            break;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialize — resolve all syscall numbers
// ============================================================================
bool DirectSyscall::Initialize() {
    m_sysNtOpenProcess            = GetSyscallNumber("NtOpenProcess");
    m_sysNtAllocateVirtualMemory  = GetSyscallNumber("NtAllocateVirtualMemory");
    m_sysNtWriteVirtualMemory     = GetSyscallNumber("NtWriteVirtualMemory");
    m_sysNtReadVirtualMemory      = GetSyscallNumber("NtReadVirtualMemory");
    m_sysNtFreeVirtualMemory      = GetSyscallNumber("NtFreeVirtualMemory");
    m_sysNtProtectVirtualMemory   = GetSyscallNumber("NtProtectVirtualMemory");
    m_sysNtCreateThreadEx         = GetSyscallNumber("NtCreateThreadEx");
    m_sysNtClose                  = GetSyscallNumber("NtClose");

    printf("[Syscall] NtOpenProcess:           0x%04X\n", m_sysNtOpenProcess);
    printf("[Syscall] NtAllocateVirtualMemory: 0x%04X\n", m_sysNtAllocateVirtualMemory);
    printf("[Syscall] NtWriteVirtualMemory:    0x%04X\n", m_sysNtWriteVirtualMemory);
    printf("[Syscall] NtReadVirtualMemory:     0x%04X\n", m_sysNtReadVirtualMemory);
    printf("[Syscall] NtProtectVirtualMemory:  0x%04X\n", m_sysNtProtectVirtualMemory);
    printf("[Syscall] NtCreateThreadEx:        0x%04X\n", m_sysNtCreateThreadEx);
    printf("[Syscall] NtClose:                 0x%04X\n", m_sysNtClose);

    // Verify critical ones resolved
    if (!m_sysNtOpenProcess || !m_sysNtAllocateVirtualMemory ||
        !m_sysNtWriteVirtualMemory || !m_sysNtCreateThreadEx) {
        printf("[Syscall] FAILED to resolve critical syscalls!\n");
        return false;
    }

    printf("[Syscall] All syscalls resolved from clean ntdll on disk\n");
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Syscall wrappers — use indirect syscall via ntdll's own syscall;ret gadget
// This avoids detection of syscall instructions in our own code
// ============================================================================

// We find a "syscall; ret" gadget in ntdll and jump to it
static PVOID FindSyscallGadget() {
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll");
    if (!ntdll) return nullptr;

    uint8_t* base = (uint8_t*)ntdll;
    PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)base;
    PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(base + dos->e_lfanew);

    // Search .text section for "0F 05 C3" (syscall; ret)
    auto* section = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, section++) {
        if (!(section->Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE)) continue;

        uint8_t* start = base + section->VirtualAddress;
        DWORD size = section->Misc.VirtualSize;

        for (DWORD j = 0; j < size - 2; j++) {
            if (start[j] == 0x0F && start[j+1] == 0x05 && start[j+2] == 0xC3) {
                return &start[j];
            }
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

static PVOID g_SyscallGadget = nullptr;

// ============================================================================
// DoSyscall — execute syscall via indirect jump to ntdll gadget
// Uses the "indirect syscall" technique:
// 1. Set up registers as if calling the NT function normally
// 2. Set EAX = syscall number
// 3. Jump to ntdll's "syscall; ret" instead of executing our own syscall
// This way the syscall instruction address is inside ntdll (legitimate)
// ============================================================================

// We need to call the syscall with the right number in EAX and args in registers.
// Since we can't use inline asm in x64 MSVC, we use a function pointer trick:
// We construct a small code region that does: mov eax, <num>; mov r10, rcx; jmp [gadget]

struct SyscallTrampoline {
    uint8_t code[32];
};

// Cache: one trampoline per unique syscall number (reusable)
#include <unordered_map>
static std::unordered_map<DWORD, void*> g_TrampolineCache;
static uint8_t* g_TrampolinePool = nullptr;
static int g_TrampolineOffset = 0;

static void* BuildTrampoline(DWORD syscallNum) {
    // Return cached trampoline if already built for this syscall
    auto it = g_TrampolineCache.find(syscallNum);
    if (it != g_TrampolineCache.end()) return it->second;

    // Allocate pool on first use
    if (!g_TrampolinePool) {
        g_TrampolinePool = (uint8_t*)VirtualAlloc(
            nullptr, 4096, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    }
    if (!g_SyscallGadget) g_SyscallGadget = FindSyscallGadget();
    if (!g_SyscallGadget || !g_TrampolinePool) return nullptr;

    uint8_t* code = g_TrampolinePool + g_TrampolineOffset;

    code[0] = 0x4C; code[1] = 0x8B; code[2] = 0xD1;           // mov r10, rcx
    code[3] = 0xB8;                                              // mov eax, imm32
    *(DWORD*)(code + 4) = syscallNum;
    code[8] = 0xFF; code[9] = 0x25; *(DWORD*)(code + 10) = 0;  // jmp [rip+0]
    *(uint64_t*)(code + 14) = (uint64_t)g_SyscallGadget;

    g_TrampolineCache[syscallNum] = code;
    g_TrampolineOffset += 32;
    return code;
}

// ============================================================================
// Syscall wrapper implementations
// ============================================================================

typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtOpenProcess)(PHANDLE, ACCESS_MASK, OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES_NT*, CLIENT_ID*);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtAllocateVirtualMemory)(HANDLE, PVOID*, ULONG_PTR, PSIZE_T, ULONG, ULONG);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtWriteVirtualMemory)(HANDLE, PVOID, PVOID, SIZE_T, PSIZE_T);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtReadVirtualMemory)(HANDLE, PVOID, PVOID, SIZE_T, PSIZE_T);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtFreeVirtualMemory)(HANDLE, PVOID*, PSIZE_T, ULONG);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtProtectVirtualMemory)(HANDLE, PVOID*, PSIZE_T, ULONG, PULONG);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtCreateThreadEx)(PHANDLE, ACCESS_MASK, PVOID, HANDLE, PVOID, PVOID, ULONG, SIZE_T, SIZE_T, SIZE_T, PVOID);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pfnNtClose)(HANDLE);

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtOpenProcess(PHANDLE ph, ACCESS_MASK access, DWORD pid) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtOpenProcess)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtOpenProcess);
    if (!fn) return -1;

    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES_NT oa = {};
    oa.Length = sizeof(oa);
    struct { HANDLE UniqueProcess; HANDLE UniqueThread; } cid = {};
    cid.UniqueProcess = (HANDLE)(ULONG_PTR)pid;

    return fn(ph, access, &oa, (CLIENT_ID*)&cid);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtAllocateVirtualMemory(HANDLE proc, PVOID* base,
                                                  SIZE_T* size, ULONG type, ULONG prot) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtAllocateVirtualMemory)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtAllocateVirtualMemory);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(proc, base, 0, size, type, prot);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtWriteVirtualMemory(HANDLE proc, PVOID base,
                                               PVOID buf, SIZE_T size, PSIZE_T written) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtWriteVirtualMemory)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtWriteVirtualMemory);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(proc, base, buf, size, written);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtReadVirtualMemory(HANDLE proc, PVOID base,
                                              PVOID buf, SIZE_T size, PSIZE_T read) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtReadVirtualMemory)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtReadVirtualMemory);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(proc, base, buf, size, read);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtFreeVirtualMemory(HANDLE proc, PVOID* base,
                                              PSIZE_T size, ULONG type) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtFreeVirtualMemory)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtFreeVirtualMemory);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(proc, base, size, type);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtProtectVirtualMemory(HANDLE proc, PVOID* base,
                                                 PSIZE_T size, ULONG newProt, PULONG oldProt) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtProtectVirtualMemory)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtProtectVirtualMemory);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(proc, base, size, newProt, oldProt);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtCreateThreadEx(PHANDLE th, ACCESS_MASK access, PVOID oa,
                                           HANDLE proc, PVOID start, PVOID arg,
                                           ULONG flags, SIZE_T zeroBits,
                                           SIZE_T stackSize, SIZE_T maxStack, PVOID attrList) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtCreateThreadEx)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtCreateThreadEx);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(th, access, oa, proc, start, arg, flags, zeroBits, stackSize, maxStack, attrList);
}

NTSTATUS DirectSyscall::NtClose(HANDLE h) {
    auto fn = (pfnNtClose)BuildTrampoline(m_sysNtClose);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    return fn(h);
}
```

`Mapper/include/driver_comm.h`:

```h
#pragma once

// ============================================================================
// DriverComm — Usermode communication with the CS2 kernel driver via IOCTLs.
// All memory operations on the target process go through here instead of
// OpenProcess/ReadProcessMemory/WriteProcessMemory.
// ============================================================================

#include <Windows.h>
#include <string>
#include <cstdint>

#include "../../Shared/shared.h"

class DriverComm {
public:
    DriverComm();
    ~DriverComm();

    // -- Lifecycle -----------------------------------------------------------

    // Open a handle to the driver device (\\.\CS2Drv).
    // Returns true if the handle was acquired successfully.
    bool Open();

    // Close the driver handle.
    void Close();

    // Returns true when a valid handle is held.
    bool IsConnected() const;

    // -- Memory operations ---------------------------------------------------

    // Read a value of type T from a remote process address.
    template <typename T>
    bool ReadMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, T& outValue) const;

    // Write a value of type T to a remote process address.
    template <typename T>
    bool WriteMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, const T& value) const;

    // Read an arbitrary‑length buffer from a remote process.
    bool ReadMemoryRaw(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, void* buffer, ULONG size) const;

    // Write an arbitrary‑length buffer to a remote process.
    bool WriteMemoryRaw(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, const void* buffer, ULONG size) const;

    // -- Module helpers ------------------------------------------------------

    // Retrieve the base address of a named module in the target process.
    // Returns 0 on failure.
    uint64_t GetModuleBase(DWORD processId, const std::wstring& moduleName) const;

    // -- Allocation / free ---------------------------------------------------

    // Allocate virtual memory inside the target process.
    // Returns the base address of the allocation (0 on failure).
    uint64_t AllocateMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t size, ULONG protection) const;

    // Free previously allocated memory in the target.
    bool FreeMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, uint64_t size) const;

    // -- Stealth -------------------------------------------------------------

    // Ask the driver to unlink a module from the target process PEB.
    bool HideModule(DWORD processId, uint64_t moduleBase) const;

private:
    HANDLE m_hDevice;     // Handle to the driver device object
};

// ============================================================================
// Template implementations (must be visible at point of use)
// ============================================================================

template <typename T>
bool DriverComm::ReadMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, T& outValue) const {
    return ReadMemoryRaw(processId, address, &outValue, sizeof(T));
}

template <typename T>
bool DriverComm::WriteMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, const T& value) const {
    return WriteMemoryRaw(processId, address, &value, sizeof(T));
}
```

```h
#pragma once

// ============================================================================
// ManualMapper — Maps a DLL into a remote process using the kernel driver
// for all memory operations.
//
// Flow:
//   LoadFile  ->  Parse PE  ->  AllocateRemote  ->  CopySections
//   ->  ProcessRelocations  ->  ResolveImports  ->  ProcessTls
//   ->  CallEntryPoint  ->  CleanupHeaders  ->  HideModule
// ============================================================================

#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "driver_comm.h"
#include "pe_parser.h"

class ManualMapper {
public:
    ManualMapper() = default;
    ~ManualMapper() = default;

    // Map the DLL at `dllPath` into the process identified by `targetPid`.
    // All memory reads/writes go through `driver`.
    // Returns true on success.
    bool Map(DriverComm& driver, DWORD targetPid, const std::string& dllPath);

private:
    // -- Internal steps (called in order by Map) -----------------------------

    // Read the DLL file from disk into m_localImage.
    bool LoadFile(const std::string& path);

    // Allocate SizeOfImage bytes of RWX memory inside the target process.
    bool AllocateRemote(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Copy each PE section to its correct virtual address in the remote process.
    bool CopySections(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Apply base relocations (delta = remoteBase - preferredBase).
    bool ProcessRelocations(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Walk the import table, resolve each function via the remote module's
    // export table, and patch the IAT.
    bool ResolveImports(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Invoke TLS callbacks in the remote process.
    bool ProcessTls(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Execute DllMain(hModule, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, nullptr) remotely.
    bool CallEntryPoint(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Zero out the PE headers in remote memory to hinder forensic analysis.
    bool CleanupHeaders(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // Ask the driver to unlink the module from the target's PEB.
    bool HideModuleFromPeb(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid);

    // -- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------

    // Walk a remote module's export table to find a function's address.
    uint64_t ResolveRemoteExport(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid,
                                 uint64_t remoteModuleBase,
                                 const std::string& funcName,
                                 uint16_t ordinal) const;

    // -- State ---------------------------------------------------------------
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_localImage;       // Raw DLL bytes read from disk
    PeParser             m_pe;               // Parsed PE metadata
    uint64_t             m_remoteBase = 0;   // Allocated base in target process
};
```
