`Mapper/include/pe_parser.h`:

```h
#pragma once

// ============================================================================
// PeParser — Parses a PE (Portable Executable) image from a local buffer.
// Extracts sections, imports, relocations, and TLS callbacks needed for
// manual mapping.
// ============================================================================

#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// --- Parsed data structures -------------------------------------------------

// A single imported function (by name or by ordinal).
struct ImportedFunction {
    std::string Name;       // Empty when imported by ordinal
    uint16_t    Ordinal;    // Set to 0 when imported by name
    uint64_t    ThunkRVA;   // RVA of the IAT slot to patch
};

// One imported DLL and its functions.
struct ImportedModule {
    std::string                    DllName;
    std::vector<ImportedFunction>  Functions;
};

// A single base relocation entry.
struct RelocationEntry {
    uint32_t RVA;   // Absolute RVA where the fixup applies
    uint16_t Type;  // IMAGE_REL_BASED_xxx
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PeParser class
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PeParser {
public:
    PeParser();
    ~PeParser() = default;

    // Parse the PE buffer.  Returns true on success.
    bool Parse(const uint8_t* buffer, size_t size);

    // -- Accessors -----------------------------------------------------------

    bool IsValid() const { return m_valid; }
    bool Is64Bit() const { return m_is64; }

    const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*               GetNtHeaders()     const { return m_ntHeaders64; }
    const std::vector<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER>& GetSections()     const { return m_sections; }
    const std::vector<ImportedModule>&       GetImports()      const { return m_imports; }
    const std::vector<RelocationEntry>&      GetRelocations()  const { return m_relocations; }
    const std::vector<uint64_t>&            GetTlsCallbacks() const { return m_tlsCallbacks; }

    uint64_t GetImageBase()      const;
    uint32_t GetSizeOfImage()    const;
    uint32_t GetEntryPointRVA()  const;
    uint32_t GetSizeOfHeaders()  const;

private:
    // Internal parsing steps
    bool ParseSections();
    bool ParseImports();
    bool ParseRelocations();
    bool ParseTlsCallbacks();

    // Helpers
    template <typename T>
    const T* PtrAt(uint32_t rva) const;

    const uint8_t*                        m_base;          // Start of raw buffer
    size_t                                m_size;          // Total buffer size
    const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*               m_dosHeader;
    const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*             m_ntHeaders64;   // 64‑bit header view
    bool                                  m_is64;
    bool                                  m_valid;

    std::vector<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER>     m_sections;
    std::vector<ImportedModule>           m_imports;
    std::vector<RelocationEntry>          m_relocations;
    std::vector<uint64_t>                m_tlsCallbacks;
};

// ============================================================================
// Template implementation — translate an RVA to a const pointer inside the
// local PE buffer.  Returns nullptr when the RVA falls outside all sections.
// ============================================================================

template <typename T>
const T* PeParser::PtrAt(uint32_t rva) const {
    // Walk sections and find the one that contains this RVA.
    for (const auto& sec : m_sections) {
        uint32_t secStart = sec.VirtualAddress;
        uint32_t secEnd   = secStart + sec.Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (rva >= secStart && rva < secEnd) {
            uint32_t offset = sec.PointerToRawData + (rva - secStart);
            if (offset + sizeof(T) > m_size) return nullptr;
            return reinterpret_cast<const T*>(m_base + offset);
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}
```

`Mapper/src/driver_comm.cpp`:

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// DriverComm implementation — sends IOCTL requests to the CS2 kernel driver
// for all memory operations on the target process.
// ============================================================================

#include "../include/driver_comm.h"
#include <winioctl.h>
#include <iostream>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void PrintLastError(const char* context) {
    DWORD err = GetLastError();
    char* msg = nullptr;
    FormatMessageA(
        FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM | FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
        nullptr, err, MAKELANGID(LANG_NEUTRAL, SUBLANG_DEFAULT),
        reinterpret_cast<LPSTR>(&msg), 0, nullptr);
    std::cerr << "[DriverComm] " << context << " failed — error " << err;
    if (msg) {
        std::cerr << ": " << msg;
        LocalFree(msg);
    }
    std::cerr << std::endl;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lifecycle
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DriverComm::DriverComm()
    : m_hDevice(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
{
}

DriverComm::~DriverComm() {
    Close();
}

bool DriverComm::Open() {
    if (m_hDevice != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return true; // already open
    }

    m_hDevice = CreateFileA(
        DRIVER_USER_PATH,          // "\\\\.\\CS2Drv"
        GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
        nullptr,
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        nullptr);

    if (m_hDevice == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        PrintLastError("CreateFileA (driver open)");
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[DriverComm] Connected to kernel driver." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

void DriverComm::Close() {
    if (m_hDevice != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        CloseHandle(m_hDevice);
        m_hDevice = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
}

bool DriverComm::IsConnected() const {
    return m_hDevice != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Raw memory read/write — the workhorses behind the templates
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool DriverComm::ReadMemoryRaw(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, void* buffer, ULONG size) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return false;

    MEMORY_READ_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId    = processId;
    req.Address      = address;
    req.Size         = size;
    req.OutputBuffer = reinterpret_cast<ULONG64>(buffer);

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_READ_MEMORY,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (ReadMemory)");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool DriverComm::WriteMemoryRaw(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, const void* buffer, ULONG size) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return false;

    MEMORY_WRITE_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId   = processId;
    req.Address     = address;
    req.Size        = size;
    req.InputBuffer = reinterpret_cast<ULONG64>(buffer);

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_WRITE_MEMORY,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (WriteMemory)");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Module base query
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

uint64_t DriverComm::GetModuleBase(DWORD processId, const std::wstring& moduleName) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return 0;

    MODULE_BASE_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId   = processId;
    req.BaseAddress = 0;

    // Copy module name into fixed‑size buffer (max 255 chars + null)
    size_t copyLen = (moduleName.size() < 255) ? moduleName.size() : 255;
    wcsncpy_s(req.ModuleName, moduleName.c_str(), copyLen);

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_GET_MODULE_BASE,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (GetModuleBase)");
        return 0;
    }

    return req.BaseAddress;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Memory allocation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

uint64_t DriverComm::AllocateMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t size, ULONG protection) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return 0;

    ALLOC_MEMORY_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId     = processId;
    req.Size          = size;
    req.Protection    = protection;
    req.AllocatedBase = 0;

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_ALLOC_MEMORY,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (AllocateMemory)");
        return 0;
    }

    return req.AllocatedBase;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Memory free
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool DriverComm::FreeMemory(DWORD processId, uint64_t address, uint64_t size) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return false;

    FREE_MEMORY_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId = processId;
    req.Address   = address;
    req.Size      = size;

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_FREE_MEMORY,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (FreeMemory)");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Module hiding (PEB unlink)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool DriverComm::HideModule(DWORD processId, uint64_t moduleBase) const {
    if (!IsConnected()) return false;

    HIDE_MODULE_REQUEST req{};
    req.ProcessId  = processId;
    req.ModuleBase = moduleBase;

    DWORD bytesReturned = 0;
    BOOL ok = DeviceIoControl(
        m_hDevice,
        IOCTL_HIDE_MODULE,
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &req, sizeof(req),
        &bytesReturned,
        nullptr);

    if (!ok) {
        PrintLastError("DeviceIoControl (HideModule)");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
```

`Mapper/src/main.cpp`:

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Mapper entry point — inject a cheat DLL into cs2.exe using a kernel driver
// for all memory operations.
//
// Usage:  Mapper.exe [dll_path] [process_name]
//   Defaults: dll_path = "Cheat.dll", process_name = "cs2.exe"
// ============================================================================

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <Windows.h>

#include "../include/driver_comm.h"
#include "../include/mapper.h"
#include "../include/process.h"

// How long to wait for the target process (60 seconds)
static constexpr DWORD PROCESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parse command line
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    std::string dllPath     = "Cheat.dll";
    std::wstring processName = L"cs2.exe";

    if (argc >= 2) {
        dllPath = argv[1];
    }
    if (argc >= 3) {
        std::string pname = argv[2];
        processName = std::wstring(pname.begin(), pname.end());
    }

    std::cout << "========================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << " CS2 Manual Mapper" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "========================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << " DLL    : " << dllPath << std::endl;
    std::wcout << L" Target : " << processName << std::endl;
    std::cout << "========================================\n" << std::endl;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 1 — Connect to the kernel driver
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    std::cout << "[*] Connecting to kernel driver..." << std::endl;

    DriverComm driver;
    if (!driver.Open()) {
        std::cerr << "[!] Could not connect to the driver." << std::endl;
        std::cerr << "    Make sure the CS2Drv driver is loaded." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "[+] Driver connection established.\n" << std::endl;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 2 — Find or wait for the target process
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    std::cout << "[*] Looking for target process..." << std::endl;

    DWORD targetPid = FindProcessByName(processName);
    if (targetPid == 0) {
        std::cout << "[*] Process not running — waiting up to "
                  << (PROCESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000) << " seconds..."
                  << std::endl;
        targetPid = WaitForProcess(processName, PROCESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    if (targetPid == 0) {
        std::cerr << "[!] Target process not found. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "[+] Target PID: " << targetPid << "\n" << std::endl;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 3 — Verify the DLL exists
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    DWORD fileAttr = GetFileAttributesA(dllPath.c_str());
    if (fileAttr == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
        std::cerr << "[!] DLL file not found: " << dllPath << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 4 — Map the DLL
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    std::cout << "[*] Starting manual map..." << std::endl;

    ManualMapper mapper;
    bool success = mapper.Map(driver, targetPid, dllPath);

    if (!success) {
        std::cerr << "\n[!] Manual mapping FAILED." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "\n[+] Injection complete — cheat is active." << std::endl;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cleanup
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    driver.Close();
    return 0;
}
```

`Mapper/src/mapper.cpp`:

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// ManualMapper implementation — the core of the injector.
//
// Every read/write into the target process goes through DriverComm (IOCTLs to
// the kernel driver).  No Win32 process memory APIs are used.
// ============================================================================

#include "../include/mapper.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public entry point
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::Map(DriverComm& driver, DWORD targetPid, const std::string& dllPath) {
    std::cout << "\n[Mapper] ===== Starting manual map =====" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Mapper] DLL   : " << dllPath << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Mapper] Target: PID " << targetPid << "\n" << std::endl;

    // Step 1 — Load DLL from disk
    if (!LoadFile(dllPath)) return false;

    // Step 2 — Parse PE
    if (!m_pe.Parse(m_localImage.data(), m_localImage.size())) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] PE parsing failed." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Step 3 — Allocate remote memory
    if (!AllocateRemote(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 4 — Copy sections
    if (!CopySections(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 5 — Process relocations
    if (!ProcessRelocations(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 6 — Resolve imports
    if (!ResolveImports(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 7 — TLS callbacks
    if (!ProcessTls(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 8 — Call DllMain(DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH)
    if (!CallEntryPoint(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 9 — Erase PE headers remotely
    if (!CleanupHeaders(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    // Step 10 — PEB unlink
    if (!HideModuleFromPeb(driver, targetPid)) return false;

    std::cout << "\n[Mapper] ===== Manual map complete =====" << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// LoadFile — read the raw DLL bytes into m_localImage
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::LoadFile(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!file.is_open()) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to open DLL: " << path << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    size_t fileSize = static_cast<size_t>(file.tellg());
    if (fileSize == 0) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] DLL file is empty." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    m_localImage.resize(fileSize);
    file.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
    file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_localImage.data()), fileSize);
    file.close();

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Loaded DLL — " << fileSize << " bytes." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AllocateRemote — allocate SizeOfImage bytes of RWX memory in the target
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::AllocateRemote(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    uint32_t imageSize = m_pe.GetSizeOfImage();
    m_remoteBase = driver.AllocateMemory(pid, imageSize, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);

    if (m_remoteBase == 0) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Remote allocation failed (size=0x"
                  << std::hex << imageSize << ")." << std::dec << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Remote allocation at 0x" << std::hex << m_remoteBase
              << " (size=0x" << imageSize << ")." << std::dec << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CopySections — write each section to its correct VA in remote memory
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::CopySections(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    // Write the PE headers first (SizeOfHeaders bytes at base)
    uint32_t headersSize = m_pe.GetSizeOfHeaders();
    if (!driver.WriteMemoryRaw(pid, m_remoteBase, m_localImage.data(), headersSize)) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to write PE headers." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Write each section
    for (const auto& sec : m_pe.GetSections()) {
        if (sec.SizeOfRawData == 0) continue; // BSS — nothing to copy

        uint64_t dest = m_remoteBase + sec.VirtualAddress;
        const uint8_t* src = m_localImage.data() + sec.PointerToRawData;

        if (!driver.WriteMemoryRaw(pid, dest, src, sec.SizeOfRawData)) {
            char name[9] = {};
            memcpy(name, sec.Name, 8);
            std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to write section \"" << name << "\"." << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Sections copied (" << m_pe.GetSections().size()
              << " sections)." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ProcessRelocations — fix up addresses after the image was rebased
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::ProcessRelocations(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    const auto& relocs = m_pe.GetRelocations();
    if (relocs.empty()) {
        std::cout << "[Mapper] No relocations to process." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    int64_t delta = static_cast<int64_t>(m_remoteBase) -
                    static_cast<int64_t>(m_pe.GetImageBase());

    if (delta == 0) {
        std::cout << "[Mapper] Image loaded at preferred base — no relocations needed."
                  << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Relocation delta: 0x" << std::hex << delta
              << std::dec << std::endl;

    for (const auto& entry : relocs) {
        uint64_t patchAddr = m_remoteBase + entry.RVA;

        switch (entry.Type) {
            case IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64: {
                // 64-bit fixup: read 8 bytes, add delta, write back
                uint64_t val = 0;
                if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint64_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) {
                    std::cerr << "[Mapper] Reloc read failed at RVA 0x"
                              << std::hex << entry.RVA << std::dec << std::endl;
                    return false;
                }
                val += delta;
                if (!driver.WriteMemory<uint64_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) {
                    std::cerr << "[Mapper] Reloc write failed at RVA 0x"
                              << std::hex << entry.RVA << std::dec << std::endl;
                    return false;
                }
                break;
            }

            case IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW: {
                // 32-bit fixup: read 4 bytes, add (truncated) delta, write back
                uint32_t val = 0;
                if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint32_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) {
                    std::cerr << "[Mapper] Reloc read (32) failed at RVA 0x"
                              << std::hex << entry.RVA << std::dec << std::endl;
                    return false;
                }
                val += static_cast<uint32_t>(delta);
                if (!driver.WriteMemory<uint32_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) {
                    std::cerr << "[Mapper] Reloc write (32) failed at RVA 0x"
                              << std::hex << entry.RVA << std::dec << std::endl;
                    return false;
                }
                break;
            }

            case IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGH: {
                uint16_t val = 0;
                if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint16_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) return false;
                val += static_cast<uint16_t>(delta >> 16);
                if (!driver.WriteMemory<uint16_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) return false;
                break;
            }

            case IMAGE_REL_BASED_LOW: {
                uint16_t val = 0;
                if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint16_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) return false;
                val += static_cast<uint16_t>(delta & 0xFFFF);
                if (!driver.WriteMemory<uint16_t>(pid, patchAddr, val)) return false;
                break;
            }

            default:
                // Unknown relocation type — skip but warn
                std::cerr << "[Mapper] Warning: unknown relocation type "
                          << entry.Type << " at RVA 0x" << std::hex
                          << entry.RVA << std::dec << std::endl;
                break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Relocations processed: " << relocs.size()
              << " entries." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ResolveImports — for each imported DLL, find its base in the target and
//                  walk its export table to resolve function addresses.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::ResolveImports(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    const auto& imports = m_pe.GetImports();
    if (imports.empty()) {
        std::cout << "[Mapper] No imports to resolve." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    for (const auto& mod : imports) {
        // Convert DLL name to wide string for the driver query
        std::wstring wName(mod.DllName.begin(), mod.DllName.end());
        uint64_t dllBase = driver.GetModuleBase(pid, wName);

        if (dllBase == 0) {
            std::cerr << "[Mapper] Could not find module \"" << mod.DllName
                      << "\" in target process." << std::endl;
            return false;
        }

        std::cout << "[Mapper] Resolving " << mod.Functions.size()
                  << " imports from " << mod.DllName
                  << " (base=0x" << std::hex << dllBase << std::dec << ")"
                  << std::endl;

        for (const auto& fn : mod.Functions) {
            uint64_t funcAddr = ResolveRemoteExport(
                driver, pid, dllBase, fn.Name, fn.Ordinal);

            if (funcAddr == 0) {
                std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to resolve import: "
                          << mod.DllName << "!";
                if (!fn.Name.empty())
                    std::cerr << fn.Name;
                else
                    std::cerr << "#" << fn.Ordinal;
                std::cerr << std::endl;
                return false;
            }

            // Write the resolved address into the IAT slot
            uint64_t iatSlot = m_remoteBase + fn.ThunkRVA;
            if (!driver.WriteMemory<uint64_t>(pid, iatSlot, funcAddr)) {
                std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to write IAT entry." << std::endl;
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] All imports resolved." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ResolveRemoteExport — read a remote module's export table to find a
//                       function's address by name or ordinal.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

uint64_t ManualMapper::ResolveRemoteExport(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid,
                                           uint64_t remoteModuleBase,
                                           const std::string& funcName,
                                           uint16_t ordinal) const {
    // Read the remote module's DOS header to reach NT headers
    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dosHeader{};
    if (!driver.ReadMemory<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER>(pid, remoteModuleBase, dosHeader)) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (dosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) return 0;

    // Read the NT headers (64-bit)
    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 ntHeaders{};
    if (!driver.ReadMemory<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64>(
            pid, remoteModuleBase + dosHeader.e_lfanew, ntHeaders)) {
        return 0;
    }

    // Locate the export directory
    auto& exportDir = ntHeaders.OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
    if (exportDir.VirtualAddress == 0 || exportDir.Size == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    // Read IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY
    IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exports{};
    uint64_t exportTableAddr = remoteModuleBase + exportDir.VirtualAddress;
    if (!driver.ReadMemory<IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY>(pid, exportTableAddr, exports)) {
        return 0;
    }

    // Read the three export arrays
    uint64_t functionsAddr  = remoteModuleBase + exports.AddressOfFunctions;
    uint64_t namesAddr      = remoteModuleBase + exports.AddressOfNames;
    uint64_t ordinalsAddr   = remoteModuleBase + exports.AddressOfNameOrdinals;

    // If searching by name
    if (!funcName.empty()) {
        // Read all name RVAs
        std::vector<uint32_t> nameRVAs(exports.NumberOfNames);
        if (!driver.ReadMemoryRaw(pid, namesAddr, nameRVAs.data(),
                                  static_cast<ULONG>(nameRVAs.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)))) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Read all ordinals (parallel array to names)
        std::vector<uint16_t> nameOrdinals(exports.NumberOfNames);
        if (!driver.ReadMemoryRaw(pid, ordinalsAddr, nameOrdinals.data(),
                                  static_cast<ULONG>(nameOrdinals.size() * sizeof(uint16_t)))) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (DWORD i = 0; i < exports.NumberOfNames; ++i) {
            // Read the export name string from remote memory
            char nameBuffer[256] = {};
            if (!driver.ReadMemoryRaw(pid, remoteModuleBase + nameRVAs[i],
                                      nameBuffer, sizeof(nameBuffer) - 1)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (funcName == nameBuffer) {
                // Found it — read the function RVA from AddressOfFunctions
                uint32_t funcRVA = 0;
                uint64_t funcRVAAddr = functionsAddr + nameOrdinals[i] * sizeof(uint32_t);
                if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint32_t>(pid, funcRVAAddr, funcRVA)) {
                    return 0;
                }

                // Check for forwarded exports (RVA points inside the export directory)
                uint64_t funcVA = remoteModuleBase + funcRVA;
                if (funcRVA >= exportDir.VirtualAddress &&
                    funcRVA < exportDir.VirtualAddress + exportDir.Size) {
                    // This is a forwarded export — read the forwarder string.
                    // For simplicity, forwarded exports are not recursively resolved
                    // here.  The most common scenario (ntdll/kernel32 forwards) is
                    // handled by the fact that the target already has those modules.
                    std::cerr << "[Mapper] Warning: forwarded export \""
                              << funcName << "\" — skipping." << std::endl;
                    return 0;
                }

                return funcVA;
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Search by ordinal
        uint16_t idx = ordinal - static_cast<uint16_t>(exports.Base);
        if (idx >= exports.NumberOfFunctions) return 0;

        uint32_t funcRVA = 0;
        uint64_t funcRVAAddr = functionsAddr + idx * sizeof(uint32_t);
        if (!driver.ReadMemory<uint32_t>(pid, funcRVAAddr, funcRVA)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return remoteModuleBase + funcRVA;
    }

    return 0; // Not found
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ProcessTls — invoke TLS callback functions in the remote process
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::ProcessTls(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    const auto& callbacks = m_pe.GetTlsCallbacks();
    if (callbacks.empty()) {
        std::cout << "[Mapper] No TLS callbacks." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Calling " << callbacks.size()
              << " TLS callback(s)..." << std::endl;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < callbacks.size(); ++i) {
        uint64_t callbackAddr = m_remoteBase + callbacks[i];

        // Create a remote thread at the callback address.
        // The callback signature is: void NTAPI TlsCallback(PVOID, DWORD, PVOID)
        // We use CreateRemoteThread which passes a single LPVOID parameter.
        // TLS callbacks receive DllHandle as the first parameter; we pass the
        // module base.  Reason and Reserved are on the stack/register and will
        // be garbage, but most TLS callbacks only care about the handle.
        HANDLE hThread = CreateRemoteThread(
            OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION |
                        PROCESS_VM_OPERATION, FALSE, pid),
            nullptr,
            0,
            reinterpret_cast<LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE>(callbackAddr),
            reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(m_remoteBase),
            0,
            nullptr);

        if (hThread == nullptr) {
            std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to create remote thread for TLS callback "
                      << i << " (error=" << GetLastError() << ")." << std::endl;
            return false;
        }

        WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000);
        CloseHandle(hThread);
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] TLS callbacks executed." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CallEntryPoint — execute DllMain with DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::CallEntryPoint(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    uint32_t entryRVA = m_pe.GetEntryPointRVA();
    if (entryRVA == 0) {
        std::cout << "[Mapper] No entry point — skipping DllMain call." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    uint64_t entryAddr = m_remoteBase + entryRVA;
    std::cout << "[Mapper] Calling entry point at 0x" << std::hex << entryAddr
              << std::dec << std::endl;

    // We need a small shellcode stub because DllMain has three parameters:
    //   BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE hModule, DWORD dwReason, LPVOID lpReserved)
    // CreateRemoteThread only passes one parameter.  We build a tiny piece of
    // machine code that sets up the call properly.

    // x64 shellcode:
    //   sub  rsp, 0x28          ; 48 83 EC 28  — shadow space + alignment
    //   mov  rcx, <hModule>     ; 48 B9 XX XX XX XX XX XX XX XX
    //   mov  edx, 1             ; BA 01 00 00 00  — DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH
    //   xor  r8, r8             ; 4D 31 C0  — lpReserved = NULL
    //   mov  rax, <entryAddr>   ; 48 B8 XX XX XX XX XX XX XX XX
    //   call rax                ; FF D0
    //   add  rsp, 0x28          ; 48 83 C4 28
    //   xor  eax, eax           ; 31 C0
    //   ret                     ; C3

    uint8_t shellcode[] = {
        0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x28,                                     // sub rsp, 0x28
        0x48, 0xB9, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // mov rcx, hModule
        0xBA, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,                                // mov edx, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH
        0x4D, 0x31, 0xC0,                                            // xor r8, r8
        0x48, 0xB8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // mov rax, entryAddr
        0xFF, 0xD0,                                                   // call rax
        0x48, 0x83, 0xC4, 0x28,                                     // add rsp, 0x28
        0x31, 0xC0,                                                   // xor eax, eax
        0xC3                                                          // ret
    };

    // Patch in the two 64-bit immediates
    memcpy(&shellcode[6],  &m_remoteBase, sizeof(uint64_t)); // hModule
    memcpy(&shellcode[23], &entryAddr,    sizeof(uint64_t)); // DllMain address

    // Allocate remote memory for the shellcode
    uint64_t shellcodeAddr = driver.AllocateMemory(
        pid, sizeof(shellcode), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);

    if (shellcodeAddr == 0) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to allocate shellcode memory." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Write shellcode to remote process
    if (!driver.WriteMemoryRaw(pid, shellcodeAddr, shellcode, sizeof(shellcode))) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to write shellcode." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Create remote thread to execute the shellcode
    HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(
        PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_OPERATION,
        FALSE, pid);

    if (hProcess == nullptr) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] OpenProcess for thread creation failed (error="
                  << GetLastError() << ")." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    HANDLE hThread = CreateRemoteThread(
        hProcess,
        nullptr,
        0,
        reinterpret_cast<LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE>(shellcodeAddr),
        nullptr,
        0,
        nullptr);

    if (hThread == nullptr) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] CreateRemoteThread failed (error="
                  << GetLastError() << ")." << std::endl;
        CloseHandle(hProcess);
        return false;
    }

    // Wait for DllMain to finish
    DWORD waitResult = WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 10000);
    if (waitResult == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Warning: DllMain timed out after 10 seconds."
                  << std::endl;
    }

    CloseHandle(hThread);
    CloseHandle(hProcess);

    // Free the shellcode allocation
    driver.FreeMemory(pid, shellcodeAddr, sizeof(shellcode));

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Entry point called successfully." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CleanupHeaders — zero out the first 0x1000 bytes to erase PE headers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::CleanupHeaders(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeroes(0x1000, 0);
    if (!driver.WriteMemoryRaw(pid, m_remoteBase, zeroes.data(),
                               static_cast<ULONG>(zeroes.size()))) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Failed to zero PE headers." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] PE headers wiped (0x1000 bytes)." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HideModuleFromPeb — ask the driver to unlink this module from PEB lists
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ManualMapper::HideModuleFromPeb(DriverComm& driver, DWORD pid) {
    if (!driver.HideModule(pid, m_remoteBase)) {
        std::cerr << "[Mapper] Driver HideModule failed." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[Mapper] Module hidden from PEB." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

```

`Mapper/src/pe_parser.cpp`:

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// PeParser implementation — operates entirely on a local buffer so that the
// mapper can inspect a DLL before writing it into the target process.
// ============================================================================

#include "../include/pe_parser.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Construction
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PeParser::PeParser()
    : m_base(nullptr)
    , m_size(0)
    , m_dosHeader(nullptr)
    , m_ntHeaders64(nullptr)
    , m_is64(false)
    , m_valid(false)
{
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse — main entry point
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool PeParser::Parse(const uint8_t* buffer, size_t size) {
    m_valid = false;
    m_base  = buffer;
    m_size  = size;
    m_sections.clear();
    m_imports.clear();
    m_relocations.clear();
    m_tlsCallbacks.clear();

    if (!buffer || size < sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER)) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Buffer too small for DOS header." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // --- DOS header ---------------------------------------------------------
    m_dosHeader = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(buffer);
    if (m_dosHeader->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) { // "MZ"
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Invalid DOS signature (expected MZ)." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // --- NT headers ---------------------------------------------------------
    if (static_cast<size_t>(m_dosHeader->e_lfanew) + sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64) > size) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] NT headers extend beyond buffer." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    const auto* ntCommon = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32*>(
        buffer + m_dosHeader->e_lfanew);

    if (ntCommon->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) { // "PE\0\0"
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Invalid PE signature." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Determine bitness from the optional header magic
    WORD optMagic = ntCommon->OptionalHeader.Magic;
    if (optMagic == IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC) {
        m_is64 = true;
        m_ntHeaders64 = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*>(
            buffer + m_dosHeader->e_lfanew);
    } else if (optMagic == IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC) {
        m_is64 = false;
        // Store a cast pointer — callers must only access the 64‑bit view when
        // m_is64 is true.  For this mapper we require 64‑bit images.
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] 32-bit PE images are not supported by this mapper." << std::endl;
        return false;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Unknown OptionalHeader magic: 0x"
                  << std::hex << optMagic << std::dec << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Validate machine type (x64)
    if (m_ntHeaders64->FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Unexpected machine type — expected AMD64." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[PeParser] PE parsed — "
              << m_ntHeaders64->FileHeader.NumberOfSections << " sections, "
              << "ImageBase=0x" << std::hex << m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.ImageBase
              << ", SizeOfImage=0x" << m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage
              << std::dec << std::endl;

    // --- Sections, imports, relocations, TLS --------------------------------
    if (!ParseSections())     return false;
    if (!ParseImports())      return false;
    if (!ParseRelocations())  return false;
    if (!ParseTlsCallbacks()) return false;

    m_valid = true;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Accessors
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

uint64_t PeParser::GetImageBase() const {
    return m_ntHeaders64 ? m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.ImageBase : 0;
}

uint32_t PeParser::GetSizeOfImage() const {
    return m_ntHeaders64 ? m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage : 0;
}

uint32_t PeParser::GetEntryPointRVA() const {
    return m_ntHeaders64 ? m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint : 0;
}

uint32_t PeParser::GetSizeOfHeaders() const {
    return m_ntHeaders64 ? m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.SizeOfHeaders : 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ParseSections
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool PeParser::ParseSections() {
    WORD numSections = m_ntHeaders64->FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
    const auto* firstSection = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(
        reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*>(m_ntHeaders64));

    for (WORD i = 0; i < numSections; ++i) {
        const auto& sec = firstSection[i];

        // Bounds check: raw data must live within the local buffer
        if (sec.PointerToRawData + sec.SizeOfRawData > m_size) {
            std::cerr << "[PeParser] Section " << i
                      << " raw data exceeds buffer bounds." << std::endl;
            return false;
        }

        m_sections.push_back(sec);

        char name[9] = {};
        memcpy(name, sec.Name, 8);
        std::cout << "[PeParser]   Section \"" << name
                  << "\" VA=0x" << std::hex << sec.VirtualAddress
                  << " VSize=0x" << sec.Misc.VirtualSize
                  << " RawSize=0x" << sec.SizeOfRawData
                  << std::dec << std::endl;
    }
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ParseImports — walk the import directory table
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool PeParser::ParseImports() {
    const auto& dataDir = m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
    if (dataDir.VirtualAddress == 0 || dataDir.Size == 0) {
        std::cout << "[PeParser] No import directory." << std::endl;
        return true; // Not an error — the DLL may have no imports.
    }

    const auto* importDesc = PtrAt<IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR>(dataDir.VirtualAddress);
    if (!importDesc) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Could not resolve import directory RVA." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Walk until the null‑terminated sentinel entry
    while (importDesc->Name != 0) {
        const char* dllName = PtrAt<char>(importDesc->Name);
        if (!dllName) break;

        ImportedModule mod;
        mod.DllName = dllName;

        // Use OriginalFirstThunk (INT) when available; fall back to FirstThunk (IAT).
        uint32_t thunkRVA = importDesc->OriginalFirstThunk
                            ? importDesc->OriginalFirstThunk
                            : importDesc->FirstThunk;
        uint32_t iatRVA   = importDesc->FirstThunk;

        const auto* thunkData = PtrAt<IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64>(thunkRVA);
        if (!thunkData) { ++importDesc; continue; }

        uint32_t idx = 0;
        while (thunkData->u1.AddressOfData != 0) {
            ImportedFunction fn{};
            fn.ThunkRVA = iatRVA + idx * sizeof(IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64);

            if (IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL64(thunkData->u1.Ordinal)) {
                // Import by ordinal
                fn.Ordinal = static_cast<uint16_t>(IMAGE_ORDINAL64(thunkData->u1.Ordinal));
            } else {
                // Import by name
                const auto* hint = PtrAt<IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME>(
                    static_cast<uint32_t>(thunkData->u1.AddressOfData));
                if (hint) {
                    fn.Name    = hint->Name;
                    fn.Ordinal = hint->Hint;
                }
            }

            mod.Functions.push_back(fn);
            ++thunkData;
            ++idx;
        }

        std::cout << "[PeParser] Import: " << mod.DllName
                  << " (" << mod.Functions.size() << " functions)" << std::endl;

        m_imports.push_back(std::move(mod));
        ++importDesc;
    }

    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ParseRelocations — walk the base relocation directory
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool PeParser::ParseRelocations() {
    const auto& dataDir = m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
    if (dataDir.VirtualAddress == 0 || dataDir.Size == 0) {
        std::cout << "[PeParser] No relocation directory." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    const auto* block = PtrAt<IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION>(dataDir.VirtualAddress);
    if (!block) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Could not resolve relocation directory RVA." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t consumed = 0;
    while (consumed < dataDir.Size && block->SizeOfBlock >= sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION)) {
        uint32_t entryCount = (block->SizeOfBlock - sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION)) / sizeof(uint16_t);
        const uint16_t* entries = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(
            reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(block) + sizeof(IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION));

        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < entryCount; ++i) {
            uint16_t type   = entries[i] >> 12;
            uint16_t offset = entries[i] & 0x0FFF;

            if (type == IMAGE_REL_BASED_ABSOLUTE) {
                continue; // Padding entry, skip.
            }

            RelocationEntry re;
            re.RVA  = block->VirtualAddress + offset;
            re.Type = type;
            m_relocations.push_back(re);
        }

        consumed += block->SizeOfBlock;
        block = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION*>(
            reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(block) + block->SizeOfBlock);
    }

    std::cout << "[PeParser] Relocations: " << m_relocations.size()
              << " entries." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ParseTlsCallbacks — collect TLS callback function addresses
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool PeParser::ParseTlsCallbacks() {
    const auto& dataDir = m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_TLS];
    if (dataDir.VirtualAddress == 0 || dataDir.Size == 0) {
        std::cout << "[PeParser] No TLS directory." << std::endl;
        return true;
    }

    const auto* tlsDir = PtrAt<IMAGE_TLS_DIRECTORY64>(dataDir.VirtualAddress);
    if (!tlsDir) {
        std::cerr << "[PeParser] Could not resolve TLS directory RVA." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // AddressOfCallBacks is a VA (not an RVA).  Convert to RVA by subtracting
    // the preferred image base.
    if (tlsDir->AddressOfCallBacks == 0) {
        return true;
    }

    uint32_t cbRVA = static_cast<uint32_t>(
        tlsDir->AddressOfCallBacks - m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.ImageBase);

    const uint64_t* cbArray = PtrAt<uint64_t>(cbRVA);
    if (!cbArray) return true;

    while (*cbArray != 0) {
        // Store as RVA relative to preferred base
        uint64_t rva = *cbArray - m_ntHeaders64->OptionalHeader.ImageBase;
        m_tlsCallbacks.push_back(rva);
        ++cbArray;
    }

    std::cout << "[PeParser] TLS callbacks: " << m_tlsCallbacks.size() << std::endl;
    return true;
}
```

`Mapper/src/process.cpp`:

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Process utilities — Toolhelp32 snapshot-based process enumeration.
// ============================================================================

#include "../include/process.h"
#include <TlHelp32.h>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Case-insensitive wide-string compare
static bool WideStrEqualCI(const std::wstring& a, const std::wstring& b) {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        if (towlower(a[i]) != towlower(b[i])) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FindProcessByName
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DWORD FindProcessByName(const std::wstring& processName) {
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        std::cerr << "[Process] CreateToolhelp32Snapshot failed (error="
                  << GetLastError() << ")." << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    PROCESSENTRY32W pe{};
    pe.dwSize = sizeof(pe);

    DWORD pid = 0;
    if (Process32FirstW(snap, &pe)) {
        do {
            if (WideStrEqualCI(pe.szExeFile, processName)) {
                pid = pe.th32ProcessID;
                break;
            }
        } while (Process32NextW(snap, &pe));
    }

    CloseHandle(snap);
    return pid;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// WaitForProcess — poll at ~500 ms intervals until the process appears
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DWORD WaitForProcess(const std::wstring& processName, DWORD timeoutMs) {
    const DWORD pollInterval = 500; // milliseconds
    DWORD elapsed = 0;

    std::wcout << L"[Process] Waiting for " << processName << L"..." << std::endl;

    while (elapsed < timeoutMs) {
        DWORD pid = FindProcessByName(processName);
        if (pid != 0) {
            std::cout << "[Process] Found — PID " << pid << std::endl;
            return pid;
        }
        Sleep(pollInterval);
        elapsed += pollInterval;
    }

    std::cerr << "[Process] Timed out after " << timeoutMs
              << " ms waiting for process." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// IsProcessRunning
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool IsProcessRunning(DWORD pid) {
    HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
    if (hProcess == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }

    DWORD exitCode = 0;
    BOOL ok = GetExitCodeProcess(hProcess, &exitCode);
    CloseHandle(hProcess);

    // STILL_ACTIVE means the process has not terminated.
    return (ok && exitCode == STILL_ACTIVE);
}
```

```h
class ConfigManager {
public:
    NexusConfig profiles[MAX_PROFILES];
    int activeProfile = 0;
    char configDir[MAX_PATH] = {};

    void Init() {
        // Create config directory
        char appdata[MAX_PATH];
        SHGetFolderPathA(nullptr, CSIDL_APPDATA, nullptr, 0, appdata);
        sprintf_s(configDir, "%s\\ProjectNexus", appdata);
        CreateDirectoryA(configDir, nullptr);

        // Set default names
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PROFILES; i++) {
            sprintf_s(profiles[i].name, "Profile %d", i + 1);
        }
        strcpy_s(profiles[0].name, "Default");

        // Load all profiles
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PROFILES; i++) Load(i);
    }

    void Save(int idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= MAX_PROFILES) return;
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        sprintf_s(path, "%s\\profile_%d.cfg", configDir, idx);
        FILE* f = nullptr;
        fopen_s(&f, path, "wb");
        if (f) {
            fwrite(&profiles[idx], sizeof(NexusConfig), 1, f);
            fclose(f);
        }
    }

    void Load(int idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= MAX_PROFILES) return;
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        sprintf_s(path, "%s\\profile_%d.cfg", configDir, idx);
        FILE* f = nullptr;
        fopen_s(&f, path, "rb");
        if (f) {
            NexusConfig tmp;
            if (fread(&tmp, sizeof(NexusConfig), 1, f) == 1 && tmp.version == CONFIG_VERSION) {
                profiles[idx] = tmp;
            }
            fclose(f);
        }
    }

    NexusConfig& Active() { return profiles[activeProfile]; }
};
```

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Memory read/write (external — ReadProcessMemory/WriteProcessMemory)
// ============================================================================
template<typename T>
T Read(uintptr_t addr) {
    T val{}; ReadProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPCVOID)addr, &val, sizeof(T), nullptr); return val;
}

template<typename T>
void Write(uintptr_t addr, T val) {
    WriteProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPVOID)addr, &val, sizeof(T), nullptr);
}

// ============================================================================
// World to screen
// ============================================================================
bool W2S(Vec3 pos, Vec2& out, Mat4& vm, float sw, float sh) {
    float w = pos.x*vm.m[3][0] + pos.y*vm.m[3][1] + pos.z*vm.m[3][2] + vm.m[3][3];
    if (w < 0.01f) return false;
    out.x = sw/2 + (pos.x*vm.m[0][0]+pos.y*vm.m[0][1]+pos.z*vm.m[0][2]+vm.m[0][3])/w*sw/2;
    out.y = sh/2 - (pos.x*vm.m[1][0]+pos.y*vm.m[1][1]+pos.z*vm.m[1][2]+vm.m[1][3])/w*sh/2;
    return true;
}

void MoveMouseRel(int x, int y) {
    INPUT inp{}; inp.type = INPUT_MOUSE;
    inp.mi.dwFlags = MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE; inp.mi.dx = x; inp.mi.dy = y;
    SendInput(1, &inp, sizeof(INPUT));
}
```
