static void UpdatePlayers() {
    float sw = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
    float sh = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);

    Mat4 vm = Read<Mat4>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewMatrix);
    uintptr_t entList = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
    uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    int localTeam = localPawn ? Read<uint8_t>(localPawn + O::m_iTeamNum) : 0;

    Vec3 localPos = {};
    if (localPawn) {
        uintptr_t ln = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
        if (ln) localPos = Read<Vec3>(ln + O::m_vecAbsOrigin);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) g_players[i].valid = false;
    if (!entList) return;

    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        // EXACT traversal from reference code
        uintptr_t entry1 = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8 * ((i & 0x7FFF) >> 9)) + 16);
        if (!entry1) continue;

        uintptr_t ctrl = Read<uintptr_t>(entry1 + 112 * (i & 0x1FF));
        if (!ctrl) continue;

        if (!Read<bool>(ctrl + O::m_bPawnIsAlive)) continue;

        uint32_t ph = Read<uint32_t>(ctrl + O::m_hPlayerPawn);
        if (!ph) continue;

        uintptr_t entry2 = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8 * ((ph & 0x7FFF) >> 9)) + 16);
        if (!entry2) continue;

        uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(entry2 + 112 * (ph & 0x1FF));
        if (!pawn || pawn == localPawn) continue;

        int team = Read<uint8_t>(pawn + O::m_iTeamNum);
        int hp = Read<int>(pawn + O::m_iHealth);
        if (hp <= 0) continue;

        Vec3 pos = Read<Vec3>(pawn + O::m_vOldOrigin);
        Vec3 head = pos; head.z += 70.f;
        Vec3 feet = pos;

        Vec2 headScr, feetScr;
        bool onScr = W2S(head, headScr, vm, sw, sh) && W2S(feet, feetScr, vm, sw, sh);

        // Visible check: m_bSpotted (server-side, reliable)
        // pawn + 0x1C60 (m_entitySpottedState) + 0x8 (m_bSpotted) = pawn + 0x1C68
        bool isVisible = Read<bool>(pawn + 0x1C68);

        // Read all bone positions for skeleton ESP
        BoneScreen boneScrArr[NUM_BONES] = {};
        uintptr_t sceneNode = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
        if (sceneNode) {
            uintptr_t boneArr = Read<uintptr_t>(sceneNode + 0x140 + 0x80);

            if (boneArr) {
                // Read more bones to find the correct mapping (scan up to 40)
                const int SCAN_BONES = 40;
                const int BONE_STRIDE = 32;
                uint8_t rawBones[SCAN_BONES * 32];
                SIZE_T bytesRead = 0;

                BOOL ok = ReadProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPCVOID)boneArr, rawBones,
                    SCAN_BONES * BONE_STRIDE, &bytesRead);

                // Debug: dump ALL bone positions with height relative to feet
                static bool boneDbg = false;
                if (!boneDbg && ok && bytesRead > 0) {
                    printf("[BONE] Player feet pos: (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)\n", pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
                    printf("[BONE] %-4s %-30s %-8s\n", "IDX", "POSITION", "HEIGHT");
                    for (int b = 0; b < SCAN_BONES; b++) {
                        float* bd = (float*)(rawBones + b * BONE_STRIDE);
                        float dx = bd[0]-pos.x, dy = bd[1]-pos.y;
                        float dist2d = sqrtf(dx*dx + dy*dy);
                        if (dist2d < 80.f && (bd[0]!=0||bd[1]!=0||bd[2]!=0)) {
                            float height = bd[2] - pos.z;
                            printf("[BONE]  [%2d] (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)  H=%.0f %s\n",
                                b, bd[0], bd[1], bd[2], height,
                                height > 60 ? "<-- HEAD?" :
                                height > 45 ? "<-- NECK?" :
                                height > 30 ? "<-- CHEST/ARM?" :
                                height > 15 ? "<-- WAIST/HAND?" :
                                height > 0  ? "<-- HIP/KNEE?" : "<-- FOOT?");
                        }
                    }
                    boneDbg = true;
                }

                if (ok && bytesRead >= (SIZE_T)(NUM_BONES * BONE_STRIDE)) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BONES; b++) {
                        float* bd = (float*)(rawBones + b * BONE_STRIDE);
                        Vec3 bonePos = { bd[0], bd[1], bd[2] };

                        // Validate: bone must be near player (within 100 units XY)
                        float dx = bonePos.x - pos.x, dy = bonePos.y - pos.y;
                        if (sqrtf(dx*dx + dy*dy) > 100.f) continue;
                        if (bonePos.x == 0 && bonePos.y == 0 && bonePos.z == 0) continue;

                        Vec2 bs;
                        boneScrArr[b].valid = W2S(bonePos, bs, vm, sw, sh);
                        boneScrArr[b].pos = bs;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Read extra data
        int armor = Read<int>(pawn + 0x1CA4); // m_ArmorValue
        if (armor < 0 || armor > 100) armor = 0; // Clamp garbage values
        bool isScoped = Read<bool>(pawn + 0x1C78); // m_bIsScoped
        bool isDefusing = Read<bool>(pawn + 0x1C7A); // m_bIsDefusing

        // Read active weapon name
        char wepName[24] = {};
        uintptr_t wepSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + 0x1208);
        if (wepSvc) {
            uint32_t wh = Read<uint32_t>(wepSvc + 0x60);
            if (wh && wh != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
                uintptr_t we = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8*((wh&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (we) {
                    uintptr_t wep = Read<uintptr_t>(we + 112*(wh&0x1FF));
                    if (wep) {
                        short wid = Read<short>(wep + 0x13B2);
                        switch(wid) {
                            case 7: strcpy_s(wepName,"AK-47"); break;
                            case 16: strcpy_s(wepName,"M4A4"); break;
                            case 60: strcpy_s(wepName,"M4A1-S"); break;
                            case 9: strcpy_s(wepName,"AWP"); break;
                            case 1: strcpy_s(wepName,"Deagle"); break;
                            case 61: strcpy_s(wepName,"USP-S"); break;
                            case 4: strcpy_s(wepName,"Glock"); break;
                            case 40: strcpy_s(wepName,"SSG-08"); break;
                            case 11: strcpy_s(wepName,"G3SG1"); break;
                            case 38: strcpy_s(wepName,"SCAR-20"); break;
                            case 8: strcpy_s(wepName,"AUG"); break;
                            case 10: strcpy_s(wepName,"FAMAS"); break;
                            case 13: strcpy_s(wepName,"Galil"); break;
                            case 14: strcpy_s(wepName,"M249"); break;
                            case 17: strcpy_s(wepName,"MAC-10"); break;
                            case 19: strcpy_s(wepName,"P90"); break;
                            case 24: strcpy_s(wepName,"UMP-45"); break;
                            case 26: strcpy_s(wepName,"PP-Bizon"); break;
                            case 25: strcpy_s(wepName,"XM1014"); break;
                            case 27: strcpy_s(wepName,"MAG-7"); break;
                            case 28: strcpy_s(wepName,"Negev"); break;
                            case 29: strcpy_s(wepName,"Sawed-Off"); break;
                            case 30: strcpy_s(wepName,"Tec-9"); break;
                            case 63: strcpy_s(wepName,"CZ75"); break;
                            case 64: strcpy_s(wepName,"R8"); break;
                            case 2: strcpy_s(wepName,"Dualies"); break;
                            case 3: strcpy_s(wepName,"Five-Seven"); break;
                            case 31: strcpy_s(wepName,"Zeus"); break;
                            case 42: case 59: strcpy_s(wepName,"Knife"); break;
                            case 43: strcpy_s(wepName,"Flash"); break;
                            case 44: strcpy_s(wepName,"HE Nade"); break;
                            case 45: strcpy_s(wepName,"Smoke"); break;
                            case 46: strcpy_s(wepName,"Molotov"); break;
                            case 47: strcpy_s(wepName,"Decoy"); break;
                            case 48: strcpy_s(wepName,"Incendiary"); break;
                            case 49: strcpy_s(wepName,"C4"); break;
                            default: sprintf_s(wepName,"W:%d",wid); break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        auto& p = g_players[i-1];
        memcpy(p.bones, boneScrArr, sizeof(boneScrArr));
        p.valid = true;
        p.enemy = (team != localTeam);
        p.visible = isVisible;

        // Hitmarker + Damage Logger detection — enemy health decreased = we hit them
        if (p.enemy && g_prevHealth[i-1] > 0 && hp < g_prevHealth[i-1] && hp >= 0) {
            int dmg = g_prevHealth[i-1] - hp;
            g_hitmarkerAlpha = 1.0f;
            g_hitmarkerKill = (hp <= 0);
            g_hitmarkerTime = GetTickCount();

            // Add to damage logger
            if (cfg_espDmgLogger) {
                auto& d = g_dmgLog[g_dmgLogIdx % 16];
                d.x = p.headScreen.x;
                d.y = p.headScreen.y;
                d.damage = dmg;
                d.isKill = (hp <= 0);
                d.spawnTime = GetTickCount();
                d.active = true;
                g_dmgLogIdx++;
            }
        }
        g_prevHealth[i-1] = hp;

        p.health = hp;
        p.armor = armor;
        p.isScoped = isScoped;
        p.isDefusing = isDefusing;
        strcpy_s(p.weaponName, wepName);

        // Read eye angles for Line of Sight
        float eyeYaw = Read<float>(pawn + 0x3350 + 4); // m_angEyeAngles.yaw (offset +4 for yaw)
        p.eyeYaw = eyeYaw;
        p.headScreen = headScr;
        p.feetScreen = feetScr;
        p.onScreen = onScr;
        p.worldPos = pos;  // Store for radar
        float dx=localPos.x-pos.x, dy=localPos.y-pos.y, dz=localPos.z-pos.z;
        p.dist = sqrtf(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)*0.0254f;

        // Name
        uintptr_t nameAddr = Read<uintptr_t>(ctrl + O::m_sSanitizedPlayerName);
        if (nameAddr) ReadProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPCVOID)nameAddr, p.name, 31, nullptr);
        p.name[31] = 0;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Aimbot v2 — Angle-based with direct ViewAngles write
// Reads actual bone positions, calculates exact angles, writes to memory
// 100% precise regardless of DPI/sensitivity/raw input settings
// ============================================================================

// Math helpers for aimbot
static void CalcAngle(Vec3 src, Vec3 dst, float& pitch, float& yaw) {
    float dx = dst.x - src.x;
    float dy = dst.y - src.y;
    float dz = dst.z - src.z;
    float hyp = sqrtf(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    pitch = -atan2f(dz, hyp) * (180.f / 3.14159265f);
    yaw = atan2f(dy, dx) * (180.f / 3.14159265f);
}

static float NormalizeAngle(float a) {
    while (a > 180.f) a -= 360.f;
    while (a < -180.f) a += 360.f;
    return a;
}

static float GetFovAngle(float myPitch, float myYaw, float tPitch, float tYaw) {
    float dp = NormalizeAngle(tPitch - myPitch);
    float dy = NormalizeAngle(tYaw - myYaw);
    return sqrtf(dp*dp + dy*dy);
}

// Classify weapon by definition index → category (0=rifle,1=sniper,2=pistol,3=smg,4=shotgun,-1=other)
static int ClassifyWeapon(short wid) {
    switch(wid) {
        case 7: case 8: case 10: case 13: case 14: case 16: case 39: case 60: // AK,AUG,FAMAS,Galil,M249,M4A4,M4A1-S,Negev
            return 0; // Rifle
        case 9: case 11: case 38: case 40: // AWP,G3SG1,SCAR-20,SSG08
            return 1; // Sniper
        case 1: case 2: case 3: case 4: case 30: case 32: case 36: case 61: case 63: case 64: // Deagle,Dualies,FiveSeveN,Glock,Tec9,P2000,P250,USP-S,R8,CZ75
            return 2; // Pistol
        case 17: case 19: case 23: case 24: case 26: case 33: case 34: // MAC-10,P90,MP5-SD,UMP,PP-Bizon,MP7,MP9
            return 3; // SMG
        case 25: case 27: case 29: case 35: // XM1014,MAG-7,Sawed-Off,Nova
            return 4; // Shotgun
        default: return -1;
    }
}

static void RunAimbot() {
    if (!cfg_aimbot) return;

    bool keyHeld = (GetAsyncKeyState(cfg_aimKey) & 0x8000) != 0;
    if (!keyHeld) {
        g_lockedTarget = -1; // Release target lock when key released
        return;
    }

    uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!localPawn) return;

    // Detect current weapon for Aim Pro per-weapon config
    float useFov = cfg_fov;
    float useSmooth = cfg_smooth;
    int useBone = cfg_aimBone;
    bool useRCS = cfg_aimRCS;

    uintptr_t wepSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + 0x1208);
    if (wepSvc) {
        uintptr_t activeHandle = Read<uintptr_t>(wepSvc + 0x58);
        if (activeHandle) {
            uintptr_t entList = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
            if (entList) {
                uint32_t wh = (uint32_t)(activeHandle & 0xFFFF);
                uintptr_t we1 = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8*((wh&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (we1) {
                    uintptr_t wep = Read<uintptr_t>(we1 + 112*(wh&0x1FF));
                    if (wep) {
                        short wid = Read<short>(wep + 0x13B2);
                        int cat = ClassifyWeapon(wid);
                        WeaponAimConfig* wCfg = nullptr;
                        switch(cat) {
                            case 0: wCfg = &g_cfg.Active().aimRifle; break;
                            case 1: wCfg = &g_cfg.Active().aimSniper; break;
                            case 2: wCfg = &g_cfg.Active().aimPistol; break;
                            case 3: wCfg = &g_cfg.Active().aimSMG; break;
                            case 4: wCfg = &g_cfg.Active().aimShotgun; break;
                        }
                        if (wCfg && wCfg->enabled) {
                            useFov = wCfg->fov;
                            useSmooth = wCfg->smooth;
                            useBone = wCfg->bone;
                            useRCS = wCfg->rcs;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Read our REAL eye position from our own head bone (guaranteed accurate)
    uintptr_t localNode = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
    if (!localNode) return;
    Vec3 localPos = Read<Vec3>(localNode + O::m_vecAbsOrigin);

    // Get our bone array and read our head bone as eye position
    uintptr_t localBoneArr = Read<uintptr_t>(localNode + O::m_boneArrayOffset);
    Vec3 eyePos;
    if (localBoneArr) {
        eyePos = Read<Vec3>(localBoneArr + 7 * 32); // Our head bone = our eye pos
    } else {
        eyePos = {localPos.x, localPos.y, localPos.z + 64.06f}; // Fallback
    }

    // Read current view angles
    struct Angles { float pitch, yaw, roll; };
    Angles viewAngles = Read<Angles>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewAngles);

    // Read recoil punch angle for RCS
    Vec3 punchAngle = {0,0,0};
    if (useRCS) {
        punchAngle = Read<Vec3>(localPawn + O::m_aimPunchAngle);
    }

    int localTeam = Read<uint8_t>(localPawn + O::m_iTeamNum);
    uintptr_t entityList = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
    if (!entityList) return;

    // Target selection
    float bestFov = useFov; // FOV in degrees (per-weapon or global)
    int bestIdx = -1;
    Vec3 bestBonePos = {};

    // If we have a locked target, try to keep it
    if (cfg_aimLock && g_lockedTarget >= 0 && g_lockedTarget < 64) {
        auto& p = g_players[g_lockedTarget];
        if (p.valid && p.enemy && p.health > 0) {
            if (!cfg_aimVisCheck || p.visible) {
                bestIdx = g_lockedTarget;
            }
        }
        if (bestIdx < 0) g_lockedTarget = -1; // Target lost
    }

    // Find best target (if not locked)
    if (bestIdx < 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            auto& p = g_players[i];
            if (!p.valid || !p.enemy || p.health <= 0) continue;
            if (cfg_aimVisCheck && !p.visible) continue;

            // Get target bone world position
            // Read actual bone from game memory for precision
            int idx = i + 1;
            uintptr_t e1 = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8*((idx&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
            if (!e1) continue;
            uintptr_t ctrl = Read<uintptr_t>(e1 + 112*(idx&0x1FF));
            if (!ctrl) continue;
            uint32_t ph = Read<uint32_t>(ctrl + O::m_hPlayerPawn);
            if (!ph || ph == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;
            uintptr_t e2 = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8*((ph&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
            if (!e2) continue;
            uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(e2 + 112*(ph&0x1FF));
            if (!pawn) continue;

            // Read bone array
            uintptr_t node = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
            if (!node) continue;
            uintptr_t boneArr = Read<uintptr_t>(node + O::m_boneArrayOffset);
            if (!boneArr) continue;

            // Read target bone position (stride 32, pos at first 3 floats)
            int boneId = cfg_aimBoneIndices[useBone];
            Vec3 bonePos = Read<Vec3>(boneArr + boneId * 32);

            // Sanity check — bone should be near player origin
            float bdx = bonePos.x - p.worldPos.x;
            float bdy = bonePos.y - p.worldPos.y;
            if (bdx*bdx + bdy*bdy > 10000.f) continue; // >100 units away = bad data

            // Calculate angle to bone
            float tPitch, tYaw;
            CalcAngle(eyePos, bonePos, tPitch, tYaw);

            // Compensate for recoil in FOV check
            float adjPitch = viewAngles.pitch + punchAngle.x * 2.f;
            float adjYaw = viewAngles.yaw + punchAngle.y * 2.f;

            float fov = GetFovAngle(adjPitch, adjYaw, tPitch, tYaw);
            if (fov < bestFov) {
                bestFov = fov;
                bestIdx = i;
                bestBonePos = bonePos;
            }
        }
    }

    if (bestIdx < 0) return;

    // Lock target
    if (cfg_aimLock) g_lockedTarget = bestIdx;

    // If locked target, re-read their bone position for freshest data
    if (cfg_aimLock && bestIdx == g_lockedTarget && bestBonePos.x == 0 && bestBonePos.y == 0) {
        int idx = bestIdx + 1;
        uintptr_t e1 = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8*((idx&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
        if (e1) {
            uintptr_t ctrl = Read<uintptr_t>(e1 + 112*(idx&0x1FF));
            if (ctrl) {
                uint32_t ph = Read<uint32_t>(ctrl + O::m_hPlayerPawn);
                if (ph && ph != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
                    uintptr_t e2 = Read<uintptr_t>(entityList + (8*((ph&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                    if (e2) {
                        uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(e2 + 112*(ph&0x1FF));
                        if (pawn) {
                            uintptr_t node = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
                            if (node) {
                                uintptr_t boneArr = Read<uintptr_t>(node + O::m_boneArrayOffset);
                                if (boneArr) {
                                    int boneId = cfg_aimBoneIndices[useBone];
                                    bestBonePos = Read<Vec3>(boneArr + boneId * 32);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Calculate desired angles
    float desiredPitch, desiredYaw;
    CalcAngle(eyePos, bestBonePos, desiredPitch, desiredYaw);

    // Compensate for recoil (subtract punch angle * 2)
    if (useRCS) {
        desiredPitch -= punchAngle.x * 2.f;
        desiredYaw -= punchAngle.y * 2.f;
    }

    // Smooth interpolation with adaptive curve
    float deltaPitch = NormalizeAngle(desiredPitch - viewAngles.pitch);
    float deltaYaw = NormalizeAngle(desiredYaw - viewAngles.yaw);

    // Adaptive smooth: faster when far, slower when close (feels natural)
    float totalAngleDist = sqrtf(deltaPitch*deltaPitch + deltaYaw*deltaYaw);
    float speedMult = 1.f;
    if (totalAngleDist < 1.f) speedMult = 0.5f;       // Very close: fine adjustment
    else if (totalAngleDist > 5.f) speedMult = 1.5f;  // Far: move faster

    float smoothFactor = useSmooth / speedMult;
    if (smoothFactor < 1.f) smoothFactor = 1.f;

    float newPitch = viewAngles.pitch + deltaPitch / smoothFactor;
    float newYaw = viewAngles.yaw + deltaYaw / smoothFactor;

    // Clamp pitch to valid range
    if (newPitch > 89.f) newPitch = 89.f;
    if (newPitch < -89.f) newPitch = -89.f;
    newYaw = NormalizeAngle(newYaw);

    // Only write if there's meaningful delta (avoid fighting with game input)
    float totalDelta = fabsf(deltaPitch) + fabsf(deltaYaw);
    if (totalDelta < 0.01f) return; // Already on target

    // Write new view angles directly to game memory
    Angles newAngles = {newPitch, newYaw, 0.f};
    BOOL writeOk = WriteProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPVOID)(g_clientBase + O::dwViewAngles),
        &newAngles, sizeof(Angles), nullptr);

    // Debug (remove after confirmed working)
    static DWORD lastDbgAim = 0;
    if (GetTickCount() - lastDbgAim > 2000) {
        printf("[Aimbot] target=%d bone=%d fov=%.1f delta=%.2f/%.2f write=%s\n",
            bestIdx, cfg_aimBoneIndices[cfg_aimBone], bestFov,
            deltaPitch, deltaYaw, writeOk ? "OK" : "FAIL");
        lastDbgAim = GetTickCount();
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Triggerbot — auto-fire via WriteProcessMemory to attack button
// ============================================================================
static void RunTriggerbot() {
    if (!cfg_triggerbot) return;
    if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(cfg_triggerKey) & 0x8000)) return;

    float sw = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
    float sh = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
    float cx = sw / 2.f, cy = sh / 2.f;

    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        auto& p = g_players[i];
        if (!p.valid || !p.onScreen || !p.enemy) continue;

        float h = p.feetScreen.y - p.headScreen.y;
        if (h < 4) continue;
        float w = h * 0.45f;

        float bx = p.headScreen.x - w / 2;
        float by = p.headScreen.y;

        if (cx >= bx && cx <= bx + w && cy >= by && cy <= by + h) {
            Sleep(cfg_triggerDelay);
            // Force attack via WriteProcessMemory (same method as bhop)
            Write<int>(g_clientBase + 0x209A000, 65537); // attack = press
            Sleep(20);
            Write<int>(g_clientBase + 0x209A000, 256);   // attack = release
            break;
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RCS / No Recoil — compensate via WriteProcessMemory to dwViewAngles
// ============================================================================
static Vec2 g_lastPunch = {0, 0};

static void RunRCS() {
    if (!cfg_rcs && !cfg_noRecoil) return;
    if (!(GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000)) {
        g_lastPunch = {0, 0};
        return;
    }

    uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!localPawn) return;

    // Read punch angle
    uintptr_t punchSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + 0x14B8);
    if (!punchSvc) return;

    Vec2 punch;
    punch.x = Read<float>(punchSvc + 0x50);
    punch.y = Read<float>(punchSvc + 0x50 + 4);

    // Calculate delta since last frame
    float dx = punch.x - g_lastPunch.x;
    float dy = punch.y - g_lastPunch.y;
    g_lastPunch = punch;

    if (fabs(dx) < 0.01f && fabs(dy) < 0.01f) return;

    float amount = cfg_noRecoil ? 1.0f : cfg_rcsAmount;

    // Read current view angles
    struct Ang { float p, y, r; };
    Ang va = Read<Ang>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewAngles);

    // Subtract punch delta (multiplied by 2 because CS2 applies punch at 2x)
    va.p -= dx * 2.0f * amount;
    va.y -= dy * 2.0f * amount;

    // Clamp
    if (va.p > 89) va.p = 89; if (va.p < -89) va.p = -89;
    while (va.y > 180) va.y -= 360; while (va.y < -180) va.y += 360;

    // Write corrected angles via WriteProcessMemory
    Write<Ang>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewAngles, va);
}

// ============================================================================
// Skin Changer — write paint kit to weapon entity externally
// ============================================================================
// Skin changer offsets (nested struct: EconEntity → AttributeManager → Item → fields)
// C_EconEntity::m_AttributeManager = 0x11A8
// C_AttributeContainer::m_Item = 0x50
// Base of C_EconItemView within weapon = 0x11A8 + 0x50 = 0x11F8
namespace SkinOff {
    const uintptr_t EconItemBase = 0x11F8;  // weapon + this = C_EconItemView
    const uintptr_t DefIndex     = 0x11F8 + 0x1BA; // = 0x13B2
    const uintptr_t EntityQuality= 0x11F8 + 0x1BC; // = 0x13B4
    const uintptr_t ItemIDHigh   = 0x11F8 + 0x1D0; // = 0x13C8
    const uintptr_t ItemIDLow    = 0x11F8 + 0x1D4; // = 0x13CC
    const uintptr_t AccountID    = 0x11F8 + 0x1D8; // = 0x13D0
    const uintptr_t Initialized  = 0x11F8 + 0x1E8; // = 0x13E0

    // These are directly on C_EconEntity (NOT nested)
    const uintptr_t FallbackPaintKit  = 0x1680;
    const uintptr_t FallbackSeed      = 0x1684;
    const uintptr_t FallbackWear      = 0x1688;
    const uintptr_t FallbackStatTrak  = 0x168C;
}

static void RunSkinChanger() {
    if (!cfg_skinChanger) return;

    uintptr_t localPawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!localPawn) return;

    // Find active weapon via weapon services
    uintptr_t weapon = 0;
    uintptr_t weaponSvc = Read<uintptr_t>(localPawn + 0x1208);
    if (weaponSvc) {
        uint32_t wh = Read<uint32_t>(weaponSvc + 0x60);
        if (wh && wh != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
            uintptr_t el = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
            if (el) {
                uintptr_t e = Read<uintptr_t>(el + (8*((wh&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (e) weapon = Read<uintptr_t>(e + 112*(wh&0x1FF));
            }
        }
    }
    if (!weapon) return;

    // Read item definition index (CORRECT nested offset)
    short defIndex = Read<short>(weapon + SkinOff::DefIndex);
    // Debug to file
    static DWORD lastSkinDbg = 0;
    DWORD skinNow = GetTickCount();
    if (skinNow - lastSkinDbg > 5000) {
        FILE* dbg = nullptr;
        fopen_s(&dbg, "C:\\Users\\ATOMIZADORv10\\Desktop\\skin_debug.txt", "a");
        if (dbg) {
            fprintf(dbg, "weapon=0x%llX defIdx=%d (at 0x%llX) fallbackPK=%d\n",
                (unsigned long long)weapon, defIndex,
                (unsigned long long)(weapon + SkinOff::DefIndex),
                Read<int>(weapon + SkinOff::FallbackPaintKit));
            // Try reading defIndex at DIFFERENT offsets to find the right one
            fprintf(dbg, "  +0x1BA=%d +0x13B2=%d +0x1362=%d +0x1BE=%d\n",
                Read<short>(weapon + 0x1BA),
                Read<short>(weapon + 0x13B2),
                Read<short>(weapon + 0x1362),
                Read<short>(weapon + 0x1BE));
            // Also try direct m_Item access
            fprintf(dbg, "  AttrMgr=0x%llX\n",
                (unsigned long long)Read<uintptr_t>(weapon + 0x11A8));
            fclose(dbg);
        }
        lastSkinDbg = skinNow;
    }

    if (defIndex <= 0) return;

    // Select paint kit
    int paintKit = 0;
    bool isKnife = false;
    switch (defIndex) {
        case WepID::AK47:    paintKit = cfg_skinAK; break;
        case WepID::M4A4:
        case WepID::M4A1S:   paintKit = cfg_skinM4; break;
        case WepID::AWP:     paintKit = cfg_skinAWP; break;
        case WepID::DEAGLE:  paintKit = cfg_skinDeagle; break;
        case WepID::USPS:
        case WepID::GLOCK:   paintKit = cfg_skinUSP; break;
        case WepID::KNIFE_CT:
        case WepID::KNIFE_T: paintKit = cfg_skinKnife; isKnife = true; break;
        default: paintKit = cfg_skinAK; break;
    }

    if (paintKit <= 0) return;

    // Read local player's account ID for proper skin ownership
    static uint32_t localAccountID = 0;
    if (!localAccountID) {
        // Read from local controller's steam ID or use a placeholder
        uintptr_t localCtrl = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + 0x2384DB0);
        if (localCtrl) {
            // m_steamID is at controller + some offset, try reading xuid
            localAccountID = Read<uint32_t>(weapon + SkinOff::AccountID);
            if (!localAccountID) localAccountID = 1; // fallback
        }
    }

    // Step 1: Write fallback skin data
    Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::FallbackPaintKit, paintKit);
    Write<float>(weapon + SkinOff::FallbackWear, cfg_skinWear);
    Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::FallbackSeed, cfg_skinSeed);
    Write<int>(weapon + 0x168C, 0); // FallbackStatTrak = 0

    // Step 2: Force fallback mode — set item IDs to trigger fallback system
    Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::ItemIDHigh, -1);
    Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::ItemIDLow, -1);
    Write<uint32_t>(weapon + SkinOff::AccountID, localAccountID);

    // Step 3: Force initialized
    Write<bool>(weapon + SkinOff::Initialized, true);

    // Step 4: Set entity quality (normal = 4, knife = 3)
    if (isKnife) {
        Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::EntityQuality, 3);
        if (cfg_knifeModel > 0)
            Write<short>(weapon + SkinOff::DefIndex, (short)cfg_knifeModel);
    } else {
        Write<int>(weapon + SkinOff::EntityQuality, 4);
    }

    // Step 5: Also write OriginalOwnerXuid to match our account
    Write<uint32_t>(weapon + 0x1678, localAccountID); // m_OriginalOwnerXuidLow
    Write<uint32_t>(weapon + 0x167C, 0);              // m_OriginalOwnerXuidHigh
}

static void RunBhop() {
    if (!cfg_bhop || !(GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000)) return;
    uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!pawn) return;
    int flags = Read<int>(pawn + O::m_fFlags);
    if (flags & 1) Write<int>(g_clientBase + O::dwForceJump, 65537);
    else Write<int>(g_clientBase + O::dwForceJump, 256);
}

static void RunNoFlash() {
    if (!cfg_noflash) return;
    uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (pawn) Write<float>(pawn + O::m_flFlashMaxAlpha, 0.f);
}

static void RunFOVChanger() {
    if (!cfg_fovChanger) return;
    uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
    if (!pawn) return;
    uintptr_t camServices = Read<uintptr_t>(pawn + O::m_pCameraServices);
    if (camServices) {
        Write<uint32_t>(camServices + O::m_iFOV, (uint32_t)cfg_fovValue);
    }
}

static void RunClanTag() {
    if (!cfg_clanTag) return;
    uintptr_t localCtrl = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerController);
    if (!localCtrl) return;

    static DWORD lastAnim = 0;
    static int animIdx = 0;
    DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    if (now - lastAnim < 300) return; // Only update every 300ms
    lastAnim = now;
    animIdx++;

    int len = (int)strlen(cfg_clanTagText);
    if (len <= 0) return;

    // Build animated version (rotate characters)
    char animTag[16] = {};
    int shift = animIdx % len;
    for (int c = 0; c < len && c < 15; c++) {
        animTag[c] = cfg_clanTagText[(c + shift) % len];
    }
    animTag[len] = 0;

    // m_szClan at 0x860 is a CUtlString — read the char* pointer, write string there
    uintptr_t strPtr = Read<uintptr_t>(localCtrl + 0x860);
    if (strPtr && strPtr > 0x10000) {
        // Write to existing string buffer
        WriteProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPVOID)strPtr, animTag, len + 1, nullptr);
    } else {
        // No existing buffer — allocate one in CS2's memory
        static uintptr_t allocBuf = 0;
        if (!allocBuf) {
            allocBuf = (uintptr_t)VirtualAllocEx(g_hProc, nullptr, 32,
                MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
        }
        if (allocBuf) {
            WriteProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPVOID)allocBuf, animTag, len + 1, nullptr);
            Write<uintptr_t>(localCtrl + 0x860, allocBuf);
        }
    }
}

static void RunAutoAccept() {
    if (!cfg_autoAccept) return;
    // Auto accept works by writing to the accept button state
    // dwForceButtons or by detecting the accept dialog and clicking
    // For CS2: write 1 to the accept state when match found
    // The matchmaking accept is at a specific ConVar/memory location
    // Simplified: read if match is ready, force accept
    uintptr_t matchmaking = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + 0x2377410); // dwGameRules approx
    if (matchmaking) {
        bool matchReady = Read<bool>(matchmaking + 0x40); // m_bMatchWaitingForResume
        if (matchReady) {
            Write<bool>(matchmaking + 0x40, false); // Accept
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ESP Drawing
// ============================================================================
static void DrawESP() {
    ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
    float sw = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
    float sh = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);

    // Night Mode — dark overlay filter
    if (cfg_nightMode) {
        int alpha = (int)(cfg_nightAlpha * 255);
        if (alpha > 255) alpha = 255;
        dl->AddRectFilled({0,0}, {sw,sh}, IM_COL32(0, 0, 10, alpha));
    }

    // FOV circle
    if (cfg_showFov && cfg_aimbot) {
        // Convert degrees to pixel radius: pixels = tan(deg) * screenH/2
        float fovPixels = tanf(cfg_fov * 3.14159f / 180.f) * (sh / 2.f);
        dl->AddCircle(ImVec2(sw/2, sh/2), fovPixels, IM_COL32(255,255,255,80), 64, 1.f);
    }

    // Bomb ESP — with real timer via GlobalVars->curtime
    if (cfg_espBomb) {
        uintptr_t plantedC4Ptr = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwPlantedC4);
        if (plantedC4Ptr) {
            uintptr_t bombEntity = Read<uintptr_t>(plantedC4Ptr);
            if (bombEntity) {
                bool ticking = Read<bool>(bombEntity + 0x11A0);
                if (ticking) {
                    uintptr_t bombNode = Read<uintptr_t>(bombEntity + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
                    if (bombNode) {
                        Vec3 bombPos = Read<Vec3>(bombNode + O::m_vecAbsOrigin);
                        Vec2 bombScr;
                        Mat4 vm = Read<Mat4>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewMatrix);
                        if (W2S(bombPos, bombScr, vm, sw, sh)) {
                            // Read game time from GlobalVars
                            uintptr_t globalVars = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwGlobalVars);
                            float curTime = globalVars ? Read<float>(globalVars + 0x34) : 0.f; // curtime at +0x34

                            float blowTime = Read<float>(bombEntity + O::m_flC4Blow);
                            bool beingDefused = Read<bool>(bombEntity + 0x11DC);
                            bool exploded = Read<bool>(bombEntity + 0x11D5);
                            bool defused = Read<bool>(bombEntity + 0x11F4);
                            int bombSite = Read<int>(bombEntity + 0x11A4);

                            if (!exploded && !defused) {
                                // Real remaining time
                                float remaining = blowTime - curTime;
                                if (remaining < 0) remaining = 0;

                                ImFont* font = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 0 ?
                                    ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[0] : ImGui::GetFont();

                                // Bomb text with real countdown
                                char bombText[64];
                                sprintf_s(bombText, "BOMB [%s] %.1fs",
                                    bombSite == 0 ? "A" : "B", remaining);

                                ImVec2 ts = font->CalcTextSizeA(14.f, FLT_MAX, 0, bombText);
                                float bx = bombScr.x - ts.x/2;
                                float by = bombScr.y - 20;

                                // Color based on urgency
                                ImU32 bgCol = remaining < 5.f ?
                                    IM_COL32(220, 20, 20, 220) : IM_COL32(180, 30, 30, 200);

                                dl->AddRectFilled({bx-8, by-4}, {bx+ts.x+8, by+16}, bgCol, 8.f);
                                dl->AddText(font, 14.f, {bx, by}, IM_COL32(255,255,255,255), bombText);

                                // Pulsing circle — faster when close to exploding
                                static float pulse = 0;
                                pulse += remaining < 5.f ? 0.15f : 0.05f;
                                float pulseR = 8 + sinf(pulse) * 4;
                                dl->AddCircle({bombScr.x, bombScr.y}, pulseR,
                                    IM_COL32(255, 50, 50, 200), 16, 2.f);

                                // Defuse indicator with real defuse countdown
                                if (beingDefused) {
                                    float defuseEnd = Read<float>(bombEntity + O::m_flDefuseCountDown);
                                    float defuseRemain = defuseEnd - curTime;
                                    if (defuseRemain < 0) defuseRemain = 0;

                                    bool canDefuse = defuseRemain < remaining;
                                    char defText[48];
                                    sprintf_s(defText, "%s %.1fs",
                                        canDefuse ? "DEFUSING" : "NO TIME!", defuseRemain);

                                    ImVec2 ds = font->CalcTextSizeA(12.f, FLT_MAX, 0, defText);
                                    ImU32 defCol = canDefuse ?
                                        IM_COL32(30, 150, 30, 220) : IM_COL32(200, 30, 30, 220);
                                    dl->AddRectFilled({bx-8, by+18}, {bx+ds.x+8, by+34}, defCol, 6.f);
                                    dl->AddText(font, 12.f, {bx, by+20},
                                        IM_COL32(255,255,255,255), defText);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Dropped Weapon ESP
    if (cfg_espDroppedWeapons) {
        uintptr_t entList = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
        if (entList) {
            Mat4 vm = Read<Mat4>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewMatrix);

            for (int i = 65; i < 512; i++) {
                uintptr_t entry = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8*((i&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (!entry) continue;
                uintptr_t ent = Read<uintptr_t>(entry + 112*(i&0x1FF));
                if (!ent) continue;

                // Check if it has a scene node (world entity)
                uintptr_t node = Read<uintptr_t>(ent + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
                if (!node) continue;

                // Check if it has item definition index (weapon)
                short defIdx = Read<short>(ent + 0x13B2);
                if (defIdx <= 0 || defIdx > 70) continue;

                // Skip if it's a player pawn (health > 0)
                int hp = Read<int>(ent + O::m_iHealth);
                if (hp > 0) continue;

                // Get weapon name
                const char* wName = nullptr;
                switch(defIdx) {
                    case 7: wName="AK-47"; break; case 9: wName="AWP"; break;
                    case 16: wName="M4A4"; break; case 60: wName="M4A1-S"; break;
                    case 1: wName="Deagle"; break; case 61: wName="USP-S"; break;
                    case 40: wName="Scout"; break; case 8: wName="AUG"; break;
                    case 10: wName="FAMAS"; break; case 13: wName="Galil"; break;
                    case 19: wName="P90"; break; case 17: wName="MAC-10"; break;
                    case 24: wName="UMP"; break; case 14: wName="M249"; break;
                    case 28: wName="Negev"; break; case 25: wName="XM1014"; break;
                    case 27: wName="MAG-7"; break;
                    default: continue;
                }

                Vec3 wPos = Read<Vec3>(node + O::m_vecAbsOrigin);
                Vec2 wScr;
                if (W2S(wPos, wScr, vm, sw, sh)) {
                    ImFont* font = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 2 ?
                        ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[2] : ImGui::GetFont();
                    ImVec2 ts = font->CalcTextSizeA(11.f, FLT_MAX, 0, wName);

                    // Background pill
                    dl->AddRectFilled({wScr.x-ts.x/2-4, wScr.y-2},
                        {wScr.x+ts.x/2+4, wScr.y+12},
                        IM_COL32(40,40,50,180), 4.f);

                    // Weapon name
                    dl->AddText(font, 11.f, {wScr.x-ts.x/2, wScr.y},
                        IM_COL32(200,200,220,255), wName);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Hitmarker — draws X at crosshair when you hit someone
    if (cfg_espHitmarker && g_hitmarkerAlpha > 0.f) {
        DWORD elapsed = GetTickCount() - g_hitmarkerTime;
        float duration = 300.f; // ms
        g_hitmarkerAlpha = 1.f - (elapsed / duration);
        if (g_hitmarkerAlpha < 0.f) g_hitmarkerAlpha = 0.f;

        float cx = sw / 2.f, cy = sh / 2.f;
        float sz = 8.f;  // line length
        float gap = 3.f; // gap from center
        int alpha = (int)(g_hitmarkerAlpha * 255);

        // Kill = red, regular hit = white
        ImU32 hmCol = g_hitmarkerKill ?
            IM_COL32(255, 40, 40, alpha) : IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, alpha);
        ImU32 hmOutline = IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, alpha/2);

        // 4 lines forming X shape with gap in center
        float thick = 2.f;
        // Top-left to center
        dl->AddLine({cx-gap-sz, cy-gap-sz}, {cx-gap, cy-gap}, hmOutline, thick+1.f);
        dl->AddLine({cx-gap-sz, cy-gap-sz}, {cx-gap, cy-gap}, hmCol, thick);
        // Top-right to center
        dl->AddLine({cx+gap+sz, cy-gap-sz}, {cx+gap, cy-gap}, hmOutline, thick+1.f);
        dl->AddLine({cx+gap+sz, cy-gap-sz}, {cx+gap, cy-gap}, hmCol, thick);
        // Bottom-left to center
        dl->AddLine({cx-gap-sz, cy+gap+sz}, {cx-gap, cy+gap}, hmOutline, thick+1.f);
        dl->AddLine({cx-gap-sz, cy+gap+sz}, {cx-gap, cy+gap}, hmCol, thick);
        // Bottom-right to center
        dl->AddLine({cx+gap+sz, cy+gap+sz}, {cx+gap, cy+gap}, hmOutline, thick+1.f);
        dl->AddLine({cx+gap+sz, cy+gap+sz}, {cx+gap, cy+gap}, hmCol, thick);
    }

    // Damage Logger — floating damage numbers
    if (cfg_espDmgLogger) {
        ImFont* dmgFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 1 ?
            ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[1] : ImGui::GetFont(); // 18px header font
        DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        float lifetime = 1500.f; // 1.5 seconds

        for (int d = 0; d < 16; d++) {
            auto& di = g_dmgLog[d];
            if (!di.active) continue;

            float elapsed = (float)(now - di.spawnTime);
            if (elapsed > lifetime) { di.active = false; continue; }

            float t = elapsed / lifetime; // 0→1
            float alpha = 1.f - (t * t); // Quadratic fadeout (stays visible longer)
            float rise = t * 60.f;        // Float upward 60px over lifetime

            // Scale: starts at 1.0, grows slightly for kills
            float scale = di.isKill ? 1.2f : 1.0f;

            char txt[16];
            sprintf_s(txt, "-%d", di.damage);

            float fontSize = 16.f * scale;
            ImVec2 ts = dmgFont->CalcTextSizeA(fontSize, FLT_MAX, 0, txt);
            float drawX = di.x - ts.x / 2;
            float drawY = di.y - rise;

            int a = (int)(alpha * 255);
            ImU32 textCol = di.isKill ?
                IM_COL32(255, 50, 50, a) :    // Red for kills
                IM_COL32(255, 220, 60, a);    // Gold for regular damage
            ImU32 shadowCol = IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, a/2);

            // Shadow + text
            dl->AddText(dmgFont, fontSize, {drawX+1, drawY+1}, shadowCol, txt);
            dl->AddText(dmgFont, fontSize, {drawX, drawY}, textCol, txt);
        }
    }

    if (!cfg_esp) return;

    // Read viewMatrix once for 3D features
    Mat4 espVM = Read<Mat4>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewMatrix);

    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        auto& p = g_players[i];
        if (!p.valid || !p.onScreen) continue;
        if (!cfg_espShowTeam && !p.enemy) continue;
        if (cfg_espVisCheck && !p.visible) continue;

        // Select color set based on: team / visible enemy / hidden enemy
        float *cBox, *cSkel, *cName, *cSnap;
        if (!p.enemy) {
            cBox = cfg_colTeamBox; cSkel = cfg_colTeamSkeleton;
            cName = cfg_colTeamName; cSnap = cfg_colTeamBox;
        } else if (p.visible) {
            cBox = cfg_colVisBox; cSkel = cfg_colVisSkeleton;
            cName = cfg_colVisName; cSnap = cfg_colVisSnap;
        } else {
            cBox = cfg_colHidBox; cSkel = cfg_colHidSkeleton;
            cName = cfg_colHidName; cSnap = cfg_colHidSnap;
        }
        ImU32 col = IM_COL32((int)(cBox[0]*255),(int)(cBox[1]*255),(int)(cBox[2]*255),255);

        float rawH = p.feetScreen.y - p.headScreen.y;
        if (rawH < 4) continue;

        // Minimal padding (just 2%)
        float pad = rawH * 0.02f;
        float h = rawH + pad;
        float w = h * 0.45f;
        float x = p.headScreen.x - w / 2;
        float y = p.headScreen.y - pad;

        // Get custom font for ESP text
        ImFont* espFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 2 ? ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[2] : nullptr; // 12px small font

        // Corner box with outline
        if (cfg_espBoxes) {
            float cl = h * 0.18f;
            ImU32 outline = IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 120);
            // Outline (black shadow)
            auto boxLine = [&](ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b) {
                dl->AddLine(a, b, outline, 3.0f);
                dl->AddLine(a, b, col, 1.5f);
            };
            boxLine({x,y},{x+cl,y}); boxLine({x,y},{x,y+cl});
            boxLine({x+w,y},{x+w-cl,y}); boxLine({x+w,y},{x+w,y+cl});
            boxLine({x,y+h},{x+cl,y+h}); boxLine({x,y+h},{x,y+h-cl});
            boxLine({x+w,y+h},{x+w-cl,y+h}); boxLine({x+w,y+h},{x+w,y+h-cl});
        }

        // 3D Box — rotates with player's facing direction
        if (cfg_esp3DBox) {
            float yawRad = p.eyeYaw * 3.14159f / 180.f;
            float cYaw = cosf(yawRad), sYaw = sinf(yawRad);

            // Player bounding box (16 units half-width, 72 units tall)
            float hw = 16.f;  // half-width
            float hd = 16.f;  // half-depth (same as width for player)
            float ht = 72.f;  // full height

            Vec3 base = p.worldPos;

            // 8 corners of 3D box (rotated by yaw)
            Vec3 corners[8];
            float offsets[4][2] = {{-hw,-hd},{hw,-hd},{hw,hd},{-hw,hd}};
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                float rx = offsets[c][0]*cYaw - offsets[c][1]*sYaw;
                float ry = offsets[c][0]*sYaw + offsets[c][1]*cYaw;
                corners[c]   = {base.x+rx, base.y+ry, base.z};       // bottom
                corners[c+4] = {base.x+rx, base.y+ry, base.z+ht};    // top
            }

            // Project all 8 corners to screen
            Vec2 scr[8];
            bool allVis = true;
            for (int c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
                if (!W2S(corners[c], scr[c], espVM, sw, sh)) { allVis = false; break; }
            }

            if (allVis) {
                ImU32 lineCol = col;
                ImU32 outCol = IM_COL32(0,0,0,100);
                // Bottom face
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                    int n = (c+1)%4;
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[n].x,scr[n].y}, outCol, 2.5f);
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[n].x,scr[n].y}, lineCol, 1.2f);
                }
                // Top face
                for (int c = 4; c < 8; c++) {
                    int n = 4 + (c-4+1)%4;
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[n].x,scr[n].y}, outCol, 2.5f);
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[n].x,scr[n].y}, lineCol, 1.2f);
                }
                // Vertical edges
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[c+4].x,scr[c+4].y}, outCol, 2.5f);
                    dl->AddLine({scr[c].x,scr[c].y},{scr[c+4].x,scr[c+4].y}, lineCol, 1.2f);
                }
            }
        }

        // Health bar with background
        if (cfg_espHealth) {
            float hf = p.health / 100.f;
            ImU32 hc = IM_COL32((int)(255*(1-hf)), (int)(255*hf), 0, 255);
            dl->AddRectFilled({x-6, y-1}, {x-1, y+h+1}, IM_COL32(0,0,0,120)); // bg
            dl->AddRectFilled({x-5, y+h*(1-hf)}, {x-2, y+h}, hc);
        }

        // Glow — follows player body shape using bone positions
        if (cfg_espGlow) {
            int r = (int)(cBox[0]*255), g = (int)(cBox[1]*255), b = (int)(cBox[2]*255);

            // Count valid bones
            int validBones = 0;
            for (int b2 = 0; b2 < NUM_BONES; b2++) if (p.bones[b2].valid) validBones++;

            if (validBones >= 8) {
                // Draw glow circles at each bone position (body-shaped glow)
                int boneList[] = {
                    BONE_HEAD, BONE_NECK, BONE_SPINE2, BONE_SPINE1, BONE_SPINE0, BONE_PELVIS,
                    BONE_L_SHOULDER, BONE_L_FOREARM, BONE_L_HAND,
                    BONE_R_SHOULDER, BONE_R_FOREARM, BONE_R_HAND,
                    BONE_L_THIGH, BONE_L_CALF, BONE_L_FOOT,
                    BONE_R_THIGH, BONE_R_CALF, BONE_R_FOOT
                };
                float boneRadius[] = {
                    8,6,7,7,7,7,   // spine: head bigger
                    5,4,3,          // left arm: shoulder→hand shrinks
                    5,4,3,          // right arm
                    6,5,4,          // left leg
                    6,5,4           // right leg
                };

                for (int layer = cfg_espGlowIntensity; layer >= 1; layer--) {
                    float scale = 1.0f + (float)layer * 0.6f;
                    int alpha = 12 + (cfg_espGlowIntensity - layer) * 5;

                    for (int bi = 0; bi < 18; bi++) {
                        int idx = boneList[bi];
                        if (idx >= NUM_BONES || !p.bones[idx].valid) continue;
                        float rad = boneRadius[bi] * scale * (h / 120.f);
                        if (rad < 2) rad = 2;
                        dl->AddCircleFilled(
                            {p.bones[idx].pos.x, p.bones[idx].pos.y},
                            rad, IM_COL32(r, g, b, alpha), 12);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Fallback: proportional body glow if not enough bones
                float cx2 = p.headScreen.x;
                float segments[][3] = { // {y_offset%, radius%, alpha_mult}
                    {0.05f, 0.08f, 1.0f},   // head
                    {0.15f, 0.06f, 0.9f},   // neck
                    {0.25f, 0.10f, 0.9f},   // chest
                    {0.40f, 0.09f, 0.8f},   // waist
                    {0.55f, 0.08f, 0.8f},   // hips
                    {0.70f, 0.06f, 0.7f},   // knees
                    {0.90f, 0.05f, 0.6f},   // ankles
                };
                for (int layer = cfg_espGlowIntensity; layer >= 1; layer--) {
                    float scale = 1.0f + (float)layer * 0.5f;
                    int baseAlpha = 12 + (cfg_espGlowIntensity - layer) * 5;
                    for (auto& seg : segments) {
                        float sy = y + h * seg[0];
                        float rad = h * seg[1] * scale;
                        int alpha = (int)(baseAlpha * seg[2]);
                        dl->AddCircleFilled({cx2, sy}, rad, IM_COL32(r,g,b,alpha), 12);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Box Fill — semi-transparent fill inside box
        if (cfg_espBoxFill) {
            ImU32 fillCol = IM_COL32((int)(cBox[0]*255),(int)(cBox[1]*255),(int)(cBox[2]*255), 30);
            dl->AddRectFilled({x, y}, {x+w, y+h}, fillCol);
        }

        // Armor bar — right side, blue (always show background)
        if (cfg_espArmor) {
            float barW = 4.f;
            float barX = x + w + 3;
            // Background
            dl->AddRectFilled({barX-1, y-1}, {barX+barW+1, y+h+1}, IM_COL32(0,0,0,120));
            // Fill
            if (p.armor > 0) {
                float af = (float)p.armor / 100.f;
                if (af > 1.f) af = 1.f;
                dl->AddRectFilled({barX, y+h*(1-af)}, {barX+barW, y+h}, IM_COL32(50,140,255,255));
            }
        }

        // Head dot — circle at head with visibility-based color
        if (cfg_espHeadDot) {
            ImU32 dotCol = p.visible ? IM_COL32(255,255,0,255) : IM_COL32(255,80,80,255);
            float dotR = h * 0.025f; if (dotR < 2) dotR = 2; if (dotR > 5) dotR = 5;
            dl->AddCircleFilled({p.headScreen.x, p.headScreen.y}, dotR+1, IM_COL32(0,0,0,150));
            dl->AddCircleFilled({p.headScreen.x, p.headScreen.y}, dotR, dotCol);
        }

        // Skeleton — real bones with validation + shadow
        if (cfg_espSkeleton) {
            ImU32 skelCol = IM_COL32((int)(cSkel[0]*255),(int)(cSkel[1]*255),(int)(cSkel[2]*255),230);
            ImU32 shadowCol = IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 90);

            // Count valid bones
            int validCount = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BONES; b++) if (p.bones[b].valid) validCount++;

            if (validCount >= 8) {
                // Helper: draw one bone connection with validation
                auto drawBone = [&](int f, int t, float maxLen) {
                    if (f >= NUM_BONES || t >= NUM_BONES) return;
                    if (!p.bones[f].valid || !p.bones[t].valid) return;
                    ImVec2 a = {p.bones[f].pos.x, p.bones[f].pos.y};
                    ImVec2 b = {p.bones[t].pos.x, p.bones[t].pos.y};
                    float ld = sqrtf((b.x-a.x)*(b.x-a.x)+(b.y-a.y)*(b.y-a.y));
                    if (ld > maxLen || ld < 0.5f) return;
                    dl->AddLine(a, b, shadowCol, 2.6f);
                    dl->AddLine(a, b, skelCol, 1.2f);
                };

                float maxSpine = h * 0.30f;
                float maxArm   = h * 0.40f;
                float maxLeg   = h * 0.45f; // Legs are longer

                // SPINE: head(7) → neck(6) → spine2(5) → spine1(4) → spine0(3) → pelvis(1)
                drawBone(BONE_HEAD, BONE_NECK, maxSpine);
                drawBone(BONE_NECK, BONE_SPINE2, maxSpine);
                drawBone(BONE_SPINE2, BONE_SPINE1, maxSpine);
                drawBone(BONE_SPINE1, BONE_SPINE0, maxSpine);
                drawBone(BONE_SPINE0, BONE_PELVIS, maxSpine);

                // ARMS: spine2(5) → shoulder(9/13) → forearm(10/14) → hand(11/15)
                drawBone(BONE_SPINE2, BONE_L_SHOULDER, maxArm);
                drawBone(BONE_L_SHOULDER, BONE_L_FOREARM, maxArm);
                drawBone(BONE_L_FOREARM, BONE_L_HAND, maxArm);

                drawBone(BONE_SPINE2, BONE_R_SHOULDER, maxArm);
                drawBone(BONE_R_SHOULDER, BONE_R_FOREARM, maxArm);
                drawBone(BONE_R_FOREARM, BONE_R_HAND, maxArm);

                // LEGS: pelvis(1) → thigh(17/20) → calf(18/21) → foot(19/22)
                drawBone(BONE_PELVIS, BONE_L_THIGH, maxLeg);
                drawBone(BONE_L_THIGH, BONE_L_CALF, maxLeg);
                drawBone(BONE_L_CALF, BONE_L_FOOT, maxLeg);

                drawBone(BONE_PELVIS, BONE_R_THIGH, maxLeg);
                drawBone(BONE_R_THIGH, BONE_R_CALF, maxLeg);
                drawBone(BONE_R_CALF, BONE_R_FOOT, maxLeg);

                // Head circle
                if (p.bones[BONE_HEAD].valid) {
                    float hr = h * 0.032f;
                    if (hr < 2) hr = 2; if (hr > 6) hr = 6;
                    dl->AddCircle({p.bones[BONE_HEAD].pos.x, p.bones[BONE_HEAD].pos.y}, hr, skelCol, 14, 1.1f);
                }
            } else {
                // FALLBACK proportional skeleton (not enough bones)
                float cx2 = p.headScreen.x, top = p.headScreen.y;
                auto bone = [&](float x1,float y1,float x2,float y2){
                    dl->AddLine({x1,y1},{x2,y2},shadowCol,2.8f);
                    dl->AddLine({x1,y1},{x2,y2},skelCol,1.3f);
                };
                float nY=top+h*.09f, sY=top+h*.15f, eY=top+h*.37f, hY=top+h*.53f, kY=top+h*.75f;
                float sW=w*.36f, eW=w*.40f, hW=w*.17f;
                dl->AddCircle({cx2,top+h*.04f},h*.035f,skelCol,12,1.1f);
                bone(cx2,top+h*.08f,cx2,nY); bone(cx2,nY,cx2,hY);
                bone(cx2,nY,cx2-sW,sY); bone(cx2,nY,cx2+sW,sY);
                bone(cx2-sW,sY,cx2-eW,eY); bone(cx2+sW,sY,cx2+eW,eY);
                bone(cx2,hY,cx2-hW,kY); bone(cx2,hY,cx2+hW,kY);
                bone(cx2-hW,kY,cx2-hW*.9f,top+h); bone(cx2+hW,kY,cx2+hW*.9f,top+h);
            }
        }

        // Head dot
        if (cfg_espHeadDot) {
            dl->AddCircleFilled({p.headScreen.x, p.headScreen.y}, 3.f, col);
        }

        // Name — using custom font
        if (cfg_espName && p.name[0]) {
            ImU32 nameCol = IM_COL32((int)(cName[0]*255),(int)(cName[1]*255),(int)(cName[2]*255),255);
            float fontSize = espFont ? 12.0f : 13.0f;
            ImFont* font = espFont ? espFont : ImGui::GetFont();
            ImVec2 ts = font->CalcTextSizeA(fontSize, FLT_MAX, 0, p.name);
            float tx = x + w/2 - ts.x/2;
            float ty = y - fontSize - 3;
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {tx+1, ty+1}, IM_COL32(0,0,0,180), p.name);
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {tx, ty}, nameCol, p.name);
        }

        // Distance — using custom font
        if (cfg_espDistance) {
            char dist[16]; sprintf_s(dist, "%.0fm", p.dist);
            float fontSize = espFont ? 11.0f : 12.0f;
            ImFont* font = espFont ? espFont : ImGui::GetFont();
            ImVec2 ds = font->CalcTextSizeA(fontSize, FLT_MAX, 0, dist);
            float tx = x + w/2 - ds.x/2;
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {tx+1, y+h+3}, IM_COL32(0,0,0,160), dist);
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {tx, y+h+2}, IM_COL32(200,200,200,220), dist);
        }

        // Weapon name
        if (cfg_espWeapon && p.weaponName[0]) {
            float fontSize = espFont ? 11.0f : 12.0f;
            ImFont* font = espFont ? espFont : ImGui::GetFont();
            ImVec2 ws = font->CalcTextSizeA(fontSize, FLT_MAX, 0, p.weaponName);
            float ty = y + h + (cfg_espDistance ? 15 : 2);
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {x+w/2-ws.x/2+1, ty+1}, IM_COL32(0,0,0,160), p.weaponName);
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {x+w/2-ws.x/2, ty}, IM_COL32(180,180,200,255), p.weaponName);
        }

        // Player flags (icons/text above the box)
        if (cfg_espFlags) {
            float flagY = y - (cfg_espName ? 28 : 14);
            float flagX = x + w + 4;
            float fontSize = espFont ? 10.0f : 11.0f;
            ImFont* font = espFont ? espFont : ImGui::GetFont();

            if (p.isScoped) {
                dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {flagX, flagY}, IM_COL32(100,200,255,255), "SCOPE");
                flagY += 12;
            }
            if (p.isDefusing) {
                dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {flagX, flagY}, IM_COL32(255,200,50,255), "DEFUSE");
                flagY += 12;
            }
            if (p.armor > 0) {
                char armorTxt[8]; sprintf_s(armorTxt, "A:%d", p.armor);
                dl->AddText(font, fontSize, {flagX, flagY}, IM_COL32(100,160,255,200), armorTxt);
            }
        }

        // Snaplines
        if (cfg_espSnaplines) {
            ImU32 snapCol = IM_COL32((int)(cSnap[0]*255),(int)(cSnap[1]*255),(int)(cSnap[2]*255),(int)(cSnap[3]*255));
            dl->AddLine({sw/2,sh},{p.feetScreen.x,p.feetScreen.y},snapCol,1.f);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Menu
// ============================================================================
// Use custom Givenchy-style section header
static void SectionHeader(const char* text) { NxWidgets::Header(text); }

// Helper: status dot
static void StatusDot(bool active) {
    ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddCircleFilled(
        ImVec2(p.x + 4, p.y + ImGui::GetTextLineHeight() * 0.5f), 3.f,
        active ? IM_COL32(80, 220, 100, 255) : IM_COL32(100, 100, 110, 255));
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(12, 0));
    ImGui::SameLine();
}

static void DrawMenu() {
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos({30,30}, ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize({640,480}, ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);

    ImGui::Begin("Project Nexus", nullptr,
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize);

    // Header
    int pCount=0, eCount=0;
    for(int i=0;i<64;i++){if(g_players[i].valid){pCount++;if(g_players[i].enemy)eCount++;}}

    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f,0.843f,0.0f,1), "PROJECT NEXUS");
    ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - 220);
    StatusDot(pCount > 0);
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Players: %d  |  Enemies: %d", pCount, eCount);

    ImVec2 wp = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
    float wy = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos().y;
    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddLine(
        ImVec2(wp.x + 8, wy), ImVec2(wp.x + ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - 8, wy),
        IM_COL32(255, 215, 0, 60), 1.f);
    ImGui::Spacing();

    if (ImGui::BeginTabBar("##tabs", ImGuiTabBarFlags_FittingPolicyResizeDown)) {

        // ============ COMBAT TAB ============
        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("  Combat  ")) {
            float panelW = (ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 12) * 0.5f;
            float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4;

            // LEFT PANEL — Aimbot
            ImGui::BeginChild("##aim_panel", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                SectionHeader("AIMBOT");
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Enable Aimbot", &cfg_aimbot);

                NxWidgets::Keybind("Aim Key", &cfg_aimKey);

                ImGui::Text("Bone");       ImGui::SameLine(100);
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                ImGui::Combo("##bn", &cfg_aimBone, boneNames, IM_ARRAYSIZE(boneNames));

                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##fv", &cfg_fov, 1, 30, "FOV: %.1f deg");
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                ImGui::SliderFloat("##sm", &cfg_smooth, 1, 20, "Smooth: %.1f");

                NxWidgets::Toggle("Team Check", &cfg_teamCheck);
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Draw FOV Circle", &cfg_showFov);
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Visible Only", &cfg_aimVisCheck);
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Target Lock", &cfg_aimLock);
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Aim RCS", &cfg_aimRCS);

                SectionHeader("RECOIL");
                NxWidgets::Toggle("No Recoil", &cfg_noRecoil);
                NxWidgets::Toggle("RCS", &cfg_rcs);
                if (cfg_rcs && !cfg_noRecoil) {
                    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                    ImGui::SliderFloat("##rcs", &cfg_rcsAmount, 0.1f, 2.0f, "Amount: %.1fx");
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndChild();

            ImGui::SameLine();

            // RIGHT PANEL — Triggerbot
            ImGui::BeginChild("##trig_panel", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                SectionHeader("TRIGGERBOT");
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Enable Triggerbot", &cfg_triggerbot);

                NxWidgets::Keybind("Trigger Key", &cfg_triggerKey);

                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                ImGui::SliderInt("##td", &cfg_triggerDelay, 0, 200, "Delay: %d ms");

            }
            ImGui::EndChild();

            ImGui::EndTabItem();
        }

        // ============ VISUALS TAB ============
        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("  Visuals  ")) {
            float panelW = (ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 12) * 0.5f;
            float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4;

            // LEFT PANEL — ESP Elements + Filters
            ImGui::BeginChild("##esp_panel", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                SectionHeader("ESP ELEMENTS");
                NxWidgets::Toggle("Enable ESP", &cfg_esp);

                if (cfg_esp) {
                    ImGui::Spacing();
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Bounding Boxes", &cfg_espBoxes);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("3D Box", &cfg_esp3DBox);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Skeleton", &cfg_espSkeleton);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Health Bar", &cfg_espHealth);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Player Name", &cfg_espName);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Distance", &cfg_espDistance);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Snaplines", &cfg_espSnaplines);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Head Dot", &cfg_espHeadDot);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Armor Bar", &cfg_espArmor);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Weapon Name", &cfg_espWeapon);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Box Fill", &cfg_espBoxFill);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Player Flags", &cfg_espFlags);

                    SectionHeader("WORLD ESP");
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Bomb ESP", &cfg_espBomb);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Dropped Weapons", &cfg_espDroppedWeapons);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Hitmarker", &cfg_espHitmarker);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Damage Numbers", &cfg_espDmgLogger);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Spectator List", &cfg_espSpectators);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Glow Outline", &cfg_espGlow);
                    if (cfg_espGlow) {
                        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                        ImGui::SliderInt("##glowint", &cfg_espGlowIntensity, 1, 5, "Glow: %d layers");
                    }
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("2D Radar", &cfg_espRadar);
                    if (cfg_espRadar) {
                        NxWidgets::Toggle("Radar BG", &cfg_radarBg);
                        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                        ImGui::SliderFloat("##rsize", &cfg_radarSize, 80, 300, "Size: %.0f");
                        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                        ImGui::SliderFloat("##rzoom", &cfg_radarZoom, 0.3f, 5.f, "Zoom: %.1fx");
                        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                        ImGui::SliderFloat("##rposX", &cfg_radarX, 0, 400, "Pos X: %.0f");
                        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                        ImGui::SliderFloat("##rposY", &cfg_radarY, 0, 400, "Pos Y: %.0f");
                    }

                    SectionHeader("FILTERS");
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Show Team", &cfg_espShowTeam);
                    NxWidgets::Toggle("Visible Only", &cfg_espVisCheck);
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndChild();

            ImGui::SameLine();

            // RIGHT PANEL — Colors by category
            ImGui::BeginChild("##color_panel", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                SectionHeader("VISIBLE ENEMIES");
                ImGui::ColorEdit3("Box##vb", cfg_colVisBox, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Skel##vs", cfg_colVisSkeleton, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Name##vn", cfg_colVisName, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::ColorEdit4("Snap##vl", cfg_colVisSnap, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar);

                SectionHeader("HIDDEN ENEMIES");
                ImGui::ColorEdit3("Box##hb", cfg_colHidBox, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Skel##hs", cfg_colHidSkeleton, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Name##hn", cfg_colHidName, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::ColorEdit4("Snap##hl", cfg_colHidSnap, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar);

                SectionHeader("TEAM");
                ImGui::ColorEdit3("Box##tb", cfg_colTeamBox, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Skel##ts", cfg_colTeamSkeleton, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
                ImGui::SameLine(0,8); ImGui::ColorEdit3("Name##tn", cfg_colTeamName, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs);
            }
            ImGui::EndChild();

            ImGui::EndTabItem();
        }

        // ============ SKINS TAB ============
        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("  Skins  ")) {
            float panelW = (ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 12) * 0.5f;
            float panelH = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - 4;

            // Helper: skin combo selector
            auto SkinCombo = [](const char* label, int* current, SkinEntry* skins, int count) {
                const char* preview = "Default";
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    if (skins[i].id == *current) { preview = skins[i].name; break; }
                }
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo(label, preview)) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                        bool sel = (skins[i].id == *current);
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(skins[i].name, sel)) *current = skins[i].id;
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
            };

            ImGui::BeginChild("##skins_l", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                SectionHeader("SKIN CHANGER");
                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.843f, 0.0f, 1.0f), "COMING SOON");
                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::TextWrapped("Valve patched the external skin system in CS2 2026. We are developing a new method using inventory interception.");
                ImGui::Spacing();
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Status: In Development");
                ImGui::TextDisabled("ETA: Next Major Update");
            }
            ImGui::EndChild();

            ImGui::SameLine();

            ImGui::BeginChild("##skins_r", ImVec2(panelW, panelH), true);
            {
                if (cfg_skinChanger) {
                    SectionHeader("PISTOLS");
                    ImGui::Text("Deagle / USP-S / Glock");
                    SkinCombo("##pistol", &cfg_skinDeagle, skinsPistol, sizeof(skinsPistol)/sizeof(SkinEntry));

                    SectionHeader("KNIFE");
                    ImGui::Text("Model");
                    static int knifeIdx = 0;
                    if (ImGui::Combo("##kmodel", &knifeIdx, knifeModels, sizeof(knifeModels)/sizeof(const char*))) {
                        cfg_knifeModel = knifeModelIDs[knifeIdx];
                    }

                    ImGui::Text("Skin");
                    SkinCombo("##knife", &cfg_skinKnife, skinsKnife, sizeof(skinsKnife)/sizeof(SkinEntry));

                    SectionHeader("SETTINGS");
                    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
                    ImGui::SliderFloat("##wear", &cfg_skinWear, 0.0f, 1.0f, "Wear: %.4f");
                    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);

// ============================================================================
// Process attachment
// ============================================================================
static DWORD FindPID(const wchar_t* name) {
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    PROCESSENTRY32W pe{}; pe.dwSize = sizeof(pe);
    if (Process32FirstW(snap, &pe)) {
        do { if (!wcscmp(pe.szExeFile, name)) { CloseHandle(snap); return pe.th32ProcessID; } }
        while (Process32NextW(snap, &pe));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap); return 0;
}

static uintptr_t GetModBase(DWORD pid, const wchar_t* name) {
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE, pid);
    MODULEENTRY32W me{}; me.dwSize = sizeof(me);
    if (Module32FirstW(snap, &me)) {
        do { if (!wcscmp(me.szModule, name)) { CloseHandle(snap); return (uintptr_t)me.modBaseAddr; } }
        while (Module32NextW(snap, &me));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap); return 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// WndProc
// ============================================================================
static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (g_menuOpen && ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(h, m, w, l)) return true;
    if (m == WM_SIZE && g_dev && w != SIZE_MINIMIZED) {
        if (g_rtv) { g_rtv->Release(); g_rtv = nullptr; }
        g_sc->ResizeBuffers(0, LOWORD(l), HIWORD(l), DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, 0);
        ID3D11Texture2D* bb; g_sc->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&bb));
        g_dev->CreateRenderTargetView(bb, nullptr, &g_rtv); bb->Release();
    }
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

    // Security: use minimal permissions (not PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS)
    g_hProc = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, g_pid);

    }

        MSG msg;
        while (PeekMessage(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessage(&msg);
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) g_running = false;
        }
        if (!g_running) break;

        if (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_INSERT) & 1) {

        // Debug: dump visibility data for first enemy every 2 seconds
