        if (now - lastDbg > 2000) {
            int cnt = 0, en = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) { if (g_players[i].valid) { cnt++; if (g_players[i].enemy) en++; } }
            printf("[TICK] P:%d E:%d | ", cnt, en);

            // Find first enemy and dump spotted data
            for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
                if (!g_players[i].valid || !g_players[i].enemy) continue;

                // Re-read this enemy's pawn to get fresh spotted data
                uintptr_t el = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
                if (!el) break;
                int idx = i + 1;
                uintptr_t e1 = Read<uintptr_t>(el + (8*((idx&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (!e1) break;
                uintptr_t ctrl = Read<uintptr_t>(e1 + 112*(idx&0x1FF));
                if (!ctrl) break;
                uint32_t ph = Read<uint32_t>(ctrl + O::m_hPlayerPawn);
                if (!ph) break;
                uintptr_t e2 = Read<uintptr_t>(el + (8*((ph&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                if (!e2) break;
                uintptr_t pawn = Read<uintptr_t>(e2 + 112*(ph&0x1FF));
                if (!pawn) break;

                // Read 32 bytes at m_entitySpottedState
                uint8_t spottedData[32] = {};
                ReadProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPCVOID)(pawn + O::m_entitySpottedState), spottedData, 32, nullptr);

                printf("Spotted[%s]: ", g_players[i].name);
                for (int b = 0; b < 20; b++) printf("%02X ", spottedData[b]);
                printf("| vis=%d", g_players[i].visible);
                break;
            }
            printf("\n");
            lastDbg = now;
        }

        // Render
        ImGui_ImplDX11_NewFrame(); ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame(); ImGui::NewFrame();

        DrawESP();

        // Watermark — top right corner
        if (cfg_watermark) {
            ImDrawList* wdl = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
            float scrW = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
            ImFont* wFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 0 ?
                ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[0] : ImGui::GetFont();

            // Build watermark text
            static DWORD frameCount = 0; frameCount++;
            static DWORD lastFpsTime = 0; static int fps = 0; static int fpsCounter = 0;
            fpsCounter++;
            DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            if (now - lastFpsTime >= 1000) { fps = fpsCounter; fpsCounter = 0; lastFpsTime = now; }

            SYSTEMTIME st; GetLocalTime(&st);
            char wmText[128];
            sprintf_s(wmText, "NEXUS | FPS: %d | %02d:%02d:%02d", fps, st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond);

            ImVec2 ts = wFont->CalcTextSizeA(14.f, FLT_MAX, 0, wmText);
            float wmX = scrW - ts.x - 16.f;
            float wmY = 8.f;

            // Background pill
            wdl->AddRectFilled({wmX-8, wmY-4}, {wmX+ts.x+8, wmY+ts.y+4},
                IM_COL32(10,10,14,180), 4.f);
            wdl->AddRect({wmX-8, wmY-4}, {wmX+ts.x+8, wmY+ts.y+4},
                IM_COL32(255,215,0,40), 4.f);
            wdl->AddText(wFont, 14.f, {wmX, wmY}, IM_COL32(255,215,0,200), wmText);
        }

        // Spectator List — shows who is watching you
        if (cfg_espSpectators) {
            ImDrawList* sdl = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
            float scrW = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
            ImFont* sFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 0 ?
                ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[0] : ImGui::GetFont();

            // Get local player controller handle for comparison
            uintptr_t localCtrl = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerController);
            uint32_t localPawnHandle = localCtrl ? Read<uint32_t>(localCtrl + O::m_hPlayerPawn) : 0;

            char spectators[8][32] = {};
            int specCount = 0;

            if (localPawnHandle && localPawnHandle != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
                uintptr_t entList = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwEntityList);
                if (entList) {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= 64 && specCount < 8; i++) {
                        uintptr_t e1 = Read<uintptr_t>(entList + (8*((i&0x7FFF)>>9))+16);
                        if (!e1) continue;
                        uintptr_t ctrl = Read<uintptr_t>(e1 + 112*(i&0x1FF));
                        if (!ctrl || ctrl == localCtrl) continue;

                        // Check if this player is dead (spectating)
                        bool isAlive = Read<bool>(ctrl + O::m_bPawnIsAlive);
                        if (isAlive) continue;

                        // Get their observer target
                        uintptr_t obsServices = Read<uintptr_t>(ctrl + O::m_pObserverServices);
                        if (!obsServices) continue;
                        uint32_t obsTarget = Read<uint32_t>(obsServices + O::m_hObserverTarget);

                        // Compare observer target with our pawn handle
                        if (obsTarget == localPawnHandle) {
                            uintptr_t nameAddr = Read<uintptr_t>(ctrl + O::m_sSanitizedPlayerName);
                            if (nameAddr) {
                                ReadProcessMemory(g_hProc, (LPCVOID)nameAddr,
                                    spectators[specCount], 31, nullptr);
                                spectators[specCount][31] = 0;
                                specCount++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Draw spectator list (right side, below watermark)
            if (specCount > 0) {
                float startY = cfg_watermark ? 36.f : 8.f;
                float maxW = 0;
                for (int s = 0; s < specCount; s++) {
                    ImVec2 ts = sFont->CalcTextSizeA(13.f, FLT_MAX, 0, spectators[s]);
                    if (ts.x > maxW) maxW = ts.x;
                }

                float boxX = scrW - maxW - 32.f;
                float boxH = 20.f + specCount * 18.f;

                // Background
                sdl->AddRectFilled({boxX, startY}, {scrW-8, startY+boxH},
                    IM_COL32(10,10,14,180), 4.f);
                sdl->AddRect({boxX, startY}, {scrW-8, startY+boxH},
                    IM_COL32(255,80,80,60), 4.f);

                // Header
                char hdr[32]; sprintf_s(hdr, "SPECTATORS [%d]", specCount);
                sdl->AddText(sFont, 12.f, {boxX+8, startY+4},
                    IM_COL32(255,80,80,220), hdr);

                // Names
                for (int s = 0; s < specCount; s++) {
                    sdl->AddText(sFont, 13.f, {boxX+12, startY+20.f+s*18.f},
                        IM_COL32(255,255,255,200), spectators[s]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Velocity Graph — bottom center speedometer
        if (cfg_velocityGraph) {
            ImDrawList* vdl = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
            float scrW = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
            float scrH = (float)GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
            ImFont* vFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 2 ?
                ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[2] : ImGui::GetFont();

            // Read local player velocity
            uintptr_t lp = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
            float speed = 0.f;
            if (lp) {
                Vec3 vel = Read<Vec3>(lp + O::m_vecVelocity);
                speed = sqrtf(vel.x*vel.x + vel.y*vel.y); // horizontal speed only
            }

            // Store in ring buffer
            g_velHistory[g_velIdx % 128] = speed;
            g_velIdx++;

            // Graph dimensions
            float gW = 200.f, gH = 50.f;
            float gX = scrW/2 - gW/2;
            float gY = scrH - 100.f;

            // Background
            vdl->AddRectFilled({gX, gY}, {gX+gW, gY+gH}, IM_COL32(10,10,14,150), 3.f);

            // Draw velocity line graph
            float maxSpeed = 300.f; // CS2 max ~300 with knife
            for (int v = 1; v < 128; v++) {
                int i0 = (g_velIdx - 128 + v - 1 + 12800) % 128;
                int i1 = (g_velIdx - 128 + v + 12800) % 128;
                float v0 = g_velHistory[i0] / maxSpeed;
                float v1 = g_velHistory[i1] / maxSpeed;
                if (v0 > 1.f) v0 = 1.f;
                if (v1 > 1.f) v1 = 1.f;

                float x0 = gX + (v-1) * (gW/127.f);
                float x1 = gX + v * (gW/127.f);
                float y0 = gY + gH - v0 * gH;
                float y1 = gY + gH - v1 * gH;

                // Color based on speed (green→gold→red)
                ImU32 lineCol;
                if (v1 > 0.8f) lineCol = IM_COL32(255,215,0,200);
                else if (v1 > 0.5f) lineCol = IM_COL32(100,255,100,180);
                else lineCol = IM_COL32(80,180,80,160);

                vdl->AddLine({x0,y0}, {x1,y1}, lineCol, 1.5f);
            }

            // Speed text (big number)
            char speedTxt[16]; sprintf_s(speedTxt, "%.0f", speed);
            ImFont* bigFont = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts.Size > 1 ?
                ImGui::GetIO().Fonts->Fonts[1] : ImGui::GetFont();
            ImVec2 ts = bigFont->CalcTextSizeA(16.f, FLT_MAX, 0, speedTxt);
            vdl->AddText(bigFont, 16.f, {gX+gW/2-ts.x/2, gY+gH+4},
                speed > 250.f ? IM_COL32(255,215,0,255) : IM_COL32(255,255,255,200), speedTxt);
            // Units label
            vdl->AddText(vFont, 10.f, {gX+gW/2-ts.x/2+ts.x+3, gY+gH+8},
                IM_COL32(150,150,150,150), "u/s");
        }

        // 2D Radar — overlays on CS2's in-game radar
        if (cfg_espRadar) {
            ImDrawList* rdl = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
            float rSize = cfg_radarSize;
            float rX = cfg_radarX, rY = cfg_radarY;
            float rCx = rX + rSize/2, rCy = rY + rSize/2;

            // Background — off by default (transparent overlay on game radar)
            if (cfg_radarBg) {
                rdl->AddRectFilled({rX, rY}, {rX+rSize, rY+rSize}, IM_COL32(10,10,14,180), 2.f);
                rdl->AddRect({rX, rY}, {rX+rSize, rY+rSize}, IM_COL32(255,215,0,30), 2.f);
            }

            // Get local position + yaw for rotation
            uintptr_t lp = Read<uintptr_t>(g_clientBase + O::dwLocalPlayerPawn);
            if (lp) {
                uintptr_t ln = Read<uintptr_t>(lp + O::m_pGameSceneNode);
                Vec3 localPos = ln ? Read<Vec3>(ln + O::m_vecAbsOrigin) : Vec3{0,0,0};
                struct A3{float p,y,r;}; A3 la = Read<A3>(g_clientBase + O::dwViewAngles);
                float yawRad = -la.y * 3.14159f / 180.f;
                float cosY = cosf(yawRad), sinY = sinf(yawRad);

                // CS2 radar range ~= 1024 units at default zoom
                float radarRange = 1024.f / cfg_radarZoom;
                float scale = (rSize * 0.5f) / radarRange;

                for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
                    auto& p2 = g_players[i];
                    if (!p2.valid) continue;

                    // Use cached world position (no extra reads!)
                    float offX = p2.worldPos.x - localPos.x;
                    float offY = p2.worldPos.y - localPos.y;

                    // Rotate by local yaw so radar rotates with view
                    float rotX = offX * cosY - offY * sinY;
                    float rotY = offX * sinY + offY * cosY;

                    // Project to radar space
                    float dotX = rCx + rotX * scale;
                    float dotY = rCy - rotY * scale;

                    // Clamp to radar circle bounds (with padding)
                    float pad = 4.f;
                    float fromCx = dotX - rCx, fromCy = dotY - rCy;
                    float distSq = fromCx*fromCx + fromCy*fromCy;
                    float maxR = (rSize/2) - pad;
                    if (distSq > maxR*maxR) {
                        float d = sqrtf(distSq);
                        dotX = rCx + (fromCx/d)*maxR;
                        dotY = rCy + (fromCy/d)*maxR;
                    }

                    // Dot color — matches CS2 radar colors closely
                    ImU32 dotCol;
                    if (p2.enemy) {
                        dotCol = p2.visible ? IM_COL32(255,80,80,255) : IM_COL32(200,50,50,220);
                    } else {
                        dotCol = IM_COL32(80,180,80,200);
                    }

                    // Small dots to match CS2 radar style (2.5px)
                    rdl->AddCircleFilled({dotX, dotY}, 2.5f, dotCol);

                    // Direction indicator for enemies (tiny line showing their facing)
                    if (p2.enemy) {
                        float eYawRad = -(p2.eyeYaw) * 3.14159f / 180.f;
                        float dirX = sinf(eYawRad - yawRad) * 5.f;
                        float dirY = -cosf(eYawRad - yawRad) * 5.f;
                        rdl->AddLine({dotX, dotY}, {dotX+dirX, dotY+dirY},
                            IM_COL32(255,255,255,100), 1.f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (g_menuOpen) DrawMenu();

        ImGui::Render();
        const float clr[4] = {0,0,0,0};
        g_ctx->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &g_rtv, nullptr);
        g_ctx->ClearRenderTargetView(g_rtv, clr);
        ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData());
        g_sc->Present(1, 0);
    }

    ImGui_ImplDX11_Shutdown(); ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown(); ImGui::DestroyContext();
    if (g_rtv) g_rtv->Release(); if (g_sc) g_sc->Release();
    if (g_ctx) g_ctx->Release(); if (g_dev) g_dev->Release();
    if (g_hProc) CloseHandle(g_hProc);
    return 0;
}

`Overlay/src/widgets.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"

// ============================================================================
// Custom Widgets — Givenchy-inspired toggle switches + sliders
// ============================================================================

namespace NxWidgets {

// Gold accent color
inline ImU32 GoldColor(float alpha = 1.f) { return IM_COL32(255, 215, 0, (int)(alpha * 255)); }
inline ImU32 GoldDim()    { return IM_COL32(180, 150, 30, 255); }
inline ImU32 TrackOff()   { return IM_COL32(45, 44, 55, 255); }
inline ImU32 TrackOn()    { return IM_COL32(200, 170, 20, 255); }
inline ImU32 KnobColor()  { return IM_COL32(240, 240, 245, 255); }
inline ImU32 TextActive() { return IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255); }
inline ImU32 TextDim()    { return IM_COL32(114, 113, 138, 255); }

// ============================================================================
// Toggle Switch — animated ON/OFF with gold track
// ============================================================================
static bool Toggle(const char* label, bool* v) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
    if (window->SkipItems) return false;

    ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
    const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);

    const float height = ImGui::GetFrameHeight() * 0.7f;
    const float width = height * 1.9f;
    const float radius = height * 0.43f;

    ImVec2 pos = window->DC.CursorPos;
    ImVec2 labelSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label, nullptr, true);

    float totalW = width + g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + labelSize.x;
    float totalH = ImMax(height, labelSize.y);

    ImRect bb(pos, ImVec2(pos.x + totalW, pos.y + totalH + g.Style.FramePadding.y));
    ImGui::ItemSize(bb, g.Style.FramePadding.y);
    if (!ImGui::ItemAdd(bb, id)) return false;

    bool hovered, held;
    bool pressed = ImGui::ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);
    if (pressed) *v = !(*v);

    // Animate circle position
    float* animT = (float*)ImGui::GetStateStorage()->GetVoidPtr(id);
    if (!animT) {
        animT = new float(*v ? 1.f : 0.f);
        ImGui::GetStateStorage()->SetVoidPtr(id, animT);
    }
    float target = *v ? 1.f : 0.f;
    *animT += (target - *animT) * ImMin(g.IO.DeltaTime * 12.f, 1.f);

    float trackY = pos.y + (totalH - height) * 0.5f;
    ImVec2 trackMin(pos.x, trackY);
    ImVec2 trackMax(pos.x + width, trackY + height);

    // Track color lerp
    ImVec4 offCol(0.176f, 0.173f, 0.216f, 1.f);
    ImVec4 onCol(0.784f, 0.667f, 0.078f, 1.f);
    ImVec4 curCol = ImLerp(offCol, onCol, *animT);
    if (hovered) { curCol.x += 0.05f; curCol.y += 0.05f; curCol.z += 0.05f; }

    // Draw track
    window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(trackMin, trackMax,
        ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(curCol), height * 0.5f);

    // Draw knob with shadow
    float knobX = trackMin.x + radius + 2.f + (width - radius * 2 - 4.f) * (*animT);
    float knobY = trackMin.y + height * 0.5f;
    window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(knobX + 1, knobY + 1),
        radius, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 40), 16); // shadow
    window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(knobX, knobY),
        radius, KnobColor(), 16);

    // Label
    ImU32 textCol = *v ? TextActive() : TextDim();
    ImVec2 textPos(pos.x + width + g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x,
                   pos.y + (totalH - labelSize.y) * 0.5f);
    window->DrawList->AddText(textPos, textCol, label);

    return pressed;
}

// ============================================================================
// Custom Slider — thin line with circle handle
// ============================================================================
static bool SliderFloat(const char* label, float* v, float vmin, float vmax, const char* fmt = "%.1f") {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
    if (window->SkipItems) return false;

    ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
    const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);

    float lineH = 4.f;
    float dotR = 7.f;
    float height = dotR * 2 + 4.f;
    float width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;

    ImVec2 pos = window->DC.CursorPos;
    ImVec2 labelSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label);

    // Label above slider
    window->DrawList->AddText(pos, TextDim(), label);

    // Value text on right
    char valBuf[32];
    snprintf(valBuf, sizeof(valBuf), fmt, *v);
    ImVec2 valSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(valBuf);
    window->DrawList->AddText(ImVec2(pos.x + width - valSize.x, pos.y), GoldColor(), valBuf);

    pos.y += labelSize.y + 4.f;

    ImRect bb(pos, ImVec2(pos.x + width, pos.y + height));
    ImGui::ItemSize(ImVec2(width, labelSize.y + 4.f + height), 0);
    if (!ImGui::ItemAdd(bb, id)) return false;

    bool hovered, held;
    ImGui::ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);

    float t = (*v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin);
    if (held) {
        t = ImClamp((g.IO.MousePos.x - bb.Min.x) / width, 0.f, 1.f);
        *v = vmin + t * (vmax - vmin);
    }

    float lineY = pos.y + height * 0.5f;
    float dotX = pos.x + t * width;

    // Track background
    window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(
        ImVec2(pos.x, lineY - lineH * 0.5f),
        ImVec2(pos.x + width, lineY + lineH * 0.5f),
        TrackOff(), lineH * 0.5f);

    // Track filled
    window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(
        ImVec2(pos.x, lineY - lineH * 0.5f),
        ImVec2(dotX, lineY + lineH * 0.5f),
        GoldColor(), lineH * 0.5f);

    // Handle shadow + handle
    float handleR = (held || hovered) ? dotR + 1.f : dotR;
    window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(dotX + 1, lineY + 1), handleR,
        IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 50), 16);
    window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(dotX, lineY), handleR,
        GoldColor(), 16);
    window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(dotX, lineY), handleR - 2.5f,
        IM_COL32(30, 29, 37, 255), 16);

    return held;
}

static bool SliderInt(const char* label, int* v, int vmin, int vmax, const char* fmt = "%d") {
    float fv = (float)*v;
    char fmtBuf[32];
    snprintf(fmtBuf, sizeof(fmtBuf), fmt, *v);
    bool changed = SliderFloat(label, &fv, (float)vmin, (float)vmax, fmtBuf);
    *v = (int)fv;
    return changed;
}

// ============================================================================
// Section Header with gold accent line
// ============================================================================
static void Header(const char* text) {
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRectFilled(
        ImVec2(pos.x, pos.y), ImVec2(pos.x + 3, pos.y + ImGui::GetTextLineHeight()),
        GoldColor(), 1.f);
    ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + 10);
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.f, 0.843f, 0.f, 0.8f), "%s", text);
    ImGui::Spacing();
}

// ============================================================================
// Key name lookup — VK code to display string
// ============================================================================
static const char* GetKeyName(int vk) {
    switch (vk) {
        case VK_LBUTTON:  return "Mouse 1";
        case VK_RBUTTON:  return "Mouse 2";
        case VK_MBUTTON:  return "Mouse 3";
        case VK_XBUTTON1: return "Mouse 4";
        case VK_XBUTTON2: return "Mouse 5";
        case VK_BACK:     return "Backspace";
        case VK_TAB:      return "Tab";
        case VK_RETURN:   return "Enter";
        case VK_SHIFT:    return "Shift";
        case VK_CONTROL:  return "Ctrl";
        case VK_MENU:     return "Alt";
        case VK_CAPITAL:  return "Caps Lock";
        case VK_ESCAPE:   return "Escape";
        case VK_SPACE:    return "Space";
        case VK_PRIOR:    return "Page Up";
        case VK_NEXT:     return "Page Down";
        case VK_END:      return "End";
        case VK_HOME:     return "Home";
        case VK_LEFT:     return "Left";
        case VK_UP:       return "Up";
        case VK_RIGHT:    return "Right";
        case VK_DOWN:     return "Down";
        case VK_INSERT:   return "Insert";
        case VK_DELETE:   return "Delete";
        case VK_LSHIFT:   return "L-Shift";
        case VK_RSHIFT:   return "R-Shift";
        case VK_LCONTROL: return "L-Ctrl";
        case VK_RCONTROL: return "R-Ctrl";
        case VK_LMENU:    return "L-Alt";
        case VK_RMENU:    return "R-Alt";
        case VK_F1: return "F1"; case VK_F2: return "F2"; case VK_F3: return "F3";
        case VK_F4: return "F4"; case VK_F5: return "F5"; case VK_F6: return "F6";
        case VK_F7: return "F7"; case VK_F8: return "F8"; case VK_F9: return "F9";
        case VK_F10: return "F10"; case VK_F11: return "F11"; case VK_F12: return "F12";
        case VK_NUMPAD0: return "Num 0"; case VK_NUMPAD1: return "Num 1";
        case VK_NUMPAD2: return "Num 2"; case VK_NUMPAD3: return "Num 3";
        case VK_NUMPAD4: return "Num 4"; case VK_NUMPAD5: return "Num 5";
        case VK_NUMPAD6: return "Num 6"; case VK_NUMPAD7: return "Num 7";
        case VK_NUMPAD8: return "Num 8"; case VK_NUMPAD9: return "Num 9";
        default: {
            // Letters and numbers (A-Z, 0-9)
            if (vk >= 0x30 && vk <= 0x39) { static char buf[2]; buf[0] = (char)vk; buf[1] = 0; return buf; }
            if (vk >= 0x41 && vk <= 0x5A) { static char buf[2]; buf[0] = (char)vk; buf[1] = 0; return buf; }
            static char hexBuf[8]; snprintf(hexBuf, sizeof(hexBuf), "0x%02X", vk); return hexBuf;
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Keybind Widget — click to listen, press any key/mouse button to bind
// Phase 1: wait for ALL keys released (nothing held)
// Phase 2: detect first NEW key press
// ============================================================================
static bool Keybind(const char* label, int* key) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
    if (window->SkipItems) return false;

    ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
    const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);

    static ImGuiID activeKeybind = 0;
    static bool waitingRelease = false;  // Phase 1: waiting for all keys to be released
    bool isListening = (activeKeybind == id);

    // Layout
    float btnW = 110.f;
    float totalW = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    ImVec2 pos = window->DC.CursorPos;
    float h = ImGui::GetFrameHeight();

    ImRect bb(pos, ImVec2(pos.x + totalW, pos.y + h));
    ImGui::ItemSize(bb, g.Style.FramePadding.y);
    if (!ImGui::ItemAdd(bb, id)) return false;

    // Draw label
    ImVec2 labelSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label, nullptr, true);
    window->DrawList->AddText(
        ImVec2(pos.x, pos.y + (h - labelSize.y) * 0.5f),
        TextDim(), label);

    // Button area
    float btnX = pos.x + totalW - btnW;
    ImRect btnBB(ImVec2(btnX, pos.y), ImVec2(btnX + btnW, pos.y + h));
    bool hovered = ImGui::IsMouseHoveringRect(btnBB.Min, btnBB.Max);

    // Click to start listening
    if (hovered && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(0) && !isListening) {
        activeKeybind = id;
        waitingRelease = true;  // Start in phase 1
        isListening = true;
    }

    bool changed = false;
    if (isListening) {
        if (waitingRelease) {
            // Phase 1: wait until NO keys are held at all
            bool anyHeld = false;
            for (int vk = 1; vk < 255; vk++) {
                if (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) { anyHeld = true; break; }
            }
            if (!anyHeld) waitingRelease = false; // All released → go to phase 2
        } else {
            // Phase 2: detect the first NEW key press
            for (int vk = 1; vk < 255; vk++) {
                if (vk == VK_INSERT) continue;

                if (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) {
                    if (vk == VK_ESCAPE) {
                        activeKeybind = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    *key = vk;
                    activeKeybind = 0;
                    changed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Draw button
    ImU32 bgCol;
    if (isListening) bgCol = IM_COL32(200, 170, 20, 100);
    else if (hovered) bgCol = IM_COL32(60, 58, 75, 255);
    else              bgCol = IM_COL32(45, 44, 55, 255);

    window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(btnBB.Min, btnBB.Max, bgCol, 4.f);
    window->DrawList->AddRect(btnBB.Min, btnBB.Max,
        isListening ? GoldColor(0.8f) : IM_COL32(70, 68, 90, 255), 4.f);

    const char* btnText;
    if (isListening && waitingRelease) btnText = "[ ... ]";
    else if (isListening)              btnText = "[ press key ]";
    else                               btnText = GetKeyName(*key);

    ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(btnText);
    window->DrawList->AddText(
        ImVec2(btnX + (btnW - ts.x) * 0.5f, pos.y + (h - ts.y) * 0.5f),
        isListening ? GoldColor() : TextActive(), btnText);

    return changed;
}

} // namespace NxWidgets

```

## 🛡️ Anti-Detection

| Protection | Method |
|------------|--------|
| **100% External** | Separate process — never injects into CS2 |
| **No Hooks** | Zero function hooks inside the game |
| **No DLL Injection** | No LoadLibrary, no manual map needed |
| **Handle Cycling** | Closes and reopens process handle every 30s |
| **Window Spoofing** | Randomized window title every 15s |
| **Class Spoofing** | Window class mimics Windows UWP |
| **Process Disguise** | Binary named `SystemService.exe` |
| **Minimal Permissions** | Uses `VM_READ\|VM_WRITE` not `ALL_ACCESS` |
| **Humanized Aim** | Random smooth variation + micro-jitter per frame |
| **Direct Syscalls** | Loader uses NtOpenProcess (optional internal mode) |

## 📦 Installation

### For Users (Pre-built)

1. Download the latest release
2. Extract to any folder
3. Open **CS2** and join a match
4. Set CS2 to **Fullscreen Windowed** mode
5. Run **`ProjectNexus.exe`** — that's it!
6. Press **INSERT** to toggle the menu

### Files
```
📁 ProjectNexus/
├── ProjectNexus.exe      ← Launcher (run this)
└── SystemService.exe     ← Cheat engine (auto-launched)
```

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              ProjectNexus.exe                    │
│              (Launcher)                          │
│  • Detects CS2 process                          │
│  • Launches SystemService.exe                   │
└──────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                   │ launches
┌──────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│            SystemService.exe                     │
│            (External Overlay)                    │
│                                                  │
│  ┌─ ReadProcessMemory ─────────────────────┐    │
│  │  • Entity list (stride 112, +16)         │    │
│  │  • Bone positions (stride 32)            │    │
│  │  • View matrix, view angles              │    │
│  │  • Player health, team, position         │    │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                  │
│  ┌─ WriteProcessMemory ────────────────────┐    │
│  │  • dwViewAngles (aimbot)                 │    │
│  │  • dwForceJump (bhop)                    │    │
│  │  • m_flFlashMaxAlpha (no flash)          │    │
│  │  • attack button (triggerbot)            │    │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                  │
│  ┌─ DirectX 11 Overlay ────────────────────┐    │
│  │  • Transparent window (LWA_ALPHA + DWM)  │    │
│  │  • ImGui with Givenchy-style widgets     │    │
│  │  • ESP rendering (boxes, skeleton, etc.) │    │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         │                         │
    reads memory              writes memory
         │                         │
┌────────▼─────────────────────────▼───────────────┐
│                   cs2.exe                         │
│  (Game process — completely untouched)            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 🔧 Building from Source

### Requirements
- **Visual Studio 2022/2026** with C++ Desktop workload
- **CMake 3.20+**
- **Windows 10/11 SDK**

### Steps

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/ProjectNexus.git
cd ProjectNexus

# Configure
cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026" -A x64

# Build
cmake --build build --config Release

# Output
# build/Release/ProjectNexus.exe    (Launcher)
# build/Release/SystemService.exe   (Cheat)
```

### Dependencies (included in `Cheat/vendor/`)
- [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) (Docking branch) — UI rendering
- DirectX 11 — Overlay graphics
- DWM API — Window transparency

// Global (client.dll)
dwEntityList           = 0x2555050

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Is this detected by VAC?**
A: Currently undetected. The cheat is 100% external — it never modifies CS2's code or injects DLLs. However, use at your own risk.

**Q: Why doesn't ESP show?**
A: CS2 must be in **Fullscreen Windowed** mode (not exclusive fullscreen).

**Q: The menu doesn't appear?**
A: Press **INSERT** to toggle. Make sure the overlay is running.

**Q: How do I update offsets after a CS2 patch?**
A: Update the values in `Overlay/src/main.cpp` namespace `O` from [cs2-dumper](https://github.com/a2x/cs2-dumper/blob/main/output/offsets.json).

**Q: Can I get banned?**
A: Any cheat carries risk. This is for educational purposes. Use a secondary account for testing.

`Shared/shared.h`:

```h
#pragma once

// ============================================================================
// Shared header — communication protocol between driver and usermode
// Driver: syscall hook on NtConvertBetweenAuxiliaryCounterAndPerformanceCounter
// Usermode: calls the hooked NTAPI with a NEXUS_REQUEST struct
// ============================================================================

#ifdef _KERNEL_MODE
#include <ntddk.h>
#else
#include <Windows.h>
#endif

// Magic identifier — must match between driver and usermode
#define NEXUS_MAGIC 0x4E455855534353ULL  // "NEXUSCS"

// Commands
enum NexusCommand : unsigned int {
    CMD_READ_MEMORY     = 1,
    CMD_WRITE_MEMORY    = 2,
    CMD_GET_MODULE_BASE = 3,
    CMD_HIDE_MODULE     = 4,
    CMD_ALLOC_MEMORY    = 5,
    CMD_FREE_MEMORY     = 6,
    CMD_TEST_CONNECTION = 7,
};

// Shared request structure — passed to the hooked syscall as first parameter
#pragma pack(push, 8)
typedef struct _NEXUS_REQUEST {
    unsigned __int64 Magic;          // Must be NEXUS_MAGIC
    unsigned int     Command;        // NexusCommand
    unsigned int     ProcessId;      // Target PID
    unsigned __int64 Address;        // Read/write target address
    unsigned __int64 Buffer;         // Usermode buffer pointer
    unsigned __int64 Size;           // Size in bytes
    unsigned __int64 Output;         // Output value (base addr, alloc addr, etc.)
    wchar_t          ModuleName[256]; // For CMD_GET_MODULE_BASE
} NEXUS_REQUEST, *PNEXUS_REQUEST;
#pragma pack(pop)

```

`build_driver.bat`:

```bat
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "C:\Users\ATOMIZADORv10\CS2-Internal"

set CL_EXE="C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe"
set LINK_EXE="C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\bin\Hostx64\x64\link.exe"

set MSVC_INC="C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\include"
set MSVC_LIB="C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\lib\x64"

set WDK_INC_KM="C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.26100.0\km"
set WDK_INC_SHARED="C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.26100.0\shared"
set WDK_INC_KM_CRT="C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.26100.0\km\crt"
set WDK_LIB_KM="C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Lib\10.0.26100.0\km\x64"

set SRC=Driver\src
set SHARED=Shared
set OUT=build\Release\drv_obj

if not exist "%OUT%" mkdir "%OUT%"

echo === Compiling CS2 Kernel Driver ===

set CFLAGS=/c /D_AMD64_ /DNTDDI_VERSION=0x0A00000B /D_WIN64 /DDEPRECATE_DDK_FUNCTIONS=1 /kernel /GS- /W3 /EHs-c- /std:c++17 /O2 /Zc:wchar_t /Zc:inline

set INCLUDES=/I %WDK_INC_KM% /I %WDK_INC_SHARED% /I %WDK_INC_KM_CRT% /I %SHARED%

echo Compiling entry.cpp...
%CL_EXE% %CFLAGS% %INCLUDES% /Fo"%OUT%\entry.obj" %SRC%\entry.cpp
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

echo Compiling memory.cpp...
%CL_EXE% %CFLAGS% %INCLUDES% /Fo"%OUT%\memory.obj" %SRC%\memory.cpp
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

echo Compiling hide.cpp...
%CL_EXE% %CFLAGS% %INCLUDES% /Fo"%OUT%\hide.obj" %SRC%\hide.cpp
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

echo.
echo === Linking CS2Driver.sys ===
%LINK_EXE% /OUT:"build\Release\CS2Driver.sys" /NOLOGO /MACHINE:X64 /KERNEL /DRIVER /ENTRY:DriverEntry /SUBSYSTEM:NATIVE /NODEFAULTLIB /LIBPATH:%WDK_LIB_KM% /LIBPATH:%MSVC_LIB% ntoskrnl.lib hal.lib wmilib.lib libcntpr.lib "%OUT%\entry.obj" "%OUT%\memory.obj" "%OUT%\hide.obj"
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

echo.
echo === SUCCESS: build\Release\CS2Driver.sys ===
goto :end

:error
echo.
echo === BUILD FAILED ===

:end
endlocal

```
